editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, all caveats kept (T2 ≤ 2T1, "reset to 1 instead of 0", the qubit-order note for [0,1] vs [1,0]) — and the informal register (يمكنك، إذا أردت، لاحظ) holds everywhere. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "unitary" is rendered "موحَّد/الموحدة" (= unified/standardized) in the error table (mixed_unitary_error, coherent_unitary_error, pauli_error rows); it is consistent and root-recognizable but the conventional Arabic is "وحدوي/أحادي". (2) "qubit" is kept in Latin script almost everywhere ("qubit واحد", "الـ qubits", "n-Qubit") but is transliterated twice as "بوابة ثنائية القبيت" — one file, two conventions; likewise "الأخطاء الكمية" vs "أخطاء الكم" in the Quantum errors intro. (3) A few stiff/loose spots: "يُقرِّب تقريباً" is redundant for "roughly approximates"; "That suggests you should write your own transpiler pass" is hardened to "هذا يعني أنك تحتاج إلى…"; "overrides the simulator's basis gates" is softened to "يُعيد تهيئة"; and "عدد السكان الحرارية" has a gender-agreement slip (السكان … الحراري) plus "تشمل دوالاً" should be the diptote "دوالَّ". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: an n-qubit mixed unitary error given as a list of unitary matrices and probabilities
examples.suggested: خطأ وحدوي مختلط لـ n-Qubit يُعطى كقائمة من المصفوفات الوحدوية والاحتمالات
examples.translation: خطأ موحد مختلط لـ n-Qubit يُعطى كقائمة من المصفوفات الموحدة والاحتمالات
examples.why: "unitary" is rendered موحَّد (= unified/standardized) rather than the conventional وحدوي/أحادي; consistent and root-recognizable, so not misleading, but it is not the field's term (same issue in the coherent_unitary_error and pauli_error rows).

examples.source: an error applied to qubits [0, 1] for a two-qubit gate … When applying a two-qubit gate
examples.suggested: لبوابة ثنائية الـ qubit … عند تطبيق بوابة ثنائية الـ qubit
examples.translation: لبوابة ثنائية القبيت … عند تطبيق بوابة ثنائية القبيت
examples.why: The file otherwise keeps qubit in Latin script throughout (qubit واحد، الـ qubits، n-Qubit); these two spots switch to the transliteration القبيت, an in-file inconsistency for the single most frequent domain term.

examples.source: That suggests you should write your own transpiler pass (TransformationPass) and run the pass just before running the simulator if you need to…
examples.suggested: وهذا يشير إلى أنه يُستحسن أن تكتب تمريرة Transpiler خاصة بك…
examples.translation: هذا يعني أنك تحتاج إلى كتابة تمريرة Transpiler خاصة بك (TransformationPass) وتشغيلها مباشرة قبل تشغيل المحاكي إذا كنت بحاجة إلى…
examples.why: "suggests you should" is hardened to "means you need to"; the trailing conditional keeps it from misleading, but the English is advisory, not prescriptive.

examples.source: This will yield a noise model that roughly approximates the errors one would encounter when using that backend.
examples.suggested: سيُنتج هذا نموذج ضوضاء يُقارب الأخطاء التي ستواجهها عند استخدام ذلك الـ backend.
examples.translation: سيُنتج هذا نموذج ضوضاء يُقرِّب تقريباً الأخطاء التي ستواجهها عند استخدام ذلك الـ Backend.
examples.why: يُقرِّب تقريباً is a tautology no Arabic technical writer would produce — the verb already carries "approximate"; a plain يُقارب / يحاكي تقريبياً reads native.

examples.source: …gate time t, and excited state thermal population p1
examples.suggested: …وزمن البوابة $t$، والتعداد السكاني الحراري للحالة المثارة $p_1$
examples.translation: …وزمن البوابة $t$، وعدد السكان الحرارية للحالة المثارة $p_1$
examples.why: Gender-agreement slip (السكان … الحرارية) repeated in all three damping/relaxation rows; the physics sense of "population" is right, the adjective agreement is not.

editor_note: Nothing in this file misleads — every physics passage (phase disk, reduced purity range [0.5,1], q-sphere latitudes/Hamming distance, the |ψ⟩=(|00⟩+|01⟩+|10⟩−|11⟩)/2 example, CNOT/Toffoli/RCCX definitions) is faithful, and the informal anta register holds throughout with no antum slips. What a native editor would change is a systematic front-half/back-half terminology split: "visualization" is التصورات up to line 291 but التمثيلات المرئية from the §Visualizations heading on (so the cross-reference قسم [التصورات](#visualizations) points at a section titled التمثيلات المرئية); "circuit" is دارة (34×) in the first half and دائرة (11×) from "تشغيل الدوائر وعرض النتائج" on; QPU alternates between وحدة المعالجة الكمية (l.32/54) and وحدة معالجة الكم (l.300–333); "single-shot" is لقياس واحد (l.54) but أحادي اللقطة (l.333), and "pseudorandom" is شبه العشوائية (l.296) vs عشوائية زائفة (l.333) inside two copies of the same admonition. "Unitary" is أحادية nearly everywhere yet وحدوية once (l.470), and أحادي is simultaneously the word used for "single-qubit", so بارة like "تعريف بوابة أحادية" (table, "Declare a unitary gate") reads ambiguously. Plus "universal gate set" → مجموعة بوابات عالمية and "global phase" → طور عالمي are recognizable but calqued (شاملة / عام are the conventional renderings), and there are three mechanical slips: the duplicated "الجدول [الجدول]" at l.174, the typo عملتها for عمليتها at l.151, and the agreement errors تُضاف عمود (l.157) and ستُطلب منك (l.265, should be سيُطلب).

examples.source: Learn more in the [Visualizations](#visualizations) section.
examples.suggested: اطّلع على مزيد من المعلومات في قسم [التمثيلات المرئية](#visualizations).
examples.translation: اطّلع على مزيد من المعلومات في قسم [التصورات](#visualizations).
examples.why: "Visualizations" is التصورات in the interface tour (l.54, 56, 70, 291) but التمثيلات المرئية from the section heading at l.328 onward — the in-text link label no longer matches the section it points to.

examples.source: quantum processing units (QPUs) / the QPU specified in the Run settings
examples.suggested: pick one — e.g. وحدة المعالجة الكمية (QPU) everywhere
examples.translation: وحدة المعالجة الكمية (QPU) … وحدات معالجة الكم (QPUs)
examples.why: Same device name rendered two ways within the file (وحدة المعالجة الكمية in the tour, وحدة معالجة الكم throughout the Run-circuits and Visualizations sections).

examples.source: The Toffoli gate with the Hadamard gate is a universal gate set for quantum computing.
examples.suggested: … تشكّل مجموعة بوابات شاملة (universal) للحوسبة الكمية.
examples.translation: بوابة Toffoli مع بوابة هادامار تشكّل مجموعة بوابات عالمية للحوسبة الكمية.
examples.why: عالمية reads as "worldwide/international"; the conventional Arabic for a universal gate set is شاملة (or عامة). Same calque recurs for "global phase" → طور عالمي (l.550, 640).

examples.source: Declare a unitary gate / define new unitary operations / All unitary circuits
examples.suggested: use وحدوية consistently for unitary, reserving أحادي الـ qubit for single-qubit
examples.translation: تعريف بوابة أحادية / تعريف عمليات أحادية جديدة / كل الدوائر الوحدوية
examples.why: "Unitary" is rendered أحادية in most places but وحدوية once, and أحادي is also the word carrying "single-qubit" (بوابات أحادية الـ qubit) — so بوابة أحادية on its own is ambiguous between "unitary gate" and "single gate".

examples.source: The [table](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.03429.pdf#page=9) of OpenQASM language statements from the paper is reproduced below.
examples.suggested: [جدول](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.03429.pdf#page=9) عبارات لغة OpenQASM الوارد في الورقة مُعاد إنتاجه أدناه.
examples.translation: الجدول [الجدول](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.03429.pdf#page=9) لعبارات لغة OpenQASM الوارد في الورقة مُعاد إنتاجه أدناه.
examples.why: The word الجدول is duplicated (bare noun plus the link label) — a visible translation artifact no Arabic writer would leave.

examples.source: A control modifier yields a gate whose original operation… / A column of barrier operations … are added / you will be prompted to enter a name
examples.suggested: تصبح عمليتها الأصلية مشروطة … يُضاف عمود من عمليات الحاجز … سيُطلب منك إدخال اسم
examples.translation: تصبح عملتها الأصلية مشروطة … تُضاف عمود من عمليات الحاجز … ستُطلب منك إدخال اسم
examples.why: Three mechanical slips: عملتها is a typo for عمليتها (the glossary entry at l.~600 gets it right), and تُضاف / ستُطلب disagree in gender with عمود and the implied masculine subject.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal register ("vytvoříš", "zavolej", "Chceš-li", "tvé potřeby") is consistent — nothing here would mislead a learner. But "gate" is rendered two ways in the same file: correctly as "brána" in "Hadamardovy brány", and elsewhere as the bare, uninflected English noun capitalized mid-sentence — "sekvence jednoqubitových Gate", "tyto Gate syntetizovat", "dvěma sousedními CX Gate", "sousední dvouqubitové Gate" — which a Czech technical writer would never write (it should be "jednoqubitové brány", "CX brány"). "Basis" is likewise split and slightly off: "základní sady cílového zařízení" (line 36) vs "syntetizuje do základny R_y, R_z a R_xx" (line 91), where "základna" means a base/foundation, not a mathematical basis; the domain term is "báze" (bázové brány). Finally the English singular "a preset staged pass manager" is pluralized in the section heading and its lead sentence ("Vygenerování přednastavených staged pass managerů", "Pro vytvoření přednastavených staged pass managerů", "začít s přednastavenými staged pass managery"), which loosens the "generate one pass manager" instruction to a vaguer plural.

examples.source: merge all consecutive sequences of single-qubit gates, and then the next pass could synthesize these gates … two adjacent CX gates
examples.suggested: sloučit všechny po sobě jdoucí sekvence jednoqubitových bran a následující pass může tyto brány syntetizovat … dvěma sousedními branami CX
examples.translation: sloučit všechny po sobě jdoucí sekvence jednoqubitových Gate, a následující pass může tyto Gate syntetizovat … dvěma sousedními CX Gate
examples.why: "gate" is translated correctly as "brána" in "Hadamardovy brány" but left as an uninflected, capitalized English "Gate" in four other places in the same file. Czech is inflected, so an undeclined "Gate" after "jednoqubitových/dvouqubitové" reads as broken machine output; the term is also inconsistent within the file. Recognizable, so not misleading — but a native editor would unify on "brána".

examples.source: synthesizes them into a basis of R_y, R_z, and R_xx gates
examples.suggested: syntetizuje do báze bran $R_y$, $R_z$ a $R_{xx}$
examples.translation: syntetizuje do základny $R_y$, $R_z$ a $R_{xx}$
examples.why: "základna" is a base/foundation (or a military base), not a linear-algebra/gate-set basis; the established Czech term is "báze" ("bázové brány" for basis gates). It also conflicts with "základní sady" used for the same English "basis set" at line 36, so the concept is rendered two different ways in one page.

examples.source: Generate a preset staged pass manager / To create a preset staged pass manager with reasonable defaults / begin with a preset staged pass manager and then swap out some of the stages
examples.suggested: Vygenerování přednastaveného staged pass manageru / Pro vytvoření přednastaveného staged pass manageru s rozumnými výchozími hodnotami / je začít s přednastaveným staged pass managerem
examples.translation: Vygenerování přednastavených staged pass managerů / Pro vytvoření přednastavených staged pass managerů s rozumnými výchozími hodnotami / je začít s přednastavenými staged pass managery
examples.why: The English is consistently singular — the section teaches you to generate one pass manager, and the code that follows produces exactly one. The Czech plural blurs that into a general statement about "preset pass managers" and no longer matches the single-object example below it. Number-only drift, so not misleading, but a native editor would restore the singular (the surrounding singular usages at lines 88 and 89 already do).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ty" register holds consistently ("poskytnout ti", "prohlédni si", "najdeš", "budeš umět"), so nothing here misleads a learner — but a native technical editor would change several things. The biggest is a glossary leak: "circuit", "gate" and "qubit" are left as capitalized, mostly undeclined English nouns inside Czech sentences ("přenos Circuit do kvantového procesoru", "generováním kvantových Circuit", "orientaci v kvantových Gate a Circuit", "sestavovat tak kvantové Circuit", "ve stavech samotných Qubitů") where Czech has fully standard, universally used terms (kvantové obvody, hradla, kubity) — "kvantových Gate a Circuit" is not even grammatical. Second, "quantum computing" is rendered three ways in the same file (kvantové počítání / kvantové výpočty / kvantové výpočetnictví), and "workflow" alternates with "pracovní postupy". Third, a scatter of calques and slips a Czech writer would not produce: "IBM pozicionuje architekturu" (non-word calque of "positions"), "kompozabilní", "Přístup je poháněn", "distribuovaná paměťová programování" (should be "programování s distribuovanou pamětí"), "interpretovat výsledky s přesností", a dropped reflexive in "jak HPC a kvantové výpočty mohou v praxi vzájemně doplňovat" (missing "se"), the misspelled "Seymouram Crayem", and the launchpad metaphor rendered "odpalovací rameno" instead of the correct "odpalovací rampa".

examples.source: Tasks such as compiling and feeding circuits into the quantum processor … familiarity with quantum gates and circuits … Information is stored and processed in the states of qubits themselves.
examples.suggested: … kompilace a přenos obvodů do kvantového procesoru … orientaci v kvantových hradlech a obvodech … ve stavech samotných kubitů.
examples.translation: Úlohy jako kompilace a přenos Circuit do kvantového procesoru … orientaci v kvantových Gate a Circuit … Informace jsou ukládány a zpracovávány ve stavech samotných Qubitů.
examples.why: Glossary keep-English leak applied to terms Czech does translate. "obvod", "hradlo", "kubit" are the standard, unambiguous Czech domain terms; the leaked forms are undeclined and "kvantových Gate a Circuit" is ungrammatical.

examples.source: quantum computing (throughout)
examples.suggested: Pick one — "kvantové počítání" (or "kvantové výpočetnictví") — and use it throughout; likewise choose between "workflow" and "pracovní postupy", which also alternate (l. 49 vs 79/81/95/127).
examples.translation: kvantové počítání (l. 20, 44, 46) / kvantové výpočty (l. 68, 76) / kvantové výpočetnictví (l. 74, 95, 110, 123)
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency for the file's most central term; all three are defensible individually, but switching among them in a teaching text reads as machine output rather than an edited document.

examples.source: Overall, IBM positions the QCSC architecture as a practical roadmap for HPC centers…
examples.suggested: Celkově IBM prezentuje architekturu QCSC jako praktický plán pro HPC centra…
examples.translation: Celkově IBM pozicionuje architekturu QCSC jako praktický plán pro HPC centra…
examples.why: "pozicionuje" is not a Czech verb — a raw calque of "positions". Same class: "kompozabilní" (l. 81) for "composable" (better: skládatelná/kompozovatelná) and "Přístup je poháněn" (l. 79) for "is driven by" (better: vychází z / je motivován).

examples.source: demonstrates how HPC and quantum computing can complement each other in practice … distributed memory programming … interpret the results with accuracy
examples.suggested: …mohou se v praxi vzájemně doplňovat … programování s distribuovanou pamětí … přesně interpretovat výsledky
examples.translation: ukazuje, jak HPC a kvantové výpočty mohou v praxi vzájemně doplňovat … distribuovaná paměťová programování … interpretovat výsledky s přesností
examples.why: Three separate mechanical slips: the reflexive "se" required by "doplňovat se" is dropped (the sentence is ungrammatical as written), "distributed memory programming" is calqued into a malformed noun phrase, and "with accuracy" is transliterated instead of turned into the natural adverb.

examples.source: built by Seymour Cray … Think of this course as your launchpad
examples.suggested: postavený Seymourem Crayem … Vnímej tento kurz jako svou odpalovací rampu
examples.translation: postavený Seymouram Crayem … Vnímej tento kurz jako své odpalovací rameno
examples.why: "Seymouram" is a misspelled instrumental of Seymour. "odpalovací rameno" (launch arm) is not the Czech word for a launchpad — "odpalovací rampa" is — so the closing motivational image lands slightly off.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the du-register holds consistently ("ermöglicht es dir", "gruppiere sie", "Wenn du ZNE aktivierst"); core terms are correct and stable (Observable/Observablen, Erwartungswert, Messbasis, Shot, Twirling, Fehlerminderung, PUB masculine throughout). The one term slip is "broadcasted shape" → "der gesendeten Form" (line ~40), i.e. "broadcast" taken in the transmit sense, even though the same sentence correctly says "NumPy-Broadcasting-Regeln" — the concept stays identifiable, so this is confusing rather than misleading. The rest is translationese a native technical editor would rewrite: the calque "Parameterwerten, gegen die der Circuit gebunden wird" (bind against), "Das Folgende ist ein visueller Überblick", "Regression an ein Extrapolationsmodell", "Mengen …, die ein gemeinsames Twirl teilen", plus the ungrammatical placeholder "<optionale ein oder mehrere Parameterwerte>" and a modifier shift in the Admonition ("Informationen über die für sie relevante Ausführung" attaches "relevant" to the execution rather than to the information).

examples.source: one expectation value estimate is returned for each element of the broadcasted shape
examples.suggested: für jedes Element der gebroadcasteten Form (Broadcast-Form) wird ein Schätzwert für den Erwartungswert zurückgegeben
examples.translation: für jedes Element der gesendeten Form wird ein Schätzwert für den Erwartungswert zurückgegeben
examples.why: "broadcast" is rendered as "gesendet" (transmitted), the wrong sense of the word; the same sentence already uses "NumPy-Broadcasting-Regeln", so the file is also internally inconsistent about the term.

examples.source: A collection of parameter values to bind the circuit against.
examples.suggested: Eine Sammlung von Parameterwerten, mit denen die Parameter des Circuits belegt werden.
examples.translation: Eine Sammlung von Parameterwerten, gegen die der Circuit gebunden wird.
examples.why: "gegen … gebunden" is a literal calque of English "bind against"; no German technical writer would use "gegen" for parameter binding.

examples.source: (`<single circuit>`, `<one or more observables>`, `<optional one or more parameter values>`, `<optional precision>`)
examples.suggested: (`<einzelner Circuit>`, `<ein oder mehrere Observablen>`, `<optional: ein oder mehrere Parameterwerte>`, `<optional: Präzision>`)
examples.translation: (`<einzelner Circuit>`, `<ein oder mehrere Observablen>`, `<optionale ein oder mehrere Parameterwerte>`, `<optionale Präzision>`)
examples.why: "optionale ein oder mehrere Parameterwerte" is ungrammatical — the adjective cannot precede the numeral phrase; the English "optional" is an annotation, not an attribute.

examples.source: The following is a visual outline … / weights in a non-linear regression to an extrapolator model / sets that share a common twirl
examples.suggested: Nachfolgend ein visueller Überblick … / Gewichte bei der nichtlinearen Anpassung an ein Extrapolationsmodell / Gruppen …, die dasselbe Twirl verwenden
examples.translation: Das Folgende ist ein visueller Überblick … / Gewichtungen in einer nicht-linearen Regression an ein Extrapolationsmodell / Mengen …, die ein gemeinsames Twirl teilen
examples.why: Three English-syntax calques in a row: "Das Folgende ist", "Regression an ein Modell", and "ein Twirl teilen" (English "share"); each is understandable but reads as machine output rather than German technical prose.

examples.source: primitive implementations can return any information about execution that is relevant to them
examples.suggested: können Primitive-Implementierungen beliebige für sie relevante Informationen über die Ausführung zurückgeben
examples.translation: können Primitive-Implementierungen beliebige Informationen über die für sie relevante Ausführung zurückgeben
examples.why: The relative clause is re-attached: the English says the information is relevant to the implementation, the German says the execution is. Meaning shifts slightly, though not enough to mislead about the API.

editor_note: Nothing misleading: all figures, the QAOA/VQE/ensemble logic, the qubit-count-limits-ensemble-size-not-data-volume caveat and the "not yet implemented" caveat are faithful, and the informal "du" register holds throughout with no Sie slips. What a native editor would fix: a plain typo "basierent" for "basierend" (Benchmarks section), the ungrammatical genitive "Integration von Quantenmaschinenlernens" (must be "…von Quantenmaschinenlernen", and the compound itself is a monstrous calque), and two more calqued compounds in the closing paragraph — "Großskalaversion" (large-scale version) and "iterativen äußeren Schleifenansatz" (outer-loop approach) — which no German ML writer would coin. Separately, the frontmatter translates the product name ("Singularity Machine Learning - Klassifizierung von Multiverse Computing") while the H1 and every body mention keep the English "Singularity Machine Learning - Classification"; worse, "Klassifizierung von Multiverse Computing" reads as classification *of* the company rather than *by* it. The anglicised possessive "Singularitys quantengestütztem Ensemble-Klassifikator" is also un-German ("des quantengestützten Ensemble-Klassifikators von Singularity").

examples.source: Singularity Machine Learning - Classification by Multiverse Computing
examples.suggested: Singularity Machine Learning - Classification: eine Qiskit Function von Multiverse Computing
examples.translation: Singularity Machine Learning - Klassifizierung von Multiverse Computing
examples.why: The product name is kept in English everywhere else in the file (H1 line 15, line 42, line 89, line 379, line 415); translating only the frontmatter splits the name, and 'Klassifizierung von Multiverse Computing' parses as 'classification of Multiverse Computing' rather than 'by'.

examples.source: seeking to enhance their tech offerings by integrating quantum machine learning into their products and services
examples.suggested: die ihr Technologieangebot durch die Integration von quantenbasiertem maschinellem Lernen in ihre Produkte und Dienstleistungen erweitern möchten
examples.translation: die ihr Technologieangebot durch die Integration von Quantenmaschinenlernens in ihre Produkte und Dienstleistungen erweitern möchten
examples.why: Grammatically wrong — 'von' takes the dative, so the genitive -s in 'Quantenmaschinenlernens' is an outright error; and the compound 'Quantenmaschinenlernen' (also 'Quantenmaschinenlernlösungen', line 44) is a calque no German ML writer uses.

examples.source: an AdaBoost classifier based on an ensemble of size 75
examples.suggested: ein AdaBoost-Klassifikator, der auf einem Ensemble der Größe 75 basiert
examples.translation: ein AdaBoost-Klassifikator basierent auf einem Ensemble der Größe 75
examples.why: 'basierent' is a typo for 'basierend'; the participle construction also needs a comma, and a relative clause reads better here.

examples.source: through the implementation of a large-scale version of the classifier … By leveraging an iterative outer-loop approach
examples.suggested: durch die Implementierung einer großskaligen Version des Klassifikators … Mit einem iterativen Outer-Loop-Ansatz
examples.translation: durch die Implementierung einer Großskalaversion des Klassifikators … Durch einen iterativen äußeren Schleifenansatz
examples.why: 'Großskalaversion' and 'äußerer Schleifenansatz' are word-for-word calques; German technical prose either keeps 'Outer Loop' in English or says 'eine iterative äußere Schleife', and 'large-scale' becomes an adjective, not a noun-compound stem.

examples.source: using Singularity's quantum-enhanced ensemble classifier
examples.suggested: mit dem quantengestützten Ensemble-Klassifikator von Singularity
examples.translation: mit Singularitys quantengestütztem Ensemble-Klassifikator
examples.why: The English -s possessive on a product name is an anglicism in German prose; the von-construction is the idiomatic rendering. ('quantengestützt' for quantum-enhanced is a good, consistent choice throughout — keep it.)

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats — and the informal "tú" register holds cleanly ("Usa", "puedas", "visita", "No dudes en enviar comentarios"). The defect is glossary leakage: the common noun "circuit" is rendered inconsistently as "circuito" in most of the file ("variantes del circuito", "circuito plantilla", "capas del circuito") but left capitalized as English "Circuit"/"circuits" in five places ("la costosa generación de variantes de Circuit", "colecciones de operaciones de Circuit", "estratificar tu Circuit en cajas", "una lista de circuits", "instrucciones de Circuit con cajas") — reading as if Circuit were a class name rather than the ordinary word. The same leak hits "one- and two-qubit gates" → "Gates de uno y dos qubits" (should be "puertas/compuertas de uno y dos qubits") and "transpiler passes" → "pasadas del Transpiler" (should be "pasadas del transpilador"). None of this teaches a false concept, so it is MINOR, but a native editor would lowercase and translate all three.

examples.source: shifts the costly generation of circuit variants to the server side / collections of circuit operations / you can stratify your circuit into boxes / you pass in a list of circuits / a list of boxed circuit instructions
examples.suggested: …variantes de circuito… / colecciones de operaciones de circuito / estratificar tu circuito en cajas / una lista de circuitos / una lista de instrucciones de circuito agrupadas en cajas
examples.translation: desplaza la costosa generación de variantes de Circuit al lado del servidor / colecciones de operaciones de Circuit / puedes estratificar tu Circuit en cajas / pasas una lista de circuits / una lista de instrucciones de Circuit con cajas
examples.why: Glossary keep-English leak on a plain common noun. The same file already says "variantes del circuito", "circuito plantilla" and "capas del circuito", so "circuit" is split two ways within one page; the capitalized form also reads as an API class name, which it is not here.

examples.source: it runs the Pauli-Lindblad learning protocol if the set contains one- and two-qubit gates
examples.suggested: …si el conjunto contiene puertas de uno y dos qubits
examples.translation: ejecuta el protocolo de aprendizaje de Pauli-Lindblad si el conjunto contiene Gates de uno y dos qubits
examples.why: "Gate" as a quantum-circuit primitive has a settled Spanish rendering ("puerta"/"compuerta"); leaving it capitalized in English mid-sentence is an over-translation-by-omission and clashes with "qubits", which is correctly lowercased and naturalized.

examples.source: the Samplomatic library also provides transpiler passes that automatically group circuit instructions into annotated boxes
examples.suggested: …también proporciona pasadas del transpilador que agrupan automáticamente…
examples.translation: la biblioteca Samplomatic también proporciona pasadas del Transpiler que agrupan automáticamente las instrucciones del circuito en cajas anotadas
examples.why: "transpiler pass" is a generic pipeline concept here, not the Qiskit `transpile` API; Spanish Qiskit docs use "pasadas del transpilador". Capitalizing "Transpiler" makes it look like a named object and breaks with "circuito", which is translated in the very same clause.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, and the load-bearing Sampler/Estimator caveat ("se requieren mediciones" vs. "no deben contener mediciones") and both `compose`/`decompose` non-mutation notes are rendered correctly. Terminology is correct and consistent (qubit, compuerta for gate, circuito parametrizado, primitiva Sampler/Estimator, bits clásicos, registro clásico) and the informal tú register holds ("usa", "Consulta", "Ten en cuenta"). What a native editor would change is translationese: the calques "las compuertas cuánticas toman tiempo para implementarse" (take time to implement → tardan en implementarse), "Esto toma una instrucción" (This takes → recibe/acepta), and "Ve un ejemplo de circuitos siendo utilizados" (English -ing calque). There is also one genuine agreement/syntax error in line 52 — "Cada QuantumRegister y ClassicalRegister también se le puede asignar un nombre" is missing the dative "A cada …" — and a doubled preposition in the `measure` bullet ("mide cada qubit en el primer argumento en el bit clásico"), which momentarily obscures which argument is which.

examples.source: Every QuantumRegister and ClassicalRegister can also be named.
examples.suggested: A cada `QuantumRegister` y `ClassicalRegister` también se le puede asignar un nombre.
examples.translation: Cada [`QuantumRegister`] y [`ClassicalRegister`] también se le puede asignar un nombre.
examples.why: Ungrammatical as written: the impersonal "se le puede asignar" needs the dative "A cada …"; without it the subject and the clitic "le" do not agree and the sentence reads as unedited MT.

examples.source: Because quantum gates take time to implement, the depth of a circuit roughly corresponds to the amount of time...
examples.suggested: Dado que las compuertas cuánticas tardan un tiempo en aplicarse, la profundidad de un circuito corresponde aproximadamente al tiempo...
examples.translation: Debido a que las compuertas cuánticas toman tiempo para implementarse, la profundidad de un circuito corresponde aproximadamente a la cantidad de tiempo...
examples.why: "toman tiempo para implementarse" is a word-for-word calque of "take time to implement"; Spanish uses "tardar en". Meaning survives, but no native technical writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: This takes an instruction and a list of qubits to apply the instruction to.
examples.suggested: Este método recibe una instrucción y la lista de qubits a los que se le aplicará.
examples.translation: Esto toma una instrucción y una lista de qubits a los que aplicar la instrucción.
examples.why: "Esto toma" is a calque of English "This takes" (also used in bullet 2, "no toma argumentos"); Spanish API prose says "recibe"/"acepta". The bare demonstrative "Esto" for a method is also stiff.

examples.source: measures each qubit in the first argument onto the classical bit given as the second argument
examples.suggested: mide cada qubit del primer argumento sobre el bit clásico dado como segundo argumento
examples.translation: mide cada qubit en el primer argumento en el bit clásico dado como segundo argumento
examples.why: The doubled "en … en …" collapses the source/target distinction that "in … onto …" carries in English, so the reader has to re-parse which argument holds the qubits and which the destination bit.

examples.source: See an example of circuits being used in the Grover's Algorithm tutorial.
examples.suggested: Consulta un ejemplo del uso de circuitos en el tutorial [Algoritmo de Grover].
examples.translation: Ve un ejemplo de circuitos siendo utilizados en el tutorial [Algoritmo de Grover].
examples.why: "circuitos siendo utilizados" is the classic calque of the English progressive passive; Spanish nominalizes ("el uso de circuitos"). "Ve" as an imperative for "See" is also ambiguous with the verb "ir" here.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, no dropped caveats; the tricky v1.0 upgrade warning ("tu **ne peux pas** utiliser `pip install -U qiskit`") and the 32-bit clause ("seules les plateformes 64 bits sont prises en charge ; les plateformes 32 bits ne le sont plus") are both correct, and the "tu" register holds with no vous/veuillez slips. Three editorial defects remain. (1) One `AccordionItem title` is left entirely in English — "`No Module 'qiskit'` error with Jupyter Notebook" — while its sibling titles ARE translated ("Erreurs de compilation pendant l'installation", "Si tu débutes avec les environnements virtuels…"), so the Troubleshooting accordion renders half-English. (2) "support" is split within the file: the H2 and its cross-reference use the anglicism "Support des systèmes d'exploitation" and "Ajouter le support de visualisation", while every body sentence uses the correct "prise en charge" / "pris en charge". (3) Two calques a native technical writer would rewrite: "navigue vers le répertoire de ton projet" and "sur la base du meilleur effort".

examples.source: <AccordionItem title="`No Module 'qiskit'` error with Jupyter Notebook">
examples.suggested: <AccordionItem title="Erreur `No Module 'qiskit'` avec Jupyter Notebook">
examples.translation: <AccordionItem title="`No Module 'qiskit'` error with Jupyter Notebook">
examples.why: Untranslated accordion heading while the two sibling titles in the same file are translated; the Troubleshooting section renders half in English.

examples.source: Add visualization support / Operating system support
examples.suggested: Ajouter la prise en charge de la visualisation / Prise en charge des systèmes d'exploitation
examples.translation: Ajouter le support de visualisation / Support des systèmes d'exploitation
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: headings use the anglicism « support » while every body sentence correctly uses « prise en charge » / « pris en charge ».

examples.source: First, navigate to your project directory and create a minimal environment with only Python installed in it.
examples.suggested: Commence par te placer dans le répertoire de ton projet, puis crée un environnement minimal ne contenant que Python.
examples.translation: D'abord, navigue vers le répertoire de ton projet et crée un environnement minimal avec uniquement Python d'installé.
examples.why: « navigue vers » is a calque of "navigate to" — for a shell `cd` a French technical writer says « place-toi dans » / « rends-toi dans »; « avec uniquement Python d'installé » is also awkward.

examples.source: Support for these operating systems are best effort only.
examples.suggested: La prise en charge de ces systèmes d'exploitation est assurée au mieux, sans garantie.
examples.translation: Le support de ces systèmes d'exploitation est fourni sur la base du meilleur effort.
examples.why: "best effort" rendered word-for-word as « sur la base du meilleur effort » reads as translationese; the idiomatic French is « au mieux, sans garantie ».

editor_note: Idiomatic native French throughout with faithful meaning and consistent "tu" register ("Tu peux exécuter tes charges de travail basées sur les primitives Qiskit…", "Commence par créer une session…", "Entraîne-toi avec les primitives"); core terms are correctly conventional — job/session/batch/backend/Estimator/Sampler kept in English, "context manager" → "gestionnaire de contexte", "workloads" → "charges de travail", "queuing each job" → "la mise en file d'attente de chaque job", "broadcasting numpy" left untranslated as the field does.

No semantic drift: the caveats survive intact (the "NOT the time used for billing" line becomes "זה **אינו** הזמן המשמש לחיוב (זמן QPU)", the Sampler-only restriction and the preview-status warning are both present), and the raw-data field list, the dt/scheduling-cycle definition and the "X gate on qubit 10 at 1161 dt" example all match the English. What a native technical editor would change is phrasing and term casing. "gate" is kept English in the field list ("ה-Gate וה-Qubit לפעול עליו") but Hebraized as "שער ה-X" further down — inconsistent, and that field-list gloss is a stiff calque of "the gate and the qubit to operate on" that a Hebrew writer would render as "השער והקיוביט שעליהם מתבצעת הפעולה". Two more word-choice slips: "pulses בקרה" puts an English plural noun before a Hebrew modifier where "פולסי בקרה" is the natural form, and "capture" is glossed with "מקליט" (audio-record) instead of "רושם/מתעד" for recording a qubit state. None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: `Instruction` - The gate and the qubit to operate on.
examples.suggested: `Instruction` - השער והקיוביט שעליהם מתבצעת הפעולה.
examples.translation: `Instruction` - ה-Gate וה-Qubit לפעול עליו.
examples.why: Word-for-word calque: the dangling infinitive "לפעול עליו" has no subject in Hebrew and the singular "עליו" does not agree with the two conjoined nouns. Also the only place "gate" is left in English; line 150 uses "שער ה-X".

examples.source: A `play` type applies control pulses, and a `capture` records the qubit's state.
examples.suggested: סוג `play` מפעיל פולסי בקרה, ו-`capture` רושם את מצב הקיוביט.
examples.translation: סוג `play` מיישם pulses בקרה, ו-`capture` מקליט את מצב ה-Qubit.
examples.why: "pulses בקרה" mixes an English plural head noun with a Hebrew modifier in Hebrew construct order — natural form is "פולסי בקרה". "מקליט" is the verb for audio recording; for capturing/registering a qubit state Hebrew technical prose uses "רושם" or "מתעד".

examples.source: It is an instruction played on all channels that are part of a communication procedure with the hub at that time.
examples.suggested: זוהי הוראה שמופעלת על כל הערוצים המשתתפים בהליך תקשורת עם ה-hub באותו זמן.
examples.translation: זוהי הוראה שמתנגנת על כל הערוצים שהם חלק מנוהל תקשורת עם ה-hub באותו הזמן.
examples.why: "מתנגנת" is the reflexive/intransitive "plays by itself" (music sense); the passive "played on a channel" needs "מנוגנת" or better "מופעלת". "נוהל" also reads as an administrative regulation rather than a hardware procedure.

examples.source: Visualize the timing of generated circuits by generating a figure that you can view, download, or both.
examples.suggested: הצג חזותית את תזמון המעגלים שנוצרו, באמצעות יצירת איור שאפשר לצפות בו, להוריד, או שניהם.
examples.translation: הצג חזותית את תזמון המעגלים שנוצרו על ידי יצירת איור שאפשר לצפות בו, להוריד, או שניהם.
examples.why: Garden path: "המעגלים שנוצרו על ידי יצירת איור" reads first as "the circuits that were created by generating a figure". "באמצעות" plus a comma attaches the means-phrase to the verb, as the English does.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, the unit-circle wraparound remark and the |λ|=1 derivation are all correct, and core math terms are right and consistent (ערך עצמי / וקטור עצמי, מטריצה אוניטרית, פירוק ספקטרלי, קיוביטים, אמידת הפאזה). The main defect is an untranslated English glossary leak: "circuit" is left as the Latin-script word "Circuit" inside Hebrew sentences three times ("יחד עם Circuit קוונטי אוניטרי", "פעולת ה-Circuit", "קלט: Circuit קוונטי אוניטרי") where the conventional Hebrew is מעגל קוונטי — jarring, especially since מעגל is used correctly two lines later for "מעגל היחידה". Second, several calques and grammar slips a native editor would fix: "אנחנו *מובטחים* ש-" for "we're promised that" (Hebrew needs *מובטח* לנו ש-), gender disagreement in "ניתנת לנו מצב קוונטי" and "זהו תוצאה", and "מטריצה שלעתים קרובות מועילה לשקול" as a word-for-word render of "helpful to consider". Third, "The theorem implies" is rendered "המשפט מרמז" (the theorem hints) twice, which softens a logical entailment — מלשון גרירה (המשפט גורר / מהמשפט נובע) is what a Hebrew math writer would use — and "בבחירת ערכי העצמי" (line ~230) is ungrammatical and inconsistent with the correct "ערכים עצמיים" used elsewhere. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: along with a unitary quantum circuit that acts on n qubits … a unitary quantum circuit for an n-qubit operation U
examples.suggested: יחד עם מעגל קוונטי אוניטרי הפועל על $n$ קיוביטים … קלט: מעגל קוונטי אוניטרי לפעולה $U$
examples.translation: יחד עם Circuit קוונטי אוניטרי הפועל על $n$ קיוביטים … קלט: Circuit קוונטי אוניטרי לפעולה $U$
examples.why: The English word "Circuit" is left in Latin script inside Hebrew prose (3 occurrences, incl. "פעולת ה-Circuit"). Hebrew quantum writing uses מעגל קוונטי; the same file already writes מעגל היחידה for the mathematical circle, so the leak is not a deliberate keep-in-English convention.

examples.source: We're *promised* that |ψ⟩ is an eigenvector of the unitary matrix U
examples.suggested: *מובטח* לנו ש-$\vert \psi\rangle$ הוא וקטור עצמי של המטריצה האוניטרית $U$
examples.translation: אנחנו *מובטחים* ש-$\vert \psi\rangle$ הוא וקטור עצמי של המטריצה האוניטרית $U$
examples.why: Direct calque of the English passive. "אנחנו מובטחים" is not idiomatic Hebrew (it reads as "we are pledged/betrothed"); the promise-construction takes an impersonal מובטח לנו ש-. Same pattern also affects the neighbouring "ניתנת לנו מצב קוונטי", where the verb disagrees in gender with the masculine מצב (should be ניתן לנו).

examples.source: The theorem implies that I can be written in the form (1) … The spectral theorem implies that H can be written in the form (1)
examples.suggested: מהמשפט נובע שניתן לכתוב את $\mathbb{I}$ בצורה $(1)$ … ממשפט הספקטרום נובע שניתן לכתוב את $H$ בצורה $(1)$
examples.translation: המשפט מרמז ש-$\mathbb{I}$ ניתן לכתוב בצורה $(1)$ … משפט הספקטרום מרמז ש-$H$ ניתן לכתוב בצורה $(1)$
examples.why: מרמז means "hints at", which softens a strict logical entailment into a suggestion — a theorem does not hint. Hebrew mathematical register uses נובע/גורר. The word order "ש-I ניתן לכתוב" is also calqued from the English passive.

examples.source: There is, however, no freedom at all in how the eigenvalues are chosen … eigenvalues of unitary matrices must always have absolute value equal to one
examples.suggested: אין כלל חופש בבחירת הערכים העצמיים, פרט לסדרם
examples.translation: אין כלל חופש בבחירת ערכי העצמי, פרט לסדרם … ערכים עצמיים של מטריצות אוניטריות חייבים תמיד להיות בעלי ערך מוחלט שווה לאחד
examples.why: "ערכי העצמי" is an ill-formed plural of ערך עצמי (it construes עצמי as a noun); the correct and already-used form elsewhere in the same file is ערכים עצמיים / הערכים העצמיים. Within-file inconsistency plus a grammatical slip in the same clause.

examples.source: (This is a simple but great example of a matrix that's often very helpful to consider.)
examples.suggested: (זוהי דוגמה פשוטה אך מצוינת למטריצה שלעתים קרובות כדאי מאוד לשקול אותה.)
examples.translation: (זוהי דוגמה פשוטה אך מצוינת של מטריצה שלעתים קרובות מועילה לשקול.)
examples.why: Word-for-word rendering of "helpful to consider" leaves a dangling infinitive with no object; Hebrew needs a resumptive pronoun or an impersonal construction. The same missing-resumptive pattern appears in the section opener, "מטריצות … ניתן לבטא בצורה פשוטה ושימושית" (should be ניתן לבטא אותן).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "kamu/-mu" register holds consistently (no "Anda"/bapak-ibu slips); core terms are right and stable (primitif Qiskit, transpilasi, observabel pengukuran, penekanan error / mitigasi error, mode eksekusi Job/Session/Batch). Three editorial defects, none misleading: (1) "circuit" is kept in English but capitalized mid-sentence — "eksekusi Circuit kuantum" (§Qiskit Runtime) and "mengambil Circuit abstrak" (§Qiskit Functions) — which reads as a glossary/keep-English artifact rather than prose; a native writer would write "sirkuit kuantum" / "sirkuit abstrak" (or at minimum lowercase it, reserving capitalized "Circuit functions" for the product name). (2) "access plans" is rendered "rencana akses" twice (§IBM Quantum Platform), a calque that reads as "a plan of action" rather than the subscription tiers the page means (Open/Premium/Flex Plan) — "paket akses" is the conventional term. (3) "can be run over a specified number of shots" becomes "dapat dijalankan selama jumlah shot yang ditentukan"; "selama" reads as duration ("for the duration of"), where shots are repetitions — "untuk sejumlah shot yang ditentukan" is correct.

examples.source: ...from executing quantum circuits on quantum processors. / ...that take abstract circuits and desired measurement observables as input.
examples.suggested: ...dari eksekusi sirkuit kuantum di prosesor kuantum. / ...yang mengambil sirkuit abstrak dan observabel pengukuran yang diinginkan sebagai input.
examples.translation: ...dari eksekusi Circuit kuantum di prosesor kuantum. / ...yang mengambil Circuit abstrak dan observabel pengukuran yang diinginkan sebagai input.
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English and capitalized in mid-sentence running prose, which reads as an untranslated glossary token, not as something a native technical writer would type. Indonesian quantum material normally uses "sirkuit kuantum"; capitalized "Circuit" should be reserved for the product name "Circuit functions", which the same bullet also uses — so the file effectively splits the word between prose and product name without marking the difference.

examples.source: ...configuring access plans... / ...users can select or adjust access plans...
examples.suggested: ...mengonfigurasi paket akses... / ...pengguna dapat memilih atau menyesuaikan paket akses...
examples.translation: ...mengonfigurasi rencana akses... / ...pengguna dapat memilih atau menyesuaikan rencana akses...
examples.why: "Plan" here means a service tier/subscription (the page itself later names Open Plan, Premium Plan, Flex Plan). "Rencana" is the literal sense of plan-as-scheme, so the Indonesian reads like configuring an access strategy rather than choosing a billing/entitlement tier. "Paket" is the conventional Indonesian rendering for a service plan and would also line up with the untranslated "Premium Plan / Flex Plan" later in the file.

examples.source: A Job is a single query to a primitive that can be run over a specified number of shots.
examples.suggested: Job adalah satu kueri ke primitif yang dapat dijalankan untuk sejumlah shot yang ditentukan.
examples.translation: Job adalah satu kueri ke primitif yang dapat dijalankan selama jumlah shot yang ditentukan.
examples.why: "Selama" is temporal ("during / for the duration of"), so the sentence suggests the job runs for a period of time measured in shots. The English "over N shots" means the query is repeated N times; "untuk sejumlah shot" preserves the repetition sense. A beginner reading this page for the definition of a shot could take away a duration-based intuition instead of a repetition-based one, though the surrounding context keeps it recoverable.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats — and the informal inclusive "kita" register holds (only two "kami" slips at lines 92 and 330), but several math/CS terms are literal-but-wrong false friends a native technical editor would fix: "dividend" → "dividen" (line 330, which in Indonesian means a stock dividend; should be "bilangan yang dibagi"), "arbitrary unitary gates" → "gate uniter sewenang-wenang" (line 113; math Indonesian uses "sembarang"), "modular exponentiation" → "eksponen modular" (lines 344/346/383 — names the exponent, not the operation; "eksponensiasi/perpangkatan modular"), "prohibitive computational costs" → "biaya komputasional yang melarang" (line 426), and "cascading half adders/full adders" → "mengalirkan" (lines 258, 264, 424 — "to make flow", not "to chain in series"). Terminology is otherwise consistent and well chosen (gate/qubit/uniter/rangkaian kept stable), but "greatest common divisor" is rendered "faktor pembagi terbesar" at line 381 with "persekutuan" dropped, while the same concept stays "GCD" at lines 186/227/340–342. The remaining defects are calques rather than errors: "model yang tidak realistis kuat" (line 125) copies English adverb order and momentarily reads as "not realistically powerful"; "kedalaman mereka" / "mereka tampaknya" (lines 178, 401, 413) use the animate pronoun for circuits and algorithms; and "algoritma asimtotik yang cepat" (lines 382–383) misattaches the modifier of "asymptotically fast algorithms".

examples.source: Another basic problem is *division*, which we interpret to mean computing both the quotient and remainder given an integer divisor and dividend.
examples.suggested: Masalah dasar lainnya adalah *pembagian*, yang kita artikan sebagai menghitung hasil bagi dan sisa dari suatu pembagi dan bilangan yang dibagi (keduanya bilangan bulat).
examples.translation: Masalah dasar lainnya adalah *pembagian*, yang kami interpretasikan sebagai menghitung kuosien dan sisa yang diberikan pembagi dan dividen integer.
examples.why: "Dividen" in Indonesian is the financial term (share payout), not the number being divided; the correct term is "bilangan yang dibagi". The relative clause "sisa yang diberikan pembagi" also mis-parses "given" as "provided by". Same line carries a "kami" slip where the file otherwise uses inclusive "kita".

examples.source: A somewhat more expensive computation that arises in number theory is *modular exponentiation*.
examples.suggested: ... adalah *eksponensiasi modular* (perpangkatan modular).
examples.translation: Komputasi yang agak lebih mahal yang muncul dalam teori bilangan adalah *eksponen modular*.
examples.why: "Eksponen modular" names a number (the exponent), not the operation of raising to a power mod M; the operation is "eksponensiasi/perpangkatan modular". The Figure that follows defines N^K mod M, so the concept survives, but the label is the wrong part of speech and is repeated three times.

examples.source: By cascading two half adders and taking the OR of the carry bits they produce, we can create what's known as a *full adder*.
examples.suggested: Dengan merangkai (menyusun berantai) dua half adder dan mengambil OR dari bit carry yang dihasilkannya, ...
examples.translation: Dengan mengalirkan dua half adder dan mengambil OR dari bit carry yang mereka hasilkan, kita bisa membuat apa yang dikenal sebagai *full adder*.
examples.why: "Mengalirkan" means to make something flow/drain; it does not convey chaining circuits in series, which is the whole construction being taught here. It recurs for "cascading the full adders" (line 264) and "cascading full adders" in the uniformity section (line 424).

examples.source: Classical algorithms for integer addition, multiplication, division, and computing greatest common divisors ...
examples.suggested: ... dan menghitung faktor persekutuan terbesar (FPB/GCD) ...
examples.translation: Algoritma klasikal untuk penjumlahan, perkalian, pembagian integer, dan menghitung faktor pembagi terbesar ...
examples.why: Dropping "persekutuan" (common) makes the term denote the greatest divisor of one number rather than the greatest common divisor of two. It also breaks with the rest of the file, which keeps the English "GCD" (lines 186, 227, 340–342).

examples.source: Sometimes all single-qubit gates are viewed as being elementary, though this does lead to an unrealistically powerful model when the accuracy with which gates are performed is not properly taken into account.
examples.suggested: ... meskipun ini menghasilkan model yang kuat secara tidak realistis ketika akurasi pelaksanaan gate tidak diperhitungkan dengan benar.
examples.translation: Terkadang semua gate qubit tunggal dipandang sebagai dasar, meskipun ini memang mengarah pada model yang tidak realistis kuat ketika akurasi pelaksanaan gate tidak diperhitungkan dengan benar.
examples.why: Indonesian puts the adverbial after the adjective; "tidak realistis kuat" copies English word order and on first reading can be parsed as "not realistically powerful" — the opposite of the warning that the model becomes too powerful.

examples.source: ... viewing arbitrary unitary gates, potentially acting on millions of qubits, as being elementary operations ...
examples.translation: ... memandang gate uniter sewenang-wenang, yang berpotensi bekerja pada jutaan qubit, sebagai operasi dasar ...
examples.why: "Sewenang-wenang" is "arbitrary" in the sense of capricious/high-handed; the mathematical sense is "sembarang". A native technical writer would write "gate uniter sembarang".

examples.source: A different way to measure the efficiency of circuits ... is by their *depth*.
examples.suggested: ... adalah melalui *kedalaman*-nya.
examples.translation: Cara berbeda untuk mengukur efisiensi rangkaian ... adalah melalui *kedalaman* mereka.
examples.why: "Mereka" is the animate third-person plural; using it for circuits (line 178), for possibilities "ketika mereka diketahui mungkin" (line 401) and for advantages "mereka tampaknya kurang menarik" (line 413) is a direct calque of English "their/they" that no Indonesian technical writer would use.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner: the 50-qubit ceiling, the "no built-in error suppression or mitigation" caveat, the Open Plan sessions warning and the ansatz/transpiler passages all land correctly, terminology is consistent (qubit, QPU, gate di base, coupling map, fake backend, transpiler, circuiti di Clifford / circuiti stabilizzatori), and the informal "tu" holds throughout ("puoi", "devi", "consulta", "specifica"). Four things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The H1 reads "Migra dai simulatori cloud ai simulatori locali" while the EN H1 and the file's own frontmatter title are both "Migrate to local simulators" / "Migra ai simulatori locali" — an unexplained expansion that makes page title and heading disagree. (2) "eseguire simulazioni rumorose della QPU" is a calque of "noisy simulations"; Italian technical usage is "simulazioni con rumore" ("rumorose" reads as if the simulation itself makes noise). (3) The comparative in "provides higher-performance simulation" is flattened to "offre una simulazione ad alte prestazioni", losing the explicit "higher than the fake backends" contrast the sentence is built on. (4) In the comparison table "Runtime moderato" / "Runtime più breve" leaves "runtime" untranslated where it means execution time, which in a Qiskit page collides with the product name Qiskit Runtime; "tempo di esecuzione" is the unambiguous rendering.

examples.source: # Migrate to local simulators
examples.suggested: # Migra ai simulatori locali
examples.translation: # Migra dai simulatori cloud ai simulatori locali
examples.why: Heading expanded beyond the English and now disagrees with the file's own frontmatter title "Migra ai simulatori locali"; not misleading, but an editor would align them.

examples.source: performing noisy simulations of the QPU
examples.suggested: eseguire simulazioni con rumore della QPU
examples.translation: eseguire simulazioni rumorose della QPU
examples.why: "simulazioni rumorose" is a literal calque of "noisy"; the established Italian phrasing for simulation including a noise model is "simulazioni con rumore" (or "in presenza di rumore").

examples.source: which provides higher-performance simulation that can handle larger circuits
examples.suggested: che offre una simulazione a prestazioni superiori, in grado di gestire circuiti più grandi
examples.translation: che offre una simulazione ad alte prestazioni in grado di gestire circuiti più grandi
examples.why: The comparative "higher-performance" (better than the fake backends just described) is flattened to an absolute "ad alte prestazioni", dropping the contrast the section is making.

examples.source: Moderate runtime for QPU-specific tests | Shorter runtime for a wide range of simulations
examples.suggested: Tempo di esecuzione moderato ... | Tempo di esecuzione più breve ...
examples.translation: Runtime moderato per test specifici della QPU | Runtime più breve per un'ampia gamma di simulazioni
examples.why: Here "runtime" means elapsed execution time, but left in English on a Qiskit page it reads as the product name Qiskit Runtime; "tempo di esecuzione" removes the ambiguity.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the delicate `Move` explanation (reset + SWAP, "scartando lo stato in ingresso del secondo qubit", the entanglement caveat "altrimenti, l'operazione di reset causerà il collasso parziale dello stato del resto del sistema") is rendered correctly and the informal tu register holds ("Consulta", "Nota che in Qiskit"). The defect is a glossary/casing leak: the everyday noun "circuit" is left as capitalized English "Circuit" in five places ("due Circuit a quattro qubit", "Crea un nuovo Circuit", "Crea l'osservabile da abbinare al nuovo Circuit", "dal Circuit e dall'osservabile originali") while the same paragraph writes "circuito" correctly ("Dato il circuito sopra… in modo che il circuito possa separarsi in due Circuit"); the same casing split affects "Backend", capitalized in three headings but lowercase in the prose beneath them. Separately, "full-sized circuit" becomes the calque "circuito di dimensione intera", where a native writer would say "circuito completo" or "circuito a dimensione piena". Nothing here misleads a learner — the terms remain identifiable — but an Italian technical editor would normalize all of it.

examples.source: splitting it into two four-qubit circuits … Here, we build a new circuit with one additional qubit
examples.suggested: suddividendolo in due circuiti a quattro qubit ciascuno … Qui costruiamo un nuovo circuito con un qubit aggiuntivo
examples.translation: suddividendolo in due Circuit a quattro qubit ciascuno … Qui costruiamo un nuovo Circuit con un qubit aggiuntivo
examples.why: Plain English 'circuit' is left untranslated and capitalized as if it were the Qiskit class name, while the surrounding prose in the very same paragraph uses 'circuito' correctly — an unmotivated within-file split of the most basic term in the tutorial.

examples.source: Generate the subexperiments to run on the backend / Here we are using a fake backend
examples.suggested: Genera i sottoesperimenti da eseguire sul backend / (prose already correct)
examples.translation: Genera i sottoesperimenti da eseguire sul Backend / Qui stiamo usando un backend fittizio (fake backend)
examples.why: 'Backend' is capitalized in the three section headings but lowercase in the body text directly below them; the English is lowercase everywhere outside title case, so the headings introduce a false proper-noun reading.

examples.source: To simulate the expectation value of the full-sized circuit, many subexperiments are generated
examples.suggested: Per simulare il valore atteso del circuito completo, vengono generati molti sottoesperimenti
examples.translation: Per simulare il valore atteso del circuito di dimensione intera, vengono generati molti sottoesperimenti
examples.why: 'di dimensione intera' is a word-for-word calque of 'full-sized' that reads as translationese; Italian technical prose says 'circuito completo' (or 'a dimensione piena') for the uncut, whole circuit.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift found: the After-gate/Before-measure ordering (「*ゲート*または*リセット*命令の**後**」/「*測定*命令の**前**」), the $T_2 \le 2T_1$ caveat, the qubit-order warning in "2. 特定 qubit 量子エラー", and the reset-to-1-instead-of-0 bullet all match the English exactly, and prose reads naturally. Three editorial defects remain. (1) Register slip: the last "Next steps" bullet ends 「…のリファレンスをご確認ください」 — ご-prefixed keigo, where the sibling bullet correctly uses 「参照してください」. (2) Within-file inconsistency in the qubit rendering: the error-function table and the GHZ paragraph write 「n-Qubit」 with a capital Q (lines 94–98, 353) while every other prose mention is lowercase 「単一 qubit」「全 qubit」「2 qubit ゲート」 (lines 99–103, 289–319, 397–398, 456). (3) "excited state thermal population $p_1$" is rendered 「励起状態の熱分布」 ("thermal distribution") three times in the table; the quantity is an occupation probability, so 「励起状態の熱的な占有確率（ポピュレーション）」 is the conventional term — recognizable but imprecise.

examples.source: Review the [Qiskit Aer noise module](...) reference.
examples.suggested: [Qiskit Aer ノイズモジュール](...)のリファレンスを確認してください。
examples.translation: [Qiskit Aer ノイズモジュール](...)のリファレンスをご確認ください。
examples.why: ご確認ください is ご-prefixed honorific, outside this project's plain desu/masu convention; the adjacent bullet already uses the correct 参照してください.

examples.source: an n-qubit CPTP error channel … / a single-qubit reset error …
examples.suggested: n-qubit を lowercase に統一（「n qubit CPTP エラーチャネル」）
examples.translation: 一般的な n-Qubit CPTP エラーチャネル … / 単一 qubit リセットエラー …
examples.why: The same term is capitalized 「n-Qubit」 in the table's multi-qubit rows and in the GHZ sentence, but lowercase 「qubit」 everywhere else in the file; a native editor would unify the casing.

examples.source: excited state thermal population $p_1$
examples.suggested: 励起状態の熱的な占有確率（ポピュレーション）$p_1$
examples.translation: 励起状態の熱分布 $p_1$
examples.why: 熱分布 means 'thermal distribution'; $p_1$ is the occupation probability (population) of the excited state, so the chosen word names a related but different quantity — recognizable in context, not misleading.

editor_note: An entire source paragraph is missing: the EN sentence that introduces Step 2's partitioning step and gives the only definition of "subobservable" ("Now the circuit can be partitioned along the `Move` gate and we obtain the subcircuits, as well as the subobservable, which is the portion of the original observable associated with each subcircuit.") has no Japanese counterpart — the JA text jumps straight from the `new_obs` output block to the bare `partition_problem(...)` code cell, so the reader meets `subobservables` with no lead-in and no explanation, and the term is never defined anywhere else in the file (grep for オブザーバブル finds only lines 170/172/218). Terminology is otherwise correct and consistent (qubit→キュービット, observable→オブザーバブル, expectation value→期待値, transpile→トランスパイル, backend→バックエンド, Pauli basis→パウリ基底, mixed state→混合状態, wire cutting→ワイヤカッティング), so the fix is narrow: restore the dropped paragraph. Two secondary items: honorific slips against the no-keigo convention (「ご確認ください」 line 38, 「ご参照ください」 line 227 — plain 「確認してください」/「参照してください」 is the house style), and one calqued, back-to-front sentence at line 138 that a native technical writer would rewrite.

examples.source: Now the circuit can be partitioned along the `Move` gate and we obtain the subcircuits, as well as the subobservable, which is the portion of the original observable associated with each subcircuit.
examples.suggested: これで回路を `Move` ゲートに沿って分割でき、サブ回路と、各サブ回路に対応する元のオブザーバブルの一部であるサブオブザーバブルが得られます。
examples.translation: (missing — no Japanese sentence exists; the JA file goes directly from the ```text new_obs output to the ```python partition_problem code cell)
examples.why: A whole explanatory paragraph is dropped. It is the section's only definition of subobservable and the only lead-in to the partitioning step, so the Japanese learner is handed `subobservables = partitioned_problem.subobservables` with nothing telling them what that object is or why the circuit is being split here — the teaching content of Step 2 is materially lost.

examples.source: Before starting this tutorial, be sure you have the following installed: / Find more detail in this paper.
examples.suggested: 以下がインストールされていることを確認してください： / 詳細は[こちらの論文](...)を参照してください。
examples.translation: 以下がインストールされていることをご確認ください： / 詳細は[こちらの論文](...)をご参照ください。
examples.why: 「ご確認ください」「ご参照ください」 are honorific (keigo) forms; the file's convention is plain polite desu/masu without keigo, which the rest of the document holds to (e.g. 「注意してください」 at line 78, 172).

examples.source: Since the ideal expectation value of ⟨Z_i⟩ = 1 ∀ i, the ideal expectation value of O is also 1.
examples.suggested: すべての $i$ について $\langle Z_i \rangle$ の理想的な期待値が $1$ であることから、$O$ の理想的な期待値も $1$ になります。
examples.translation: $\langle Z_i \rangle = 1$ $\forall$ $i$ の理想的な期待値より、$O$ の理想的な期待値も $1$ となります。
examples.why: The noun-stacked 「⟨Z_i⟩ = 1 ∀ i の理想的な期待値より」 reads as a calque of the English 'Since the ideal expectation value of ⟨Z_i⟩ = 1' — the math is glued in front of 理想的な期待値 instead of being predicated on it, which a native technical writer would never phrase this way. Meaning survives, but the sentence is momentarily hard to parse.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no semantic drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; the SVM primal/dual contrast, the kernel-trick explanation, the "measurements are the source of non-linearity" point and the Pérez-Salinas single-qubit quote all land exactly as in the English, and register (합니다체 with occasional 해요체, e.g. "참고해 주세요") is the correct Korean technical-doc convention. The one real defect is a glossary leak: "circuit" is left as the English capitalized word inside Korean sentences roughly 14 times ("양자 Circuit", "변분 양자 Circuit"(VQC), "결과 Circuit", "동적 Circuit", "가중치 Circuit"), and "qubit" likewise ("qubit 부분 추적", "단일 Qubit") — where standard Korean is 양자 회로 and 큐비트. Worse, the file splits itself: the Quantum-perceptron paragraph writes "회로 중간 측정(mid-circuit measurement)" and "동적 Circuit" in the same sentence, so 회로 and Circuit denote the same concept two lines apart. Secondary: two image alt texts (the QNN-as-circuit figure and the VQC-layers figure) are left in English while every other alt text in the file is translated, and "primal formulation" is rendered "원초 공식", where 공식 reads as "formula" rather than "formulation" (원초 형식/원 문제 is the usual pairing with the correct 쌍대). None of these would mislead a learner — the concepts stay identifiable — but a native technical editor would fix all three.

examples.source: Other considerations include quantum Fourier transform based methods, mid-circuit measurements or dynamic circuits, and tracing qubits out of the circuit.
examples.suggested: 그 밖에도 양자 푸리에 변환 기반 방법, 회로 중간 측정(mid-circuit measurement) 또는 동적 회로, 큐비트 부분 대각합(tracing qubits out) 등의 방법이 있습니다.
examples.translation: 그 밖에도 양자 푸리에 변환 기반 방법, 회로 중간 측정(mid-circuit measurement) 또는 동적 Circuit, qubit 부분 추적(tracing qubits out) 등의 방법이 있습니다.
examples.why: Within one sentence the same concept appears as both 회로 and English "Circuit", and "qubit" is left untranslated. Standard Korean is 양자 회로 / 큐비트; the English words dropped into Korean prose read as an unlocalized glossary leak, not as a deliberate keep-in-English convention (the rest of the file localizes 신경망, 가중치, 편향, 커널).

examples.source: “a single qubit provides sufficient computational capabilities to construct a universal quantum classifier when assisted with a classical subroutine.”
examples.suggested: "단일 큐비트가 고전 서브루틴의 도움을 받아 범용 양자 분류기를 구성하는 데 충분한 계산 능력을 제공한다"
examples.translation: "단일 Qubit이 고전 서브루틴의 도움을 받아 범용 양자 분류기를 구성하는 데 충분한 계산 능력을 제공한다"
examples.why: Capitalized "Qubit" mid-Korean-sentence inside a quoted paper result; 큐비트 is the universal Korean rendering and the particle 이/가 attaches awkwardly to the Latin-script word.

examples.source: ![A representation of a quantum neural network as a circuit.] / ![A diagram showing several layers of gates within a quantum neural network]
examples.suggested: ![양자 신경망을 회로로 나타낸 표현.] / ![양자 신경망 내부의 여러 게이트 층을 보여주는 다이어그램]
examples.translation: ![A representation of a quantum neural network as a circuit.] / ![A diagram showing several layers of gates within a quantum neural network]
examples.why: Every other descriptive alt text in the file is translated (lines 25, 33, 40, 66, 106); these two were skipped, leaving English screen-reader text in a Korean page.

examples.source: This is what we call the “primal formulation”. ... We call this the "dual formulation"
examples.suggested: 이를 "원초 형식(primal formulation)"이라고 합니다. ... 이를 "쌍대 형식(dual formulation)"이라 하며
examples.translation: 이를 "원초 공식(primal formulation)"이라고 합니다. ... 이를 "쌍대 공식(dual formulation)"이라 하며
examples.why: 쌍대 is correct, but 공식 in Korean means "formula" (a specific equation), not "formulation" (a way of posing the problem); 형식/정식화 or 원 문제·쌍대 문제 is the standard optimization-textbook pairing. Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native editor would change it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the win conditions (a=b for (0,0)/(0,1)/(1,0), a≠b for (1,1)), the 3/4 classical bound, the (2+√2)/4 ≈ 0.85 quantum value, Tsirelson's inequality and the 2022 Nobel paragraph all match the English, and the register is consistently the standard -습니다 documentation style. The defects are terminological/stylistic: English glossary nouns are dropped raw into Korean prose with inconsistent casing — "양자 Circuit 다이어그램", "제어 Gate", and "qubit" (lines 137, 249, 295) vs "Qubit" (lines 286, 494, 433) — where a Korean technical writer would write 양자 회로 / 제어 게이트 / 큐비트. "Entanglement" is 얽힘 everywhere except one stray "엉킴(얽힘)" (line 59), and "entangled quantum state" becomes the noun-stacked "얽힘 양자 상태" instead of "얽힌 양자 상태" (line 128). Two calques remain: "effectively" is rendered correctly as 실질적으로 at line 494 but as the false-friend 효과적으로 ("with good effect") at line 512, and line 93's "그 중 어느 것도 … 진다" uses the negative-polarity quantifier 어느 것도 with an affirmative predicate, which reads ungrammatically (native: "그 중 어느 것이든 … 진다"). None of these reverses a claim, so a learner is not misled.

examples.source: Here is a quantum circuit diagram that describes this strategy. … In this diagram we see two ordinary controlled gates
examples.suggested: 다음은 이 전략을 설명하는 양자 회로 다이어그램입니다. … 이 다이어그램에서 일반적인 제어 게이트 두 개를 볼 수 있습니다.
examples.translation: 다음은 이 전략을 설명하는 양자 Circuit 다이어그램입니다. … 이 다이어그램에서 일반적인 제어 Gate 두 개를 볼 수 있습니다.
examples.why: Raw capitalized English nouns (Circuit, Gate) inside Korean prose read as glossary leakage; 회로/게이트 are the settled Korean domain terms. Compounded by qubit/Qubit casing splitting within the same file (lines 137, 249 lowercase vs 286, 433, 494 capitalized).

examples.source: there are some nonlocal games for which it's currently not known how well Alice and Bob can play using entanglement
examples.suggested: 얽힘을 사용했을 때 Alice와 Bob이 얼마나 잘 플레이할 수 있는지 현재까지 알려지지 않은 비국소 게임들도 있습니다.
examples.translation: 엉킴(얽힘)을 사용했을 때 Alice와 Bob이 얼마나 잘 플레이할 수 있는지 현재까지 알려지지 않은 비국소 게임들도 있습니다.
examples.why: Sole occurrence of 엉킴 for entanglement; every other instance in the file (lines 128, 133, 644, 651, 652) uses the standard 얽힘. The parenthetical gloss shows the translator hesitating over an already-settled term.

examples.source: By choosing α, Alice effectively defines an orthonormal basis of vectors that looks like this
examples.suggested: Alice는 $\alpha$를 선택함으로써 사실상 다음과 같은 정규직교 기저를 정의하는 셈입니다.
examples.translation: Alice는 $\alpha$를 선택함으로써 다음과 같이 생긴 정규직교 기저 벡터들을 효과적으로 정의합니다.
examples.why: 'effectively' here means 'in effect', not 'efficiently'; 효과적으로 is the false friend. Line 494 renders the same word correctly as '실질적으로 하는 일은', so the file contradicts itself.

examples.source: go one-by-one through all of the possible deterministic strategies and check that every one of them loses for at least one of the four possible question pairs
examples.suggested: 모든 가능한 결정론적 전략을 하나씩 검토하여, 그 중 어느 것이든 네 가지 가능한 질문 쌍 중 적어도 하나에서는 진다는 것을 확인하는 것입니다.
examples.translation: 모든 가능한 결정론적 전략을 하나씩 검토하여, 그 중 어느 것도 네 가지 가능한 질문 쌍 중 적어도 하나에서는 진다는 것을 확인하는 것입니다.
examples.why: 어느 것도 is a negative-polarity quantifier and requires a negated predicate; paired with the affirmative 진다 it is ungrammatical and briefly invites the opposite reading ('none of them loses'). The following clause disambiguates, so it does not mislead, but a native editor would rewrite it.

examples.source: if they share an entangled quantum state as the following figure suggests
examples.suggested: … 준비해 둔 얽힌 양자 상태를 공유하고 있다면
examples.translation: 특히 다음 그림처럼 그들이 게임을 시작하기 전에 준비해 둔 얽힘 양자 상태를 공유하고 있다면
examples.why: 'entangled' is adjectival; 얽힘 양자 상태 stacks the noun 얽힘 directly onto 양자 상태, which reads as translationese. The correct attributive form 얽힌 is used elsewhere ('얽힌 광자', line 652).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the physics teaches correctly (JW relations, Schwinger Hamiltonian, tetrahedral-lattice encoding, "lembu berbentuk sfera" analogy all land), but a native technical editor would change several word choices. Two stand out: "one-to-one correspondence" is rendered "surat-menyurat satu-ke-satu" — the false friend for letter-writing correspondence, not mathematical kesepadanan — and the protein-folding "turn" is rendered "giliran" (a turn in a queue/rotation) about six times instead of a directional belokan/pusingan, so "Keadaan qubit menunjukkan 'giliran' protein pada setiap tapak kekisi" reads as turn-taking rather than a fold direction. Mathematical "continuous" is "berterusan" (ongoing) rather than "selanjar", and "discretize" is the coinage "mendiskreasikan"; "fermionic" is consistently misspelled "fermonik" while "bosonik" is spelled correctly in the same paragraph. The cutoff sentence drops "below which" ("jarak potongan di mana anda menganggap pasangan berinteraksi"), losing the direction of the inequality, and the frontmatter description turns "nature simulation problems" into "masalah simulasi alam semesta" (universe simulation). Residual calques: "tidak dipegang" for "does not hold", "yang asli kepada komputer kuantum" for "native to", "rakan sekerja" for "collaborators", "terus lari dengannya" for "run with it". None of these would make a learner believe something false about the physics.

examples.source: The Jordan-Wigner mapping is conceptually simple because of the one-to-one correspondence between orbitals and qubits.
examples.suggested: ... kerana kesepadanan satu-ke-satu antara orbital dan qubit.
examples.translation: Pemetaan Jordan-Wigner adalah mudah secara konseptual kerana surat-menyurat satu-ke-satu antara orbital dan qubit.
examples.why: 'surat-menyurat' is correspondence in the sense of exchanging letters — a classic false friend. The mathematical sense is 'kesepadanan' (or 'hubungan satu-dengan-satu'); as written the clause is semi-nonsensical to a Malay reader.

examples.source: The protein chain is represented as a series of turns or directions on this lattice. ... the states of the qubits indicate the "turn" of the protein at each lattice site
examples.suggested: ... satu siri belokan (atau arah) pada kekisi ini. ... menunjukkan "belokan" protein pada setiap tapak kekisi
examples.translation: Rantai protein diwakili sebagai satu siri giliran atau arah pada kekisi ini. ... Keadaan qubit menunjukkan "giliran" protein pada setiap tapak kekisi
examples.why: 'giliran' means a turn in a rotation/queue, not a change of direction in space. Used consistently ~6 times (also 'bilangan giliran berlabel a', 'dua giliran pertama'), so the geometric idea is only recoverable from the adjacent 'arah' and 'tepi tetrahedron'.

examples.source: Is our problem continuous? Since quantum computers are digital, if the problem is continuous, we will need to find a way to discretize it.
examples.suggested: Adakah masalah kita selanjar? ... kita perlu mencari cara untuk mendiskretkannya.
examples.translation: Adakah masalah kita berterusan? Oleh kerana komputer kuantum adalah digital, jika masalahnya adalah berterusan, kita perlu mencari cara untuk mendiskreasikannya.
examples.why: 'berterusan' is continuous in the temporal sense (ongoing/uninterrupted); the mathematical antonym of discrete is 'selanjar'. 'mendiskreasikan' is a non-standard coinage (also 'kepingan ruang yang didiskreasi' later) where 'mendiskretkan' is the accepted form.

examples.source: we might dictate a cutoff distance below which you consider the pair to be interacting
examples.suggested: kita mungkin menetapkan jarak had (cutoff) yang di bawahnya pasangan itu dianggap berinteraksi
examples.translation: kita mungkin menetapkan jarak potongan di mana anda menganggap pasangan berinteraksi
examples.why: 'below which' is dropped, so the defining condition of the cutoff disappears — the Malay only says a distance 'at which' the pair counts as interacting. Also 'jarak potongan' reads as a cut/discount rather than a threshold.

examples.source: fermionic systems / fermionic operators / fermionic encoding
examples.suggested: sistem fermionik / operator fermionik / pengekodan fermionik
examples.translation: sistem fermonik / operator fermonik / pengekodan fermonik
examples.why: 'fermonik' is a consistent misspelling of 'fermionik' (the i of fermion is lost), and it sits beside a correctly spelled 'bosonik' in the same paragraph, making the pairing look inconsistent.

examples.source: This isn't something anyone can just pick up and run with from the start
examples.suggested: Ini bukan sesuatu yang boleh dikuasai sesiapa sahaja serta-merta dari awal
examples.translation: Ini bukan sesuatu yang sesiapa pun boleh hanya ambil dan terus lari dengannya dari awal
examples.why: 'ambil dan terus lari dengannya' is a word-for-word calque of the English idiom and reads as physically running away with something; the encouraging closing tone of the paragraph flattens into odd phrasing.

editor_note: The core term "observable" is rendered throughout (8 times, including the section heading "## Boleh-cela Pauli untuk kod pengulangan") as **"boleh-cela"**, which in Malay means "blameworthy / open to reproach" (root *cela* = fault, blemish) — it has no connection to observation. The correct and established convention in this very locale is **"boleh cerap" / "boleh-cerap"** (root *cerap* = to observe), used in every other ms file (e.g. quantum-machine-learning/qvc-qnn.mdx, quantum-kernel-methods.mdx, programming-models.mdx); this file is the only one in i18n/ms using "boleh-cela". In a lesson whose whole subject is *ralat* (errors) and fault detection, telling the learner to "view the two Pauli operations as boleh-cela" actively invites the reading "as faulty/defective things" rather than "as observables", so the central object of the stabilizer measurement is misnamed with a plausible-but-wrong meaning. Secondary, non-misleading points: "bit-flip" is calqued as "balik-bit" (native form would be "pembalikan bit"); "qubit" is randomly capitalised mid-compound as "3-Qubit"/"satu-Qubit" (6 times) against lowercase "qubit" elsewhere; and line 21 drops "state" from "a valid 3-qubit encoding of a qubit *state*". The mathematical content (commute/anti-commute, ±1 eigenvalues, parity arguments, syndrome partitions) is otherwise faithful and accurate.

examples.source: ## Pauli observables for the repetition code
examples.suggested: ## Boleh-cerap Pauli untuk kod pengulangan
examples.translation: ## Boleh-cela Pauli untuk kod pengulangan
examples.why: "boleh-cela" means "blameworthy/reproachable" (cela = fault, blemish), not "observable". The whole ms corpus uses "boleh cerap"/"boleh-cerap" (cerap = observe); this is the only ms file using "cela". In an error-correction lesson the wrong root reads as "faulty", so the learner is taught a false name and a false connotation for the central concept.

examples.source: if we view the two Pauli operations ... as observables, and measure both using the circuits suggested at the end of the previous section
examples.suggested: jika kita melihat dua operasi Pauli ... sebagai boleh-cerap, dan mengukur kedua-duanya menggunakan litar yang dicadangkan di hujung bahagian sebelumnya
examples.translation: jika kita melihat dua operasi Pauli ... sebagai boleh-cela, dan mengukur kedua-duanya menggunakan litar yang dicadangkan di akhir bahagian sebelumnya
examples.why: Reads as "view the two Pauli operations as faulty/blameworthy" — the opposite of the pedagogical point, which is that these operations are the measurement observables whose +1 outcomes certify a clean encoding.

examples.source: bit-flip detection for the 3-bit repetition code ... a bit-flip error occurs on the leftmost qubit
