examples.suggested: pengesanan pembalikan bit ... ralat pembalikan bit berlaku pada qubit paling kiri
examples.translation: pengesanan balik-bit untuk kod pengulangan 3-bit ... ralat balik-bit berlaku pada qubit paling kiri
examples.why: "balik-bit" keeps English compound order and is not idiomatic Malay; a native technical writer would write "pembalikan bit" (or "ralat balikan bit"). Recognizable, so not misleading — but a calque.

examples.source: a valid 3-qubit encoding of a qubit state / The 3-qubit Pauli operations
examples.suggested: pengekodan 3-qubit yang sah bagi suatu keadaan qubit / Operasi Pauli 3-qubit
examples.translation: pengekodan qubit 3-Qubit yang sah / Operasi Pauli 3-Qubit
examples.why: "qubit" is inconsistently capitalised as "3-Qubit"/"satu-Qubit" (6 occurrences) against lowercase "qubit" used everywhere else in the same file; the line-21 phrasing also drops "state" from "encoding of a qubit state", leaving the awkward "pengekodan qubit 3-Qubit".

examples.source: The two equations above therefore imply that ... / this is a phenomenon that generalizes to all stabilizer codes
examples.suggested: Oleh itu, dua persamaan di atas menunjukkan bahawa ... / ini ialah fenomena yang boleh digeneralisasikan kepada semua kod penstabil
examples.translation: Dua persamaan di atas oleh itu menyiratkan bahawa ... / ini adalah fenomena yang digeneralisasikan kepada semua kod penstabil
examples.why: "menyiratkan" is Indonesian-flavoured (Malay: "menunjukkan"/"bermakna"), and "oleh itu" is stranded mid-sentence in English word order. "digeneralisasikan" is a bare passive ("is generalized") where the English is an intransitive property of the phenomenon.

editor_note: The lesson's closing punchline is missing entirely: the English ends with two sentences, and the Polish keeps only "Podsumowując, algorytm Simona daje nam uderzającą przewagę... w modelu z wyroczną." — the whole final sentence contrasting a *linear* number of queries for the quantum algorithm against an *exponential* number for any classical (even probabilistic) one is dropped, so the learner finishes the page without the quantitative result the entire analysis was building toward. The "Algorithm description" section is also partly untranslated and ungrammatical: "Oto diagram kwantowego Circuit", "przy użyciu tego obwód... po przeanalizowaniu zachowania Circuit", "Gate'y Hadamarda", plus bare "Hadamard gates" twice in the Analysis section — the concept "bramka/obwód" is split across English leaks, a Polish suffix graft, and correct "bramki zapytania"/"układu kwantowego" in the same file. "range(f)" is rendered "*dziedzina obrazu*", a coinage that fronts "dziedzina" (= domain, the opposite concept) where Polish uses "zbiór wartości"/"obraz". Smaller: two H2 headings left in English ("## Simon's problem", "## Algorithm description"); "wyrocznia" is consistently mis-inflected as "z wyroczną" (should be "z wyrocznią"); "dwa-do-jednego" vs "dwu-do-jednego"; "obietnica" silently becomes "założeniem problemu Simona" at one point.

examples.source: So, in summary, Simon's algorithm provides us with a striking advantage of quantum over classical algorithms within the query model. In particular, Simon's algorithm solves Simon's problem with a number of queries that's *linear* in the number of input bits $n$ of our function, whereas any classical algorithm, even if it's probabilistic, needs to make a number of queries that's *exponential* in $n$ in order to solve Simon's problem with a reasonable probability of success.
examples.suggested: …w modelu zapytań. W szczególności algorytm Simona rozwiązuje problem Simona przy liczbie zapytań *liniowej* względem liczby bitów wejściowych $n$ naszej funkcji, podczas gdy dowolny algorytm klasyczny, nawet probabilistyczny, musi wykonać liczbę zapytań *wykładniczą* względem $n$, aby rozwiązać problem Simona z rozsądnym prawdopodobieństwem sukcesu.
examples.translation: Podsumowując, algorytm Simona daje nam uderzającą przewagę algorytmów kwantowych nad klasycznymi w modelu z wyroczną.
examples.why: The entire concluding sentence is missing. It carries the lesson's central quantitative claim (linear vs exponential query count); without it the reader is left with a vague 'striking advantage' and no statement of what the separation actually is.

examples.source: Here's a quantum circuit diagram representing Simon's algorithm. … To solve Simon's problem using this circuit will actually require several independent runs of it … after the behavior of the circuit is analyzed.
examples.suggested: Oto diagram obwodu kwantowego reprezentującego algorytm Simona. … Rozwiązanie problemu Simona przy użyciu tego obwodu … po przeanalizowaniu zachowania obwodu.
examples.translation: Oto diagram kwantowego Circuit reprezentującego algorytm Simona. … Rozwiązanie problemu Simona przy użyciu tego obwód wymaga w praktyce kilku niezależnych jego uruchomień … po przeanalizowaniu zachowania Circuit.
examples.why: Untranslated English 'Circuit' left inline twice, and 'tego obwód' is an uninflected fragment that is not grammatical Polish. The same concept appears correctly as 'układu kwantowego' in the post-processing section, so 'obwód'/'układ'/'Circuit' are three renderings of one term in one file.

examples.source: there are $n$ qubits on the top that are acted upon by Hadamard gates … After the first layer of Hadamard gates is performed … using the same formula for the action of a layer of Hadamard gates as before
examples.suggested: na które działają bramki Hadamarda … Po wykonaniu pierwszej warstwy bramek Hadamarda … wzoru na działanie warstwy bramek Hadamarda
examples.translation: na które działają Gate'y Hadamarda … Po wykonaniu pierwszej warstwy Hadamard gates … korzystając z tego samego wzoru na działanie warstwy Hadamard gates co poprzednio
examples.why: 'gate' is the standard Polish 'bramka' and is used correctly in the very same paragraph ('bramki zapytania'), yet here it appears as the graft 'Gate'y Hadamarda' and twice as bare English 'Hadamard gates'.

examples.source: First, the *range* of the function $f$ is the set containing all of its output strings.
examples.suggested: Po pierwsze, *zbiór wartości* (obraz) funkcji $f$ to zbiór zawierający wszystkie jej ciągi wyjściowe.
examples.translation: Po pierwsze, *dziedzina obrazu* funkcji $f$ to zbiór zawierający wszystkie jej ciągi wyjściowe.
examples.why: 'dziedzina obrazu' is not a Polish mathematical term and leads with 'dziedzina', which denotes the domain — the opposite set from range. The following formula rescues it, but the label itself points the reader at the wrong concept.

examples.source: How many queries does a *classical* query algorithm need … If we have any probabilistic query algorithm … within the query model.
examples.suggested: …*klasyczny* algorytm zapytań … dowolny probabilistyczny algorytm zapytań … w modelu zapytań.
examples.translation: Ile zapytań potrzebuje *klasyczny* algorytm z wyroczną … Jeśli mamy dowolny probabilistyczny algorytm z wyroczną … w modelu z wyroczną.
examples.why: The opening paragraph establishes 'kwantowy algorytm zapytań'; the closing section silently switches the same term to 'algorytm z wyroczną' (oracle algorithm). On top of that, the instrumental of 'wyrocznia' is mis-spelled 'wyroczną' (should be 'wyrocznią') in all three places.

examples.source: The set $f^{-1}(\{z\})$ is known as the *preimage* of $\{z\}$ under $f.$ We can define the preimage under $f$ of any set in place of $\{z\}$ in an analogous way
examples.suggested: …nazywany *przeciwobrazem* zbioru $\{z\}$ względem $f$ (przy odwzorowaniu $f$). Analogicznie możemy zdefiniować przeciwobraz względem $f$ dowolnego zbioru…
examples.translation: Zbiór $f^{-1}(\{z\})$ jest nazywany *przeciwobrazem* $\{z\}$ pod $f.$ Analogicznie możemy zdefiniować przeciwobraz pod $f$ dowolnego zbioru zamiast $\{z\}$
examples.why: 'pod $f$' is a word-for-word calque of English 'under $f$'; Polish mathematical usage is 'względem $f$' or 'przy odwzorowaniu $f$'. A Polish author would never write 'przeciwobraz pod f'.

editor_note: The body prose is faithful, but the frontmatter carries stale content from an older EN revision and makes a claim the current source does not: `description` reads "Przechowuj obiekty Qiskit na dysku **lub w chmurze**" while EN says only "Store Qiskit objects to disk" — nothing on this page involves cloud storage (it is a QPY-to-local-file guide), so a learner is told a capability that is not taught here. The `title`/`sidebar_label` likewise drift to "Zapisywanie i pobieranie obiektów Qiskit" instead of "Zapisywanie obwodów na dysku", broadening the page's scope beyond "Save circuits to disk". Separately, "circuit" is split within the file: the untranslated glossary leak "Circuit" appears five times ("zapisać swój Circuit", "prosty Circuit kwantowy", "listę Circuit", "wczytać Circuit") alongside the correct Polish "obwód" in the same paragraph ("Ten obwód jest teraz zapisany… tylko jeden obwód"); "listę Circuit" is also ungrammatical (undeclined English noun) and reads as raw glossary substitution. Fix: restore the frontmatter to the current EN scope (drop "lub w chmurze") and normalize every "Circuit" to "obwód"/"obwód kwantowy" except where it names the `QuantumCircuit` class.

examples.source: description: "Store Qiskit objects to disk so you can continue where you left off"
examples.suggested: description: "Przechowuj obiekty Qiskit na dysku, aby móc kontynuować pracę od miejsca, w którym skończyłeś"
examples.translation: description: "Przechowuj obiekty Qiskit na dysku lub w chmurze, aby móc kontynuować pracę od miejsca, w którym skończyłeś"
examples.why: "lub w chmurze" is not in the English and is not supported anywhere on the page — the guide only covers QPY serialization to a local file. It is a leftover from an older EN revision and promises a capability the learner will not find here.

examples.source: title: "Save circuits to disk" / sidebar_label: "Save circuits to disk"
examples.suggested: title: "Zapisywanie obwodów na dysku" / sidebar_label: "Zapisywanie obwodów na dysku"
examples.translation: title: "Zapisywanie i pobieranie obiektów Qiskit" / sidebar_label: "Zapisywanie i pobieranie obiektów Qiskit"
examples.why: Title and sidebar label are stale relative to the current source: they widen the topic from "circuits to disk" to "Qiskit objects" generally, matching the superseded EN page rather than this one.

examples.source: save your circuit to file … the full Qiskit circuit object … a simple quantum circuit … a list of circuits … re-load the circuit
examples.suggested: zapisać swój obwód do pliku … pełny obiekt obwodu Qiskit … prosty obwód kwantowy … listę obwodów … ponownie wczytać obwód
examples.translation: zapisać swój Circuit do pliku … pełny obiekt Circuit Qiskit … prosty Circuit kwantowy … listę Circuit … wczytać Circuit
examples.why: Untranslated glossary leak: the standard Polish term is "obwód (kwantowy)", and the file itself uses it twice in the same paragraph ("Ten obwód jest teraz zapisany…", "tylko jeden obwód"). The English noun also refuses to decline — "listę Circuit" is ungrammatical Polish and reads as raw substitution.

examples.source: Note that this always returns a list of circuits, even if you only serialized one circuit.
examples.suggested: Pamiętaj, że ta funkcja zawsze zwraca listę obwodów, nawet jeśli zserializowałeś tylko jeden obwód.
examples.translation: Pamiętaj, że ta funkcja zawsze zwraca listę Circuit, nawet jeśli zserializowałeś tylko jeden obwód.
examples.why: Same sentence contains both renderings of "circuit", so the split is visible to the reader in a single line; the mixed form blunts the point that one serialized obwód still comes back inside a list.

editor_note: Terminology and register are solid overall — qubit, Hamiltoniano, ansatz (kept in English, correctly), portas SWAP, transpilação, operadores de Pauli, estado fundamental, criação/aniquilação, base computacional are all conventional and consistent, and the informal "você / eu te encorajo" convention holds throughout. Three concrete defects remain: (1) an untranslated English word left in the prose — "podemos hopefully encontrar melhores resultados na pesquisa médica" (line 130); (2) a garbled, ungrammatical sentence at line 71, "As três escolhas resultariam em termos dois seguimentos com um ângulo de aproximadamente 109,5 graus", which calques "result in our having" as "resultariam em termos" and renders "edges" as "seguimentos" even though the same paragraph and the rest of the file correctly use "arestas"; (3) "valor de expectativa" (line 19) for "expectation value" where the established Portuguese term is "valor esperado". Two smaller stiffnesses: "a estratégia exata … elas geralmente realizam" (line 28) carries the English plural "they" onto a singular subject, and "adjacentes na cadeia principal da cadeia" (line 81) is a redundant literal rendering of "backbone of the chain". None of these invert meaning or teach a false concept, so this does not mislead a learner — but a native technical editor would fix all five.

examples.source: By simulating how they bend and fold we can hopefully find better outcomes in medical research.
examples.suggested: Ao simular como eles se dobram e se curvam, podemos, com sorte, encontrar melhores resultados na pesquisa médica.
examples.translation: Ao simular como eles dobram e se curvam, podemos hopefully encontrar melhores resultados na pesquisa médica.
examples.why: The English adverb "hopefully" was left untranslated inside otherwise Portuguese prose — a raw MT leak that a native writer would never produce.

examples.source: All three choices would result in our having two edges with an angle of approximately 109.5 degrees between them.
examples.suggested: Qualquer uma das três escolhas resultaria em duas arestas com um ângulo de aproximadamente 109,5 graus entre elas.
examples.translation: As três escolhas resultariam em termos dois seguimentos com um ângulo de aproximadamente 109,5 graus entre eles.
examples.why: "resultariam em termos" is an unparseable calque of "result in our having", and "seguimentos" is both a malformed word and inconsistent with "arestas", the rendering of "edges" used everywhere else in the same paragraph.

examples.source: ...into a cost function or expectation value that we can evaluate using a quantum computer.
examples.suggested: ...em uma função de custo ou valor esperado que podemos avaliar usando um computador quântico.
examples.translation: ...em uma função de custo ou valor de expectativa que podemos avaliar usando um computador quântico.
examples.why: "expectation value" is conventionally "valor esperado" in Portuguese quantum-computing writing; "valor de expectativa" is a recognizable but non-standard calque.

examples.source: While the exact strategy one uses to map a problem to a quantum computer depends on the problem at hand, they generally accomplish a couple main things.
examples.suggested: Embora a estratégia exata usada para mapear um problema em um computador quântico dependa do problema em questão, essas estratégias geralmente cumprem algumas funções principais.
examples.translation: Embora a estratégia exata usada para mapear um problema a um computador quântico dependa do problema em questão, elas geralmente realizam algumas coisas principais.
examples.why: The plural pronoun "elas" is carried over from the English "they" but has no plural antecedent in the Portuguese sentence ("a estratégia" is singular), leaving a visible agreement break.

examples.source: Obviously, amino acids that are adjacent in the backbone of the chain will always interact with each other.
examples.suggested: Obviamente, os aminoácidos adjacentes na cadeia principal sempre interagirão entre si.
examples.translation: Obviamente, os aminoácidos que são adjacentes na cadeia principal da cadeia sempre interagirão uns com os outros.
examples.why: "na cadeia principal da cadeia" repeats "cadeia" because "backbone" and "chain" were both translated literally; a native technical writer would just say "na cadeia principal".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, and the tricky conditional in the Flex/Premium sections ("marcada como 'limitada'… as cargas de trabalho pendentes permanecerão na fila" vs. "não for limitada… menor prioridade e filas mais longas") is rendered correctly in both copies; register is consistently informal "você". What a native editor would still change: step 2 of "Criar uma instância" reads "No painel, no painel de Instâncias" — "painel" is used twice in five words for two different things (dashboard vs. pane), which is clumsy and momentarily confusing. UI-label policy is inconsistent: almost every interface string is kept in English ("View all", "Create instance", "Remaining", "Archive", "Edit details"), but the "Pending workloads" column is translated to "Cargas de trabalho pendentes", so a reader hunting for that column on the page has nothing to match. Two smaller stiffness points: "toggle" flattened to "botão" (loses the on/off-switch sense the instruction depends on) and "certifique-se de que tem a conta… correta" / "às quais você está atribuído", both subject-dropped, slightly European-flavored constructions where a Brazilian technical writer would write "certifique-se de ter" and "às quais você foi atribuído".

examples.source: From the dashboard Instances pane, click **View all**, or go to the Instances page from the main menu.
examples.suggested: No bloco de Instâncias do painel, clique em **View all**, ou acesse a página [Instances] pelo menu principal.
examples.translation: No painel, no painel de Instâncias, clique em **View all**, ou acesse a página [Instances] pelo menu principal.
examples.why: "No painel, no painel de" repeats the same noun for two different UI objects (dashboard and pane) in one clause — no native technical writer would leave this; it reads as word-by-word MT and briefly obscures where the user should click.

examples.source: The Pending workloads column on the Instances table shows the number of workloads currently queued...
examples.suggested: A coluna Pending workloads (Cargas de trabalho pendentes) na tabela de Instâncias...
examples.translation: A coluna Cargas de trabalho pendentes na tabela de Instâncias mostra o número de cargas de trabalho atualmente na fila...
examples.why: Every other UI string in the file is deliberately kept in English (View all, Create instance, Remaining, Archive instance, Edit details); translating only this column label breaks the file's own convention and leaves the reader with a name that does not appear in the interface.

examples.source: Click the "Customize allocated compute resources" toggle.
examples.suggested: Clique no botão de alternância (toggle) "Customize allocated compute resources".
examples.translation: Clique no botão "Customize allocated compute resources".
examples.why: "botão" loses the toggle/switch semantics; the step is about flipping a state on, and the generic "botão" makes the control harder to identify on screen. Recognizable but imprecise.

examples.source: first ensure you have the correct account and region selected in the account switcher in the header.
examples.suggested: primeiro certifique-se de ter a conta e a região corretas selecionadas no seletor de contas no cabeçalho.
examples.translation: primeiro certifique-se de que tem a conta e a região corretas selecionadas no seletor de contas no cabeçalho.
examples.why: Subject-dropped "de que tem" is a European-Portuguese-flavored construction that clashes with the otherwise Brazilian, explicit-"você" register used across the file (e.g. "Você pode ter (ou fazer parte de) várias contas"). Same stiffness in "às quais você está atribuído" for "to which you are assigned".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — nothing here would mislead a learner — but the file carries visible glossary-substitution artifacts a native technical editor would fix. "circuit" is rendered as the non-Romanian hyphenated, mid-sentence-capitalized "Circuit-urile / Circuit-ului / Circuit-urilor" six times (lines 14, 33, 38, 45, 52, 54) against a lowercase "circuit-uri" in the same sentence on line 54; correct Romanian is simply "circuitele / circuitului / circuite". The same mechanism produced the malformed "milioane de poartă-uri" (line 52) where the plural of "poartă" is "porți". Beyond that there are English-syntax calques ("detaliază ideile cheie din față" for "the key ideas ahead", line 24; "nu este așteptată să fie viabilă" for "is not expected to be viable", line 40; "simularea clasică forțată" for "brute-force simulation", line 18) and a slightly garbled qLDPC expansion, "coduri … de joasă densitate de paritate" (line 40), which drops the "check/verificare" element. Core domain terms are otherwise correct and consistent: "diminuarea erorilor" (error mitigation) vs "suprimarea erorilor" (error suppression), "qubiți logici", "toleranța la erori", "eșantionare"; register is correctly informal/first-person plural with no dumneavoastră slips.

examples.source: designed to deliver large-scale, fault-tolerant computation with millions of gates and thousands of logical qubits
examples.suggested: … cu milioane de porți și mii de qubiți logici
examples.translation: concepute să ofere calcul tolerant la erori la scară largă, cu milioane de poartă-uri și mii de qubiți logici
examples.why: "poartă-uri" is not a Romanian word — the plural of "poartă" is "porți". It is a mechanical glossary substitution that a native reader would immediately register as broken.

examples.source: quantum circuits / circuit complexity / circuit libraries
examples.suggested: circuitele cuantice / complexitatea crescândă a circuitului / execuția circuitelor cuantice / circuitele dinamice … biblioteci de circuite
examples.translation: Circuit-urile cuantice (l.14, 38), complexitatea crescândă a Circuit-ului (l.33), execuția Circuit-urilor cuantice (l.45), Circuit-urile dinamice … biblioteci de circuit-uri (l.54)
examples.why: The hyphenated, mid-sentence-capitalized "Circuit-" form is not Romanian orthography, and line 54 mixes capitalized "Circuit-urile" with lowercase "circuit-uri" in the same sentence — a within-file inconsistency on the single most frequent domain noun.

examples.source: details the key ideas ahead
examples.suggested: detaliază ideile-cheie care urmează
examples.translation: detaliază ideile cheie din față
examples.why: "din față" is a literal calque of spatial "ahead" and in Romanian reads as physical position, not "upcoming". A native technical writer would write "care urmează" and hyphenate "idei-cheie".

examples.source: the implementation of full fault-tolerance is not expected to be viable in the immediate near term
examples.suggested: nu se așteaptă ca implementarea toleranței complete la erori să fie viabilă în viitorul imediat
examples.translation: implementarea toleranței complete la erori nu este așteptată să fie viabilă pe termen imediat apropiat
examples.why: "nu este așteptată să fie" is a direct transfer of the English passive-plus-infinitive construction; Romanian uses the impersonal reflexive "nu se așteaptă ca … să fie". Grammatical but audibly translated.

examples.source: quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) error correction codes
examples.suggested: codurile emergente de corecție cuantică a erorilor cu verificare de paritate de joasă densitate (qLDPC)
examples.translation: codurile emergente de corecție a erorilor cuantice de joasă densitate de paritate (qLDPC)
examples.why: The rendering drops "check/verificare" and reattaches the modifier, so it reads as "low density of parity" rather than "low-density parity-check"; it also shifts "quantum" onto "erorilor" instead of the codes. Recognizable via the qLDPC acronym, hence minor.

examples.source: computations beyond classical brute-force simulation
examples.suggested: calcule dincolo de simularea clasică prin forță brută
examples.translation: calcule dincolo de simularea clasică forțată
examples.why: "forțată" reads as "forced/coerced" simulation and loses the established Romanian term "forță brută" for brute force.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift: the T2 ≤ 2·T1 caveat, the reset-to-1-instead-of-0 toy model, the qubit-order caveat for [0,1] vs [1,0], and the P(A|B) recorded-vs-true bit distinction are all rendered correctly, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a Romanian technical editor would fix: (1) "poartă" (feminine) repeatedly takes the masculine article — "un poartă pe un singur qubit", "un poartă pe doi Qubiți", "pentru un poartă cu doi Qubiți" — plus the malformed plural "erori de poartă-uri CPTP" (should be "erori de porți CPTP"); (2) "noise model" is left in English from the "Adaugă erori într-un noise model" section onward while the first half of the page consistently says "model de zgomot", and "gate" is likewise split between "poartă"/"timpul de poartă" and "Gate-urilor"; (3) the heading "## Example 2: Relaxare termică T1/T2" keeps the English word "Example" whereas the parallel heading above says "Exemplu de zgomot 1"; (4) a formal-register slip, "Rețineți că trebuie să avem", against "Reține că ordinea Qubiților contează" elsewhere; and (5) pervasive mid-sentence capitalization plus hyphenated grafts ("Circuit-urilor cuantice", "n-Qubiți", "Backend fizic") that read as machine output rather than native Romanian technical prose.

examples.source: When applying a single-qubit gate, flip the state of the qubit with probability `p_gate1`. / When applying a two-qubit gate, apply single-qubit errors to each qubit.
examples.suggested: Când se aplică o poartă pe un singur qubit, ... / Când se aplică o poartă pe doi qubiți, ...
examples.translation: Când se aplică un poartă pe un singur qubit, starea Qubitului se inversează cu probabilitatea `p_gate1`. / Când se aplică un poartă pe doi Qubiți, se aplică erori pe un singur qubit fiecărui qubit.
examples.why: 'poartă' is feminine in Romanian, so 'un poartă' is ungrammatical; the same error recurs at ~line 314 ('pentru un poartă cu doi Qubiți'). No native writer would produce this.

examples.source: The `QuantumError` class which describes CPTP gate errors.
examples.suggested: Clasa `QuantumError`, care descrie erori de porți CPTP.
examples.translation: Clasa `QuantumError`, care descrie erori de poartă-uri CPTP.
examples.why: 'poartă-uri' is a malformed plural (singular 'poartă' with an '-uri' suffix bolted on via hyphen); the correct plural is 'porți'.

examples.source: Add errors to a noise model / Noise model examples / Basic bit-flip error noise model
examples.suggested: Adaugă erori într-un model de zgomot / Exemple de modele de zgomot / Model de zgomot simplu cu eroare de bit-flip
examples.translation: Adaugă erori într-un noise model / Exemple de noise model / Noise model simplu cu eroare de bit-flip
examples.why: The first half of the page (title, intro, 'Inițializează un model de zgomot dintr-un Backend') consistently uses 'model de zgomot'; from the 'Adaugă erori' section onward it switches to the untranslated 'noise model' (incl. 'noise model-ului', 'noise model-uri'). Same concept, two renderings in one file.

examples.source: ## Example 2: T1/T2 thermal relaxation
examples.suggested: ## Exemplul 2: Relaxare termică T1/T2
examples.translation: ## Example 2: Relaxare termică T1/T2
examples.why: 'Example' is left untranslated in the heading, while the parallel heading above it is correctly 'Exemplu de zgomot 1' and the earlier section is '### Exemplu'.

examples.source: Note that we must have $T_2 \le 2 T_1$.
examples.suggested: Reține că trebuie să avem $T_2 \le 2 T_1$.
examples.translation: Rețineți că trebuie să avem $T_2 \le 2 T_1$.
examples.why: Formal/plural imperative against the file's otherwise consistent informal 'tu' ('Poți inițializa', 'Reține că ordinea Qubiților contează', 'scrii propriul tău pass').

examples.source: ...to build noise models for simulating quantum circuits in the presence of errors.
examples.suggested: ...pentru a construi modele de zgomot pentru simularea circuitelor cuantice în prezența erorilor.
examples.translation: ...pentru a construi modele de zgomot pentru simularea Circuit-urilor cuantice în prezența erorilor.
examples.why: 'Circuit-urilor' capitalizes a common noun mid-sentence and hyphenates a native Romanian word that inflects normally ('circuitelor'); the same pattern appears as 'n-Qubiți', 'Gate-urilor', 'Backend fizic' and reads as machine output.

editor_note: The file is overall fluent and terminologically sound (ansatz/Hamiltonian/Estimator kept in English, ตัวดำเนินการ for operator, ค่าความคาดหวัง for expectation value, กาง for "span" — all correct and consistent), but §3.2 inverts the meaning of `least_busy`: "เราเลือก backend ที่ว่างงานน้อยที่สุด" parses in Thai as "we pick the LEAST idle backend", i.e. the busiest one — the opposite of "We select the least busy backend", and it contradicts the code comment right below it ("fewest number of jobs in the queue"). Correct rendering is "backend ที่ยุ่งน้อยที่สุด" / "ที่ว่างที่สุด". Secondary, non-misleading items: two dropped hedges ("almost certainly" in §2.1 and "potential" in "Both suffer from POTENTIAL trainability issues" → "ทั้งคู่ประสบกับปัญหาการเทรน", which asserts the problem rather than flagging it as possible); "generally deep quantum circuits" flattened to "quantum circuit ที่มีความลึกโดยทั่วไป" ("circuits of typical depth"), losing "deep" — the very reason QPE needs fault tolerance; and recurring calques (หมายเหตุว่า for "Note that", น่าสัญญา for "promising", "นั่นไม่ใช่ที่แนะนำ" for "that is not advisable"). Register is correctly casual throughout — no ครับ/ค่ะ.

examples.source: We select the least busy backend.
examples.suggested: เราเลือก backend ที่ยุ่งน้อยที่สุด (คิวงานน้อยที่สุด)
examples.translation: เราเลือก backend ที่ว่างงานน้อยที่สุด
examples.why: ว่างงาน = idle/unemployed, so ว่างงานน้อยที่สุด = the LEAST idle backend, i.e. the busiest — an inversion of least_busy. It also contradicts the adjacent code comment 'select the backend with the fewest number of jobs in the queue'. A learner is taught the opposite selection criterion.

examples.source: Both suffer from potential trainability issues, like multiple local minima…
examples.suggested: ทั้งคู่อาจประสบปัญหาด้านการฝึก (trainability) เช่น local minima หลายตัว…
examples.translation: ทั้งคู่ประสบกับปัญหาการเทรน เช่น local minima หลายตัว…
examples.why: 'potential' is dropped, turning a hedged 'may suffer' into a flat assertion that gradient-based and gradient-free optimizers do suffer these issues.

examples.source: QPE requires fault-tolerant quantum computers due to its generally deep quantum circuits and the high level of coherence it requires.
examples.suggested: …เนื่องจาก quantum circuit ของมันมักมีความลึกมาก และต้องการ coherence ในระดับสูง
examples.translation: QPE ต้องการควอนตัมคอมพิวเตอร์แบบ fault-tolerant เนื่องจาก quantum circuit ที่มีความลึกโดยทั่วไปและระดับ coherence สูงที่ต้องการ
examples.why: 'generally deep' becomes 'circuits with typical/general depth', dropping the word that carries the causal explanation (deep circuits → need for fault tolerance). The pedagogical point flattens.

examples.source: The most computationally expensive single step is almost certainly calculating the expectation value…
examples.suggested: ขั้นตอนเดี่ยวที่มีต้นทุนสูงที่สุดแทบจะแน่นอนว่าคือการคำนวณค่าความคาดหวัง…
examples.translation: ขั้นตอนเดี่ยวที่มีต้นทุนการคำนวณสูงที่สุดคือการคำนวณค่าความคาดหวัง…
examples.why: 'almost certainly' is dropped, hardening a hedged claim into a categorical one.

examples.source: Note that in the Hamiltonian above… / Note that Qiskit uses little endian notation…
examples.suggested: สังเกตว่า… / โปรดสังเกตว่า…
examples.translation: หมายเหตุว่าใน Hamiltonian ข้างต้น… / หมายเหตุว่า Qiskit ใช้ little endian notation…
examples.why: หมายเหตุ is a noun ('a note/remark'); 'หมายเหตุว่า' is a direct calque of 'Note that' that a Thai technical writer would not use as a sentence opener. Repeated four times.

examples.source: …which have shown promising results in noisy environments. / Although this initial guess could be random, that is not advisable.
examples.suggested: …ซึ่งให้ผลลัพธ์ที่มีแนวโน้มดีในสภาพแวดล้อมที่มี noise / …แต่ไม่แนะนำให้ทำเช่นนั้น
examples.translation: …ซึ่งแสดงผลลัพธ์ที่น่าสัญญาในสภาพแวดล้อมที่มี noise / แม้ว่า guess เริ่มต้นนี้อาจเป็นแบบสุ่ม แต่นั่นไม่ใช่ที่แนะนำ
examples.why: น่าสัญญา is a literal calque of 'promising' (Thai uses มีแนวโน้มดี/น่าพอใจ), and 'นั่นไม่ใช่ที่แนะนำ' is ungrammatical word-for-word English syntax. Both read as fluent MT rather than native technical prose.

editor_note: Meaning is broadly faithful and the register is correctly casual (no ครับ/ค่ะ), but a native technical editor would change several things. "global noise channel" is rendered "ช่องทาง noise ส่วนกลาง" — ส่วนกลาง means "central", not "global/system-wide", and it clashes with the image caption which keeps "local" in English; "ทั่วทั้งระบบ" or "โดยรวม" is the right word. In the advantages paragraph "a vast set of mitigated expectation values of observables" loses "expectation values" and becomes "เข้าถึง observable ที่ผ่านการลด noise จำนวนมาก" (mitigated observables), even though the same file correctly writes "ค่าความคาดหวัง...ของ observable" elsewhere. Smaller items: the comparative "the noisier gates" is strengthened to the superlative "gate ที่มี noise มากที่สุด"; "As an advantage" is calqued as "ในฐานะข้อได้เปรียบ"; "ฟังก์ชันนำ map ที่กลับค่า noise ของ Circuit ทั้งหมด" is left without its verb complement (นำ...ไปใช้) and drops "fully"; and "circuit" is written inconsistently as capitalized "Circuit" in most of the prose but lowercase "circuit" in benefit #2, while "error mitigation" is rendered "การลดความผิดพลาด" in the title but "การลด noise" throughout the body. None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: a tensor network representing the inverse of the global noise channel affecting the state of the quantum processor
examples.suggested: tensor network ที่แทนค่าผกผันของ noise channel โดยรวมทั้งระบบ ที่กระทบต่อสถานะของโปรเซสเซอร์ควอนตัม
examples.translation: tensor network ที่แทนค่าผกผันของช่องทาง noise ส่วนกลาง ที่กระทบต่อสถานะของโปรเซสเซอร์ควอนตัม
examples.why: ส่วนกลาง reads as "central", not "global". The point is that the channel covers the whole processor, and the file itself keeps "local" in English in the figure caption, so the global/local contrast is lost.

examples.source: TEM leverages informationally complete measurements to give access to a vast set of mitigated expectation values of observables
examples.suggested: ...เพื่อเข้าถึงค่าความคาดหวัง (expectation values) ของ observable จำนวนมากที่ผ่านการลดความผิดพลาดแล้ว
examples.translation: TEM ใช้ประโยชน์จากการวัดที่ครอบคลุมข้อมูลอย่างสมบูรณ์เพื่อเข้าถึง observable ที่ผ่านการลด noise จำนวนมาก
examples.why: "expectation values" is dropped, so it reads as if the observables themselves are mitigated. The rest of the file renders the concept correctly as ค่าความคาดหวังของ observable, making this an internal inconsistency too.

examples.source: minimize the number of layers with two-qubit gates (the noisier gates on quantum devices)
examples.suggested: ลดจำนวนชั้นที่มี two-qubit gate (gate ที่มี noise สูงกว่าบนอุปกรณ์ควอนตัม)
examples.translation: ลดจำนวนชั้นที่มี two-qubit gate (gate ที่มี noise มากที่สุดบนอุปกรณ์ควอนตัม)
examples.why: English is comparative ("noisier"); มากที่สุด turns it into an absolute superlative claim. The fact happens to hold on IBM hardware, so it does not mislead, but it overstates the source.

examples.source: The function applies a map that fully inverts the whole noisy circuit using tensor networks to represent the noisy layers.
examples.suggested: ฟังก์ชันจะนำ map ที่กลับค่า noise ของ circuit ทั้งวงจรได้อย่างสมบูรณ์ไปใช้ โดยใช้ tensor network แทนชั้นที่มี noise
examples.translation: ฟังก์ชันนำ map ที่กลับค่า noise ของ Circuit ทั้งหมดโดยใช้ tensor network เพื่อแทนชั้นที่มี noise
examples.why: นำ X is left dangling without ไปใช้/มาใช้, so the clause has no main verb — a native writer would never leave it. "fully" is also dropped.

examples.source: As an advantage, TEM leverages informationally complete measurements
examples.suggested: ข้อได้เปรียบสำคัญคือ TEM ใช้ประโยชน์จากการวัดที่ครอบคลุมข้อมูลอย่างสมบูรณ์
examples.translation: ในฐานะข้อได้เปรียบ TEM ใช้ประโยชน์จากการวัดที่ครอบคลุมข้อมูลอย่างสมบูรณ์
examples.why: ในฐานะข้อได้เปรียบ is a word-for-word calque of "As an advantage" and reads as machine output; Thai technical prose fronts it as ข้อได้เปรียบคือ.

examples.source: circuit / error-mitigated expectation values
examples.suggested: Use lowercase "circuit" throughout, and keep one rendering for error mitigation (e.g. การลดความผิดพลาด) distinct from noise.
examples.translation: "circuit" lowercase in benefit #2 but capitalized "Circuit" elsewhere (quantum Circuit, Circuit จะถูกวัด, Circuit ที่ไม่มี noise); "error mitigation" = การลดความผิดพลาด in the title but การลด noise in the body
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: the mid-sentence capital C is an artifact, and blending error/noise mitigation blurs two terms the English keeps apart. Recognizable throughout, so not misleading.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped numbers, or dropped caveats; the QKE core (zero-state probability = kernel entry, depth-vs-noise argument, (1-p)^N scaling) all lands correctly, register is consistently informal (tayo/natin/mo, no po/opo), and the domain terms are sensibly kept in English (qubit, circuit depth, entanglement, feature map, kernel matrix, backend, transpile, Sampler) with native renderings used consistently for the rest (pagsukat = measurement, ingay = noise, estado = state, probabilidad). What a native editor would still fix: three malformed word-forms — "ang layunin ng pagmamagang ito" (¶1, should be "pagmamapang"), "ilang iba't ibang estado ang maaaring masukatan?" (Check-your-understanding Q1, should be "masukat"), and "dapat mong idisenyong ang entanglement map" (Scaling §, should be "idisenyo ang") — plus the editorial-artifact doublet "mga na-map (naimapang) data vector" in Step 1, which reads like an unresolved draft. "backend" is lowercase in the first Step 2 ("pinaka-hindi abala na backend") but capitalized and re-worded later ("pinaka-kaunting abala na Backend", and "iyong Circuit ... / Backend" in the Review list) — same concept, three surface forms. Finally, the "Suriin ang iyong pag-unawa" section adds a sentence with no English counterpart ("Basahin ang mga tanong sa ibaba ... i-click ang mga tatsulok upang matuklasan ang mga solusyon"); it is accurate for the <details> rendering used here, so it does not mislead, but it is content not in the source.

examples.source: where usually $d'>d$ and where the goal of this mapping is to make the categories of data separable by a hyperplane
examples.suggested: ... at ang layunin ng pagmamapang ito ay gawing mapaghihiwalay ng isang hyperplane ang mga kategorya ng data
examples.translation: kung saan karaniwan ay $d'>d$ at ang layunin ng pagmamagang ito ay gawing mapaghihiwalay ng isang hyperplane ang mga kategorya ng data
examples.why: "pagmamagang" is not a Tagalog word — a garbled form of "pagmamapa" (mapping). Meaning is still recoverable from context, but it is a visible typo in the lesson's opening definition.

examples.source: will of course, involve many such inner products between mapped data vectors
examples.suggested: ... sa pagitan ng mga na-map na data vector
examples.translation: ay syempre nagsasangkot ng maraming ganitong inner product sa pagitan ng mga na-map (naimapang) data vector
examples.why: The parenthetical "(naimapang)" is a leftover alternative rendering, not a gloss the reader needs — a native technical writer would pick one form. Reads as an unresolved draft.

examples.source: We start by selecting the least busy backend … / optimizing your circuit for running on real quantum computers / backends
examples.suggested: Use one form throughout: "pinakakaunti ang abala na backend", and lowercase "backend"/"circuit" everywhere
examples.translation: pinaka-hindi abala na backend (Hakbang 2, unang halimbawa) … pinaka-kaunting abala na Backend (Hakbang 2, scaling section) … pag-optimize ng iyong Circuit para patakbuhin sa mga tunay na quantum computer / Backend (Pagsusuri)
examples.why: Same English terms rendered three ways within the file, with mid-sentence capitalization of "Backend" and "Circuit" that has no basis in the English. Recognizable, but inconsistent.

examples.source: ### Check your understanding\n\nIn a 10-qubit quantum circuit, generally, how many different states are there that could possibly be measured?
examples.suggested: Drop the added instruction line; "masukatan" → "masukat"
examples.translation:
### Suriin ang iyong pag-unawa
Basahin ang mga tanong sa ibaba, isipin ang iyong mga sagot, pagkatapos ay i-click ang mga tatsulok upang matuklasan ang mga solusyon.

Sa isang 10-qubit quantum circuit, sa pangkalahatan, ilang iba't ibang estado ang maaaring masukatan?
examples.why: An instruction sentence appears that the English does not have (harmless — it matches the <details> rendering used here — but it is unsourced added content), and "masukatan" is a malformed verb form for "measured".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift: the analysis/transformation pass contrast ("Hindi nila mababago ang DAG, ngunit maaari nilang baguhin ang `property_set`"), the twirl left/right cancellation ("ang mga inilapat *bago* ... ay makontra ng mga inilapat *pagkatapos*"), the coherent→stochastic error claim, and "50 circuits" all match the English, and register stays informal (Pinapayagan ka, gusto namin) with no po/opo. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) the netlist sentence carries a calqued double-"ay" construction — "ay ang daloy ng impormasyon sa pagitan ng mga operasyon ay malinaw" — which no Tagalog technical writer would produce; (2) "manipulated by the `TransformationPass`" is rendered "pinamamahalaan" (managed/governed) rather than minamanipula/binabago, weakening the DAG-is-mutated point; (3) "much more error-prone than single-qubit gates" becomes "mas madaling magkamali", which both drops "much" and attributes human-style mistake-making to gates instead of error rates. Separately worth a pass: the second `AccordionItem title="Background: DAG representation"` is left in English while the first one ("Mga bersyon ng package") is translated.

examples.source: The advantage of this representation over a pure list of gates (that is, a *netlist*) is that the flow of information between operations is explicit, making it easier to make transformation decisions.
examples.suggested: Ang kalamangan ng representasyong ito kumpara sa isang purong listahan ng mga gate (ibig sabihin, isang *netlist*) ay na malinaw ang daloy ng impormasyon sa pagitan ng mga operasyon, kaya mas madaling magdesisyon tungkol sa mga transformation.
examples.translation: Ang kalamangan ng representasyong ito kumpara sa isang purong listahan ng mga gates (ibig sabihin, isang *netlist*) ay ang daloy ng impormasyon sa pagitan ng mga operasyon ay malinaw, na nagpapadali ng paggawa ng mga desisyon sa transformation.
examples.why: The English 'is that X is explicit' is copied structurally, producing a stacked 'ay ... ay' clause that reads as machine output; Tagalog fronts the predicate (malinaw ang daloy) instead.

examples.source: This example uses the DAG, which is the object manipulated by the `TransformationPass` type of pass.
examples.suggested: ... na siyang object na binabago (minamanipula) ng uri ng pass na `TransformationPass`.
examples.translation: Ginagamit ng halimbawang ito ang DAG, na siyang object na pinamamahalaan ng uri ng pass na `TransformationPass`.
examples.why: 'pinamamahalaan' means managed/administered; the whole point of a TransformationPass is that it mutates the DAG, which 'binabago' conveys and 'pinamamahalaan' blurs. Not misleading enough to teach a false concept, but it flattens the AnalysisPass-vs-TransformationPass distinction the page builds later.

examples.source: ...which we assume to be two-qubit gates in this example (because they are much more error-prone than single-qubit gates).
examples.suggested: ...(dahil higit na mas madaling magkaroon ng error ang mga ito kumpara sa mga single-qubit gate).
examples.translation: ...na ipinapalagay naming mga two-qubit gates sa halimbawang ito (dahil mas madaling magkamali kumpara sa mga single-qubit gates).
examples.why: 'magkamali' personifies the gate as making a mistake rather than having a higher error rate, and the intensifier 'much' is dropped; the subject pronoun is also elided, leaving the clause ambiguous about what is error-prone.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ти" register holds with no Ви/Вам slips; core terms (кубіт, гейт, GHZ-стан, транспілювати, ланцюжок кубітів, центральність за посередництвом, придушення помилок) are correct. The defects are terminology consistency and English/German-style leaks: "circuit" is rendered "схема" for the whole file but switches to bare capitalized "Circuit" in section 5 and at the end of section 3.2 ("кращий GHZ Circuit", "Побудуй GHZ Circuit для 20 і більше кубітів", "скористаймося саме цим Circuit"); likewise "backend" appears as mid-sentence capitalized "Backend" ("Давай оберемо Backend", "властивостями конкретного Backend") and "the H gate" becomes the untranslated, wrong-order "Gate H" even though "гейт" is used everywhere else. The title calques "utility-scale" as "Експеримент масштабу утиліти" — "утиліта" in Ukrainian means a software utility program — and the same concept is rendered quite differently in the closing line as "квантові обчислення на рівні промислового застосування". Smaller: "coupling map" alternates мапа зв'язків / карта зв'язків, "error" alternates похибка / помилка, image alt text alternates "Вихід попереднього блоку коду" / "Вивід попередньої комірки коду", and the hedge in "the circuit depth should become lower" is flattened to a flat assertion "дозволяє зменшити глибину схеми".

examples.source: You can combine and expand these ideas or you come up with your own ideas to create a better GHZ circuit. … Build a GHZ circuit for 20 qubits or more …
examples.suggested: … щоб побудувати кращу GHZ-схему. … Побудуй GHZ-схему для 20 і більше кубітів …
examples.translation: Ти можеш комбінувати та розвивати їх або запропонувати власні, щоб побудувати кращий GHZ Circuit. … Побудуй GHZ Circuit для 20 і більше кубітів …
examples.why: The whole file (incl. §1.2, §2.1) renders "circuit" as "схема" ("GHZ-схему", "глибина схеми"); section 5 and the end of §3.2 abruptly leave the bare English "Circuit" capitalized mid-sentence. Same concept, two renderings — a glossary leak, not a style choice.

examples.source: We choose a qubit in the middle of the chain to first apply the H gate to.
examples.suggested: … щоб першим застосувати до нього гейт H.
examples.translation: Ми обираємо кубіт у середині ланцюжка, щоб першим застосувати до нього Gate H.
examples.why: "Gate H" is untranslated and in English/German head-first order; the file otherwise uses "гейт" consistently ("двокубітними гейтами", "похибками гейтів"). A Ukrainian technical writer would never write "Gate H".

examples.source: Let's pick a backend and transpile this circuit. … We first specify a backend. Because we will be working extensively with the properties of a specific backend …
examples.suggested: Давай оберемо backend і транспілюємо цю схему. … Спочатку вкажемо backend. Оскільки ми детально працюватимемо з властивостями конкретного backend …
examples.translation: Давай оберемо Backend і транспілюємо цю схему. … Спочатку вкажемо Backend. Оскільки ми детально працюватимемо з властивостями конкретного Backend …
examples.why: Keeping "backend" in English is defensible, but capitalizing it mid-sentence is German orthography, not Ukrainian; it also can't be declined, so "властивостями конкретного Backend" reads as an untranslated fragment.

examples.source: Utility-scale experiment III … your introduction to utility-scale quantum computing
examples.suggested: Експеримент промислового масштабу III … (and keep the same wording in the closing line)
examples.translation: Експеримент масштабу утиліти III … знайомство з квантовими обчисленнями на рівні промислового застосування
examples.why: "утиліта" in Ukrainian means a software utility program, so "масштабу утиліти" is a misleading calque; the closing sentence renders the same course-level concept quite differently ("на рівні промислового застосування"), so the two never connect for the learner.

examples.source: Using the tree rather than the chain, the circuit depth should become lower.
examples.suggested: Використання дерева замість ланцюжка має зменшити глибину схеми.
examples.translation: Використання дерева замість ланцюжка дозволяє зменшити глибину схеми.
examples.why: The English hedges with "should" (an expectation to be checked against the measured depths that follow); the Ukrainian states it as an accomplished fact, flattening the pedagogical setup of the experiment.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the bit-ordering paragraph (LSb 0, "біт $n−1$ є крайнім лівим бітом, а біт $0$ — крайнім правим"), the ISA/depth paragraph, the Estimator/Sampler paragraph and the credit-card caveat all carry the English content correctly, and the informal "ти" register holds with no Ви/Вам/Ваш slips. The defect is a systematic glossary-leak pattern: several core terms are left as bare, uninflected English nouns embedded in Ukrainian case slots, alongside the correct Ukrainian term for the *same* concept elsewhere in the file — "Circuit" 5× ("кілька простих Circuit", "Під час виконання Circuit на пристрої", "виконує вибір Circuit") against "схема/схеми" 17×; "qubit" 4× in prose ("набору qubit", "з'єднання qubit", "(або qubit)") where the rest of the uk workshop corpus uses "кубіт"; "базові Gate" against "вентилі вимірювання"; "пристрою-Backend"/"ISA цього Backend". Secondary: "notebook" → "зошит" (school exercise book; sibling uk files use "ноутбук"), "primitive" split between the noun "примітив" (l.13, 291, 294, 347) and the adjective phrase "примітивної функції Qiskit" (l.182, which reads as "a crude function"), "hardware" split between slangy "на реальному залізі" (l.134) and "апаратного забезпечення" (l.307), plus one ungrammatical imperative "Зверни до посібника" (l.146, missing the reflexive -сь; l.61 has it right).

examples.source: Let's try building some simple circuits with Qiskit.
examples.suggested: Спробуємо побудувати кілька простих квантових схем за допомогою Qiskit.
examples.translation: Спробуємо побудувати кілька простих Circuit за допомогою Qiskit.
examples.why: 'Circuit' is left as a bare uninflected English noun as the head of a Ukrainian genitive-plural phrase, while the same file renders 'circuit' as 'схема' 17 times (incl. the neighbouring heading 'Побудова базових квантових схем'). Grammatically broken and reads as a raw glossary leak.

examples.source: …a probability distribution for a set of qubits you choose to measure. … the device's basis gates and qubit connectivity.
examples.suggested: …розподіл імовірностей для набору кубітів, які ти обираєш для вимірювання. … базисні вентилі та зв'язність кубітів пристрою.
examples.translation: …розподіл імовірностей для набору qubit, які ти обираєш для вимірювання. … базові Gate і з'єднання qubit пристрою.
examples.why: 'qubit' and 'Gate' are untransliterated and uninflected inside Ukrainian case slots. The conventional term is 'кубіт' (used in the sibling uk workshop files 04 and 06), and the same file already uses 'вентилі' for gates two paragraphs earlier ('вентилі вимірювання') — so the concept is split within the file.

examples.source: 3. Execute using a Qiskit primitive function.
examples.suggested: 3.  Виконай за допомогою функції-примітиву Qiskit.
examples.translation: 3.  Виконай за допомогою примітивної функції Qiskit.
examples.why: As an adjective, 'примітивна функція' reads as 'a crude/simple function' (and in older Ukrainian maths, 'antiderivative') rather than the Qiskit term of art. The file itself uses the noun 'примітив' everywhere else ('примітивом Sampler', 'Примітив `Estimator`', 'примітивів Qiskit'), so this step-3 heading breaks the term the learner is being taught.

examples.source: In order to execute quantum circuits on real hardware… / Step 2. Optimize the circuits for the target hardware
examples.suggested: …на реальному обладнанні… / …для цільового обладнання
examples.translation: Щоб виконувати квантові схеми на реальному залізі… / Крок 2. Оптимізація схем для цільового апаратного забезпечення
examples.why: 'залізо' is colloquial slang for hardware; the informal 'ти' convention covers pronouns, not lexical slang in an instructional heading's body text. It also renders 'hardware' two different ways within the file.

examples.source: Refer to the Set up your IBM Cloud account guide for more information…
examples.suggested: Звернись до посібника […], щоб дізнатися більше про використання API-ключа…
examples.translation: Зверни до посібника [Налаштування облікового запису IBM Cloud] для отримання додаткової інформації…
examples.why: 'Зверни' is missing the reflexive -сь and is ungrammatical here (l.61 gets it right: 'звернись до цього посібника'). 'для отримання додаткової інформації про' is also a stiff nominal calque a native technical writer would turn into a 'щоб' clause.

examples.source: In this notebook you will walk through a Qiskit Patterns workflow… / After this notebook, we will be looking at the Quantum Teleportation protocol.
examples.suggested: У цьому ноутбуці ти пройдеш… / Після цього ноутбука ми розглянемо…
examples.translation: У цьому зошиті ти пройдеш через робочий процес Qiskit Patterns… / Після цього зошита ми розглянемо протокол квантової телепортації.
examples.why: 'зошит' is a school exercise book, not a Jupyter notebook; the uk corpus elsewhere uses 'у цьому ноутбуці'. 'пройдеш через робочий процес' is also a calque of 'walk through' — Ukrainian would use 'пройдеш робочий процес' or 'ознайомишся з робочим процесом'.

editor_note: The decisive defect is in the "Transform the measurement bases" section: "many observables may be measured simultaneously if they commute qubit-wise" is rendered "إذا كانت تتبادل الإيهام بيت بيت" — "الإيهام" (illusion/delusion) is meaningless here and "بيت بيت" says *bit by bit*, not كيوبت بكيوبت, so the learner is given a wrong (and unparseable) criterion for when observables can be measured in one basis, which is exactly the point that paragraph exists to teach. A second drift sits in the `num_to_measure` bullet: "The terms have now been re-scaled" becomes "أُعيد قياس الحدود" (= the terms were re-*measured*), and the same sentence continues "بحيث يؤدي قياسها إلى تخفيف..." — the reader is told the terms were measured again rather than that their coefficients were rescaled, which misstates what PNA produces. Beyond those, "evolved generator" is consistently "المولّد المتطوّر" (= advanced/sophisticated, not time-evolved), and the file is peppered with glossary doubling/leaks ("دائرة Circuit كمومية"، "ننقل الدائرة Circuit إلى Backend"، "ترتيب qubit القانوني"، "مجموع جميع Paulis") plus split renderings of basis (أساس vs قاعدة قياس), post-selection (الانتقاء اللاحق vs الاختيار اللاحق), primitive (أداة أولية vs الكيان الأولي) and twirling (تدوير vs تعشية). Informal register (ستحتاج، دائرتك، تذكّر، تفضّل بزيارة) is held consistently throughout — no register problem.

examples.source: many observables may be measured simultaneously if they commute qubit-wise
examples.suggested: يمكن قياس عدة عناصر قابلة للرصد في آنٍ واحد إذا كانت متبادلة (تتبادل) على مستوى الكيوبتات (qubit-wise commuting)
examples.translation: يمكن قياس عديد من العناصر القابلة للرصد في آنٍ واحد إذا كانت تتبادل الإيهام بيت بيت
examples.why: "تتبادل الإيهام" is word-salad (الإيهام = illusion) and "بيت بيت" says bit-by-bit instead of كيوبت بكيوبت; the learner is handed a false and unrecoverable condition for simultaneous measurement, which is the whole justification for needing only the all-Z basis.

examples.source: The terms have now been re-scaled such that measuring them has the effect of mitigating the learned gate noise.
examples.suggested: أُعيد تحجيم معاملات هذه الحدود الآن بحيث يؤدي قياسها إلى التخفيف من ضوضاء البوابات المُتعلَّمة.
examples.translation: أُعيد قياس الحدود الآن بحيث يؤدي قياسها إلى تخفيف ضوضاء البوابات المُتعلَّمة.
examples.why: "أُعيد قياس" reads as "were re-measured", especially since the very next clause uses the same root for "measuring them"; it hides the actual mechanism (classical rescaling of the coefficients) and makes the sentence circular.

examples.source: we propagate the observable through that evolved generator / the evolved anti-noise / a pile-up of evolved generators
examples.suggested: المولّد بعد تطوّره (الزمني) عبر الدائرة / مضاد الضوضاء المُطوَّر زمنياً
examples.translation: المولّد المتطوّر / مضاد الضوضاء المتطوّر / المولّدات المتطوّرة
examples.why: "متطوّر" in Arabic means advanced/sophisticated; the physics sense here is time-evolution through the circuit, so the reader loses the fact that the generator is the same object propagated forward, not a better one.

examples.source: Create a Trotterized quantum circuit and observable. Transpile it to the backend. / transpile the circuit to the backend / provide it the backend
examples.suggested: إنشاء دائرة كمومية تروترية... وترجمتها (transpile) إلى الواجهة الخلفية / نُترجِم الدائرة إلى الواجهة الخلفية / ونزوّده بالواجهة الخلفية
examples.translation: إنشاء دائرة Circuit كمومية تروترية... Transpile إلى Backend / ننقل الدائرة Circuit إلى Backend / ونزوّده بالواجهة الخلفية Backend
examples.why: Untranslated glossary tokens are pasted next to their Arabic equivalents ("دائرة Circuit", "الواجهة الخلفية Backend") and one verb is left bare in English ("Transpile إلى Backend"); no Arabic technical writer would double the noun like this, and it recurs about eight times.

examples.source: use it to mitigate gate errors / A technique for mitigating gate errors
examples.suggested: للتخفيف من أخطاء البوابات
examples.translation: ونستخدمها للتخفيف من أخطاء بوابة / تقنية للتخفيف من أخطاء بوابة
examples.why: "أخطاء بوابة" is an indefinite singular that reads as "errors of a gate"; the plural definite "أخطاء البوابات" is what the English means and what a native writer would use — the mistake is repeated in the opening paragraph and the bolded definition.

examples.source: Single qubit gates will be left-dressed within the boxes.
examples.suggested: ستُضمَّن بوابات الكيوبت الواحد داخل الصناديق ملحقةً من جهة اليسار (left-dressed).
examples.translation: ستُلحق بوابات الكيوبت الواحد بالصناديق من الجانب الأيسر.
examples.why: The English says the 1Q gates end up *inside* the boxes (dressed on the left); the Arabic says they are attached to the boxes from the left side, which suggests they sit outside the box — a meaningful difference when the boxes define what the noise learner sees.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — the structure, steps, links and the tricky sentences (including the "لا يمكن الوصول إلى IBM Quantum Platform إلا عبر الشبكة العامة" mirror of the odd English line, and "بصرف النظر عن طريقة الوصول، سواء عبر نقطة نهاية عامة أو VPE") are faithful, and the informal register (الخاصة بك، اتبع، حدد) holds throughout. What a native technical editor would change is cloud terminology: "instance" is rendered "نسخة" (نسخ الخوادم الافتراضية، نسخة IBM Quantum Platform) where IBM Cloud Arabic convention is "مثيل" — recognizable but imperfect and used for both server instances and the service instance; "redundant" is rendered "متكررة" (= repeated) rather than the redundancy sense (احتياطية / ذات تكرار احتياطي). Two smaller slips: "lets you control all private addressing within your cloud" becomes "التحكم الكامل في عناوين IP الخاصة" (the quantifier "all addressing" is re-cast as "full control" and narrowed to IP addresses), and the step-2 relative clause "بوابة نقطة نهاية ... تريد أن تكون متاحة بشكل خاص" is missing its resumptive pronoun (تريدها أن تكون), which reads stiff.

examples.source: Endpoint gateways enable communications from virtual server instances within your VPC … your IBM Quantum Platform instance
examples.suggested: مثيلات الخوادم الافتراضية … مثيل IBM Quantum Platform
examples.translation: نسخ الخوادم الافتراضية … نسخة IBM Quantum Platform
examples.why: "نسخة" means copy; the established IBM Cloud Arabic rendering of "instance" is "مثيل". Recognizable, so not misleading, but it is the non-conventional term and it is used for every occurrence in the file.

examples.source: is redundant and highly available
examples.suggested: وذات تكرار احتياطي (أو: احتياطية) وعالية التوافر
examples.translation: ومتكررة وعالية التوافر
examples.why: "متكررة" reads as "repeated/recurring", not the availability-engineering sense of redundancy; "عالية التوافر" next to it is correct, so the pairing sounds odd to a native infrastructure writer.

examples.source: VPE for VPC lets you control all private addressing within your cloud.
examples.suggested: تتيح لك VPE لـ VPC التحكم في جميع عمليات العنونة الخاصة داخل سحابتك.
examples.translation: تتيح لك VPE لـ VPC التحكم الكامل في عناوين IP الخاصة داخل سحابتك.
examples.why: The English quantifies the scope ("all private addressing"); the Arabic moves the quantifier onto the control ("full control") and narrows "addressing" to "IP addresses". Same practical takeaway, but the emphasis shifted.

examples.source: Create an endpoint gateway for IBM Quantum Platform that you want to be privately available to the VPC.
examples.suggested: … لـ IBM Quantum Platform التي تريدها أن تكون متاحة بشكل خاص داخل VPC.
examples.translation: [إنشاء بوابة نقطة نهاية] لـ IBM Quantum Platform تريد أن تكون متاحة بشكل خاص لـ VPC.
examples.why: Calqued English relative clause: Arabic needs the resumptive pronoun (تريدها) and a definite relative marker; as written the clause dangles and briefly reads as though the platform, not the gateway, is what you want made private.

editor_note: The physics is faithful and the argument structure is intact — "provázanost" for entanglement, "Bellův stav", "měřením ve standardní bázi" and the whole four-case verification table are all correct and consistent — but the file has a systematic glossary-leak problem that no Czech technical writer would leave in. First, "qubit" is never declined: "přenos jednoho qubit", "Posílání qubit", "posláním jednoho qubit", "na svém qubit", "přenášené pomocí qubit" — Czech requires qubitu / qubitů, so roughly eight occurrences are ungrammatical. Second, English "Gate" and "Circuit" are pasted in capitalized mid-sentence instead of the standard "hradlo" / "obvod": "$Z$ Gate", "controlled-NOT Gate", "diagram kvantového Circuit", and worst "Hadamardovu Gate", where the feminine accusative adjective agrees with nothing. Third, two small wording shifts flatten the English: "complementary aim" becomes "opačného cíle" (opposite, not complementary) and "rather striking" becomes "poměrně překvapivé" (surprising rather than striking). None of this misleads a learner about how superdense coding works, but all of it needs an editing pass.

examples.source: the transmission of one qubit using two classical bits of communication … sending a single qubit
examples.suggested: přenos jednoho qubitu pomocí dvou klasických bitů komunikace … posláním jednoho qubitu
examples.translation: přenos jednoho qubit pomocí dvou klasických bitů komunikace … posláním jednoho qubit
examples.why: "qubit" is left in the nominative everywhere instead of being declined into Czech case endings (qubitu, qubitů, qubitem). It is grammatically wrong in roughly eight places and is the single clearest tell that this is machine output with a protected glossary token rather than Czech prose.

examples.source: Alice performs a $Z$ gate on her qubit … he applies a Hadamard gate to $\mathsf{A}$
examples.suggested: Alice provede hradlo $Z$ na svém qubitu … poté aplikuje Hadamardovo hradlo na $\mathsf{A}$
examples.translation: Alice provede $Z$ Gate na svém qubit … poté aplikuje Hadamardovu Gate na $\mathsf{A}$
examples.why: The conventional Czech domain term is "hradlo" (neuter). Leaving capitalized English "Gate" produces "Hadamardovu Gate", where the feminine accusative adjective "Hadamardovu" has no noun to agree with — the phrase is simply broken Czech.

examples.source: The following quantum circuit diagram describes the superdense coding protocol:
examples.suggested: Následující diagram kvantového obvodu popisuje protokol superdense kódování:
examples.translation: Následující diagram kvantového Circuit popisuje protokol superdense kódování:
examples.why: "circuit" is the standard "obvod" in Czech quantum writing; here the English noun is dropped into a Czech genitive construction ("kvantového Circuit"), which is both a leak and ungrammatical.

examples.source: Superdense coding is a protocol that, in some sense, achieves a complementary aim to teleportation.
examples.suggested: Superdense kódování je protokol, který v jistém smyslu dosahuje komplementárního cíle k teleportaci.
examples.translation: Superdense kódování je protokol, který v jistém smyslu dosahuje opačného cíle než teleportace.
examples.why: "complementary" is rendered as "opačný" (opposite). The English deliberately says the two protocols complement each other — qubit-for-bits versus bits-for-qubit — rather than that one negates the other. The lead sentence of the lesson should carry that nuance.

examples.source: a concrete and (in the context of information theory) rather striking use of entanglement
examples.suggested: konkrétní a (v kontextu teorie informace) poměrně pozoruhodné využití provázanosti
examples.translation: konkrétní a (v kontextu teorie informace) poměrně překvapivé využití provázanosti
examples.why: "striking" (remarkable, attention-grabbing) is softened to "překvapivé" (surprising). The English is praising how notable the result is, not claiming it was unexpected — a small flattening of the emphasis the lesson is building toward.

examples.source: In words, here is what Alice does:
examples.suggested: Slovy řečeno, Alice dělá toto:
examples.translation: Slovně, toto je to, co dělá Alice:
examples.why: A word-for-word calque of the English frame. "Slovně, toto je to, co…" is a stiff construction a Czech technical author would not write; the natural idiom is "Slovy řečeno" or "Vyjádřeno slovy" followed by a direct clause.

editor_note: One misleading term error drives the FAIL: "we turn on error mitigation, including Zero Noise Extrapolation (ZNE)" is rendered "zapínáme korekci chyb, včetně extrapolace nulového šumu (ZNE)" — "korekce chyb" is the established Czech name for quantum *error correction* (QEC), a different technique class from error mitigation ("zmírnění/potlačení chyb"); the sentence therefore teaches the learner that ZNE and the Runtime `resilience` options are error correction, a distinction IBM's own material treats as load-bearing. On top of that the file is littered with glossary-protection leaks that produce non-Czech word forms: "kvantového Circuit", "velikost Circuitu", "hloubku dvoQubitových Gate operací", "jednoQubitové matice redukované hustoty", "pro každý Qubit", "s rostoucím počtem Qubitů", "Nejprve vybereme Backend" — correct Czech would be obvod / hradlo / jednokubitové / dvoukubitových / kubit. Terminology is also split within the file: "kernel" appears as "jádro" (funkce jádra, matice jádra) and as "kernel" ("kernelové funkce", "exponenciální kernel"), and "kernel matrix" is once inverted into "maticová jádra" (= matrix kernels) at the Background paragraph while later correctly "matice jádra". Minor MT residue elsewhere: number disagreement in "Tato střední hodnota jsou přesně to, co jsme výše měřili" (EN plural "These expectation values"), and "near-term hardware/devices" calqued as "krátkodobý kvantový hardware" / "krátkodobá zařízení" (reads as short-lived, not near-future). Informal "ty" register is held correctly throughout (ujisti se, můžeš, Všimni si).

examples.source: Note that we turn on error mitigation, including Zero Noise Extrapolation (ZNE).
examples.suggested: Všimni si, že zapínáme zmírnění chyb (error mitigation), včetně extrapolace k nulovému šumu (ZNE).
examples.translation: Všimni si, že zapínáme korekci chyb, včetně extrapolace nulového šumu (ZNE).
examples.why: "korekce chyb" is quantum ERROR CORRECTION in Czech usage — a different technique from error mitigation. The learner concludes ZNE/the Runtime resilience options perform QEC, which is false; this is a concept-level term error, not a stylistic one.

examples.source: We print out the circuit size and the two-qubit gate depth.
examples.suggested: Vypíšeme velikost obvodu a hloubku dvoukubitových hradel.
examples.translation: Vypíšeme velikost Circuitu a hloubku dvoQubitových Gate operací.
examples.why: Glossary-protection leak: English "Circuit" and "Gate" are spliced into Czech morphology, and "dvoQubitových" is not a Czech word (the correct form is dvoukubitových). Same leak class recurs as "kvantového Circuit", "jednoQubitové", "každý Qubit", "vybereme Backend".

examples.source: ...by measuring specific observables, to construct a kernel matrix that can be used in classical kernel-based algorithms...
examples.suggested: ...aby se sestavila matice jádra použitelná v klasických algoritmech založených na jádrech...
examples.translation: ...měřením specifických observabilních veličin, aby se sestavila maticová jádra použitelná v klasických algoritmech založených na jádrech...
examples.why: "maticová jádra" inverts head and modifier (= "matrix kernels") for "kernel matrix", and contradicts the correct "matice jádra" used later (l. 36, 815). The central object of the whole PQK pipeline is named two different ways in the same file.

examples.source: classical kernel function / exponential kernel / kernel function
examples.suggested: Pick one convention — e.g. "funkce jádra" / "exponenciální jádro" — and use it throughout.
examples.translation: klasické kernelové funkce, exponenciální kernel (l. 36, 38, 405) vs. funkcí jádra, funkce jádra (l. 814, 816)
examples.why: Within-file split of the file's core term between the anglicism "kernel(ová)" and the Czech "jádro"; the title and headings use "jádra", so the "kernelová funkce" passages read as a second translator's pass.

examples.source: These expectation values are precisely what we measured above.
examples.suggested: Tyto střední hodnoty jsou přesně to, co jsme měřili výše.
examples.translation: Tato střední hodnota jsou přesně to, co jsme výše měřili.
examples.why: Singular subject with plural verb — an outright agreement break that no Czech technical writer would produce, and it also loses the English plural (one value vs. the whole set of <X>,<Y>,<Z> per qubit).

examples.source: ...particularly for near-term quantum hardware. ... while remaining more practical for near-term devices.
examples.suggested: ...zejména pro kvantový hardware blízké budoucnosti ... praktičtější pro současná (NISQ) zařízení.
examples.translation: ...zejména pro krátkodobý kvantový hardware. ... zároveň zůstat praktičtější pro krátkodobá zařízení.
examples.why: "krátkodobý" means short-lived/of short duration; it calques "near-term" into a reading about how long the hardware lasts rather than which generation of hardware is meant.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic inversion, no swapped quantity and no dropped caveat; the load-bearing physics passages (the betas-too-small explanation "Dies geschieht, weil die Betas zu klein waren, um den minimalen Eigenzustand ... zu bestrafen", and the whole orthogonality/false-excited-state argument in "Es ist für eine variationelle Berechnung nicht möglich, eine Energie zu liefern, die niedriger als die wahre Grundzustandsenergie ist") teach exactly as well as the English, and core terminology is correct and consistent (Observable, Erwartungswert, Eigenzustand, Gate, Qubit, transpilieren/Transpilierung, Backend, Estimator/Sampler-Primitiv, Ansatz, "variationell" everywhere). The defects are lexical, not conceptual. The idiom "to call out the framework steps / call out step 2 explicitly" is mistranslated twice as "explizit aufrufen" (= to invoke/call a function), where German needs "explizit benennen/hervorheben" — jarring, especially next to real function calls in the surrounding code. Several other calques survive: "um insgesamt $k=2$ Zustände zu lösen" (states are not "gelöst"; "zu bestimmen/berechnen"), "mit NumPys linearem Algebra-Eigenwertlöser" (word-for-word from "NumPy's linear algebra eigensolver"), and "deine Bewertung abzulegen" for "take your assessment" ("Prüfung/Test ablegen"). Finally "penalty" is rendered inconsistently as "Überlappungsstrafe" (§VQD Step 1 intro) vs. "Strafterme"/"Strafterm" elsewhere, and constrained/unconstrained minimizer becomes "eingeschränkter/uneingeschränkter Minimierer" where the field says "restringiert/unrestringiert" or "mit/ohne Nebenbedingungen". Informal "du" holds consistently (Beachte, Stell dir vor, Denke daran, kannst du, deinem System) with no Sie-slips.

examples.source: we will only explicitly call out the framework steps in one example case … but we will call out step 2 explicitly later.
examples.suggested: … die Framework-Schritte nur in einem Beispielfall explizit benennen … aber auf Schritt 2 gehen wir später explizit ein.
examples.translation: werden wir die Framework-Schritte jedoch nur in einem Beispielfall explizit aufrufen … aber wir werden Schritt 2 später explizit aufrufen.
examples.why: "call out" here means to point out/highlight, not to invoke. "aufrufen" is the German verb for calling a function, so in a page full of Python calls the reader briefly parses it as "invoke the steps". Wrong sense of the idiom, used twice.

examples.source: We can also leverage VQD to solve for $k=2$ total states (the ground state and the first excited state).
examples.suggested: … um insgesamt $k=2$ Zustände zu bestimmen (den Grundzustand und den ersten angeregten Zustand).
examples.translation: Wir können auch VQD nutzen, um insgesamt $k=2$ Zustände zu lösen (den Grundzustand und den ersten angeregten Zustand).
examples.why: "Zustände lösen" is a calque of "solve for states"; in German one solves an equation, not a state. A native writer would say bestimmen/berechnen/ermitteln.

examples.source: overlap penalty … the penalties … the overlap penalties (betas)
examples.suggested: Pick one: consistently "Strafterm"/"Überlappungsstrafterm" (and "Strafterme" in the plural).
examples.translation: die Überlappungsstrafe … die Strafterme … die Überlappungsstrafterme (Betas)
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency for the same concept: "Strafe" in the first occurrence, "Strafterm" in all later ones. Recognizable, but a technical editor would unify it.

examples.source: we can check this by using NumPy's linear algebra eigensolver.
examples.suggested: … mit dem Eigenwertlöser aus NumPys linearer Algebra (numpy.linalg) überprüfen.
examples.translation: können wir dies mit NumPys linearem Algebra-Eigenwertlöser überprüfen.
examples.why: The English noun stack is transferred literally; "linearem Algebra-Eigenwertlöser" mis-binds the adjective (it now modifies the solver, not the algebra) and reads as raw MT.

examples.source: Proceed to the final lesson to take your assessment and earn your badge!
examples.suggested: … um deine Prüfung abzulegen und dein Abzeichen zu erhalten!
examples.translation: Fahre mit der letzten Lektion fort, um deine Bewertung abzulegen und dein Abzeichen zu verdienen!
examples.why: "Bewertung ablegen" is not German — one legt eine Prüfung/einen Test ab. "Bewertung" is the grade, not the exam.

editor_note: Mathematically faithful throughout — every claim, condition and quantifier matches the English (POVM condition, "genau dann, wenn" for the iff on Δ_m, the p(a)=0 caveat, the three equivalent probability expressions), and the translation even silently repairs the English's loose "divided by one-half" to the correct "dividiert durch zwei". Nothing misleads, but a native technical editor would still change several things: "post-measurement quantum state" is rendered as the hybrid compound "Post-Messzustand" (lines 19, 21, 47) where German would use "Zustand nach der Messung"; "quantum information" appears as "quantenmechanischer Information" (line 291) although the frontmatter description already uses the conventional "Quanteninformation"; and "identity matrix" is consistently "Identitätsmatrix" rather than the standard "Einheitsmatrix" (defensible, but a calque). Additionally two sentences are stiff calques ("Dies erlaubt, die Ausdrücke … erscheinen zu lassen", line 429; "ergibt sie sich plausibel", line 486), the heading "Zustände bedingt auf Messergebnisse" (line 496) calques "conditioned on", the relative clause in line 47 attaches ambiguously to "Vektors" instead of the post-measurement state, and in the numbered list at line 570–574 the separable verb particle "auf." is stranded on its own line after the display equation, which will render as a one-word paragraph. Informal "du" register holds (line 483–484: "du bist eingeladen", "Versuche zunächst"), no Sie-slips.

examples.source: with no specification of the post-measurement quantum state of whatever system was measured
examples.suggested: ohne Angabe des Quantenzustands des gemessenen Systems nach der Messung
examples.translation: ohne Angabe des Post-Messzustands des gemessenen Systems
examples.why: "Post-Messzustand" is an English-German hybrid compound no German physicist would coin; German uses "Zustand nach der Messung". The qualifier "quantum" is also dropped.

examples.source: Classical information can be viewed as a special case of quantum information
examples.suggested: … als Spezialfall der Quanteninformation betrachtet werden
examples.translation: Klassische Information kann als Spezialfall quantenmechanischer Information betrachtet werden
examples.why: The field's German term is "Quanteninformation" (as used in this file's own frontmatter description); "quantenmechanische Information" is an over-translation and creates an in-file split.

examples.source: This allows for the expressions |b><b| and |c><c| to appear, which simplify to the identity matrix upon summing
examples.suggested: Dadurch entstehen die Ausdrücke …, die sich beim Summieren über b bzw. c zur Einheitsmatrix vereinfachen
examples.translation: Dies erlaubt, die Ausdrücke … erscheinen zu lassen, die sich beim Summieren … vereinfachen
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of "allows … to appear"; the causative "erscheinen zu lassen" is unidiomatic in German mathematical prose.

examples.source: While the equivalence of the first and third expressions … may not be immediate, it does make sense.
examples.suggested: … ist sie durchaus einleuchtend.
examples.translation: Obwohl die Äquivalenz von erstem und drittem Ausdruck nicht unmittelbar offensichtlich ist, ergibt sie sich plausibel.
examples.why: "ergibt sie sich plausibel" is not idiomatic German (plausibility is not something that "ergibt sich"); the English hedge "may not be" is also hardened into a flat assertion.

examples.source: We also have that the post-measurement state of X is obtained by normalizing the vector Π_a|ψ>, but we're ignoring the post-measurement state for now.
examples.suggested: …, doch den Zustand nach der Messung lassen wir vorerst außer Betracht.
