examples.source: Use Estimator to determine the expectation value of a single circuit-observable pair. / … expectation values of multiple circuit-observable pairs.
examples.suggested: … de um único par circuito-observável. / … de múltiplos pares circuito-observável.
examples.translation: Use o Estimator para determinar o valor esperado de um par Circuit-observável único. / … os valores esperados de múltiplos pares Circuit-observável.
examples.why: "circuit" is a plain common noun here, not an API name; leaving it as capitalized English clashes with "circuito" used elsewhere in the same file (lines 143, 235) and reads as an untranslated leak.

examples.source: ## Run parameterized circuits
examples.suggested: ## Executar circuitos parametrizados
examples.translation: ## Executar Circuits parametrizados
examples.why: English noun plus English plural -s inside a Portuguese heading; the adjective "parametrizados" is already agreeing in Portuguese, so the mixed form is jarring and inconsistent with "reutilização do circuito" in the sentence directly below it.

examples.source: Explore the batch [execution mode](/guides/execution-modes) and advanced options to optimize circuit performance on QPUs.
examples.suggested: Explore o [modo de execução em lote](/guides/execution-modes) e as opções avançadas para otimizar o desempenho dos circuitos nas QPUs.
examples.translation: Explore o [modo de execução](/guides/execution-modes) em lote e opções avançadas para otimizar o desempenho do circuito nas QPUs.
examples.why: The qualifier "em lote" is stranded outside the link, splitting the noun phrase; also "e opções avançadas" drops the article a native writer would use ("e as opções avançadas"). Meaning is intact — purely a fluency nit.

editor_note: The Step-1 overview sentence inverts the causal relation at the heart of the tutorial: EN "by cutting gates resulting in swap gates" (the cut gates are the ones that force swaps) becomes "prin tăierea porților, ceea ce generează porți swap" — i.e. the cutting itself generates swap gates. That teaches the opposite of the tutorial's thesis (cutting the distant 0–3 gates removes the four swaps and drops depth 103→46) and directly contradicts the later "subexperimentele QPD vor fi mai puțin adânci după tăierea porților îndepărtate"; the same clause also mis-attaches "și execută subexperimente" to the cutting rather than to "we". Beyond that, glossary substitution has left mid-sentence Title Case on common nouns ("un Circuit cuantic", "Qubiții 3 și 0", "pe unul sau mai multe Backend-uri", "cu Primitiva Sampler"), the "## Background" heading is left in English while every other heading is translated, and "extra sampling" is rendered "eșantionaj suplimentar" while the neighbouring clause uses the correct "overhead de eșantionare". Informal "tu" register holds throughout ("asigură-te", "consultă", "Folosește"), and core terms (valori de așteptare, porți îndepărtate, quasiprobabilitate, transpilat) are otherwise correct and consistent.

examples.source: we will simulate expectation values on a circuit of a certain depth by cutting gates resulting in swap gates and executing subexperiments on shallower circuits
examples.suggested: vom simula valorile de așteptare pe un circuit de o anumită adâncime tăind porțile care ar necesita porți swap și executând subexperimente pe circuite mai puțin adânci
examples.translation: vom simula valorile de așteptare pe un circuit de o anumită adâncime prin tăierea porților, ceea ce generează porți swap și execută subexperimente pe circuite mai puțin adânci
examples.why: Inverted causality on the tutorial's central mechanism: the English cuts the gates that WOULD require swaps; the Romanian says the cutting itself produces swap gates, and makes the cutting the subject that 'executes' the subexperiments. A learner would conclude that circuit cutting adds swaps (and depth), the exact opposite of the 103→46 result shown two sections later.

examples.source: quantum circuit / qubits 3 and 0 / on one or more backends / with the Sampler primitive
examples.suggested: un circuit cuantic / qubiții 3 și 0 / pe unul sau mai multe backend-uri / cu primitiva Sampler
examples.translation: un Circuit cuantic / Qubiții 3 și 0 / pe unul sau mai multe Backend-uri / cu Primitiva Sampler
examples.why: Glossary-substitution leak: Romanian does not capitalize common nouns mid-sentence. The Title Case reads as machine output and is inconsistent with the same words written lowercase elsewhere in the file ('circuitul original', 'operații cu un singur qubit').

examples.source: another two swaps to return the qubits to their initial positions
examples.suggested: alte două swap-uri pentru a readuce qubiții în pozițiile lor inițiale
examples.translation: alte două swap-uri pentru a returna Qubiții la pozițiile lor inițiale
examples.why: 'A returna' in Romanian means to return/give back a value (as a function returns); for moving something back to where it was, a native technical writer writes 'a readuce ... în'. Calqued English syntax.

examples.source: cutting results in the need of extra sampling ... sampling overhead
examples.suggested: tăierea implică necesitatea unei eșantionări suplimentare ... overhead de eșantionare
examples.translation: tăierea implică necesitatea unui eșantionaj suplimentar ... overhead de eșantionare
examples.why: 'Eșantionaj' is not the term used in Romanian statistics/quantum writing and is inconsistent with 'eșantionare' used in the very next clause and in 'coeficienții de eșantionare' (Step 4).

editor_note: Faithful overall — dates, names, figures and the two True/False answers all match, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout (vei înțelege, gândește-te, apasă pe triunghi), with no dumneavoastră slips. What a native technical editor would change: (1) the Heron row garbles "fast, high-fidelity two-qubit and single-qubit control" into "controlul rapid și de înaltă fidelitate al qubiților cu două și un singur qubit" ("control of qubits with two and one qubit"), which is incoherent rather than false, but obscures the standard single-qubit/two-qubit distinction; (2) "quantum-centric supercomputing" is rendered two ways in the same file — "supercalcul centrat pe cuantic" (accordion answer) vs "supercalculului centrat pe cuantică" (2022 row, twice); (3) "gate" is left in English throughout the Heron row ("rata erorilor de gate", "timpi de gate") where Romanian domain usage is "poartă (cuantică)". Smaller calques/imprecisions: "deja cuantice în natură" (calque of "in nature"), "million-plus qubit" inflated to "cu milioane sau mai mulți qubiți", "brute force methods" flattened to "metodelor brute", and "informed by domain-specific expertise" calqued as "informați de expertiza specifică domeniului", where the agreement also shifts from hardware/software onto the physicists and engineers.

examples.source: The signals required to enable the fast, high-fidelity two-qubit and single-qubit control are delivered with high-density flex cabling.
examples.suggested: Semnalele necesare pentru controlul rapid și de înaltă fidelitate pe un singur qubit și pe doi qubiți sunt livrate prin cabluri flexibile de înaltă densitate.
examples.translation: Semnalele necesare pentru a permite controlul rapid și de înaltă fidelitate al qubiților cu două și un singur qubit sunt livrate cu cabluri flex de înaltă densitate.
examples.why: "two-qubit / single-qubit control" was reparsed as "qubits with two and one qubit", producing an incoherent noun phrase that hides the standard single-qubit vs two-qubit operation distinction.

examples.source: quantum-centric supercomputing
examples.suggested: Pick one form and use it everywhere, e.g. „supercalcul centrat pe cuantic".
examples.translation: „supercalcul centrat pe cuantic" (accordion) vs „supercalculului centrat pe cuantică" (2022 row, twice)
examples.why: The same named IBM concept is rendered two different ways within one file; still recognizable, but a reader cannot tell they are the same term.

examples.source: having half the gate error rate ... and significantly improved gate time
examples.suggested: având o rată a erorilor de poartă la jumătate ... și timpi de poartă semnificativ îmbunătățiți
examples.translation: având o rată a erorilor de gate la jumătate ... și timpi de gate semnificativ îmbunătățiți
examples.why: „poartă (cuantică)" is the conventional Romanian term for gate; the untranslated English noun reads as raw MT inside otherwise fully translated prose.

examples.source: the million-plus qubit quantum computers of the future
examples.suggested: calculatoarele cuantice cu peste un milion de qubiți din viitor
examples.translation: calculatoarele cuantice cu milioane sau mai mulți qubiți din viitor
examples.why: "million-plus" (over one million) becomes "millions or more", overstating the roadmap target; also stiff Romanian.

examples.source: Simulation of physical or chemical systems which are already quantum mechanical in nature.
examples.suggested: Simularea sistemelor fizice sau chimice care sunt deja, prin natura lor, cuantice.
examples.translation: Simularea sistemelor fizice sau chimice care sunt deja cuantice în natură.
examples.why: "în natură" is a literal calque of "in nature"; in Romanian it reads as "out in nature" rather than "by their nature".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful overall and the informal register holds (no ครับ/ค่ะ), but a native technical editor would still change several things. (1) The "potential(ly)" hedge is dropped twice: "to potentially achieve better performance" becomes the flat assertion "เพื่อให้ได้ประสิทธิภาพที่ดีขึ้นในงานบางอย่าง", and "we can expect potential advantage from the PQK" becomes "เราก็สามารถคาดหวังได้ว่า PQK จะให้ข้อได้เปรียบ" — surrounding text does keep "ที่เป็นไปได้/ที่อาจเกิดขึ้น", so it stops short of misleading, but the quantum-advantage caveat is weakened where it matters most. (2) "feature" is split within the file: translated as "คุณสมบัติ" in the title/background ("พื้นที่คุณสมบัติเชิงควอนตัม", "คัดเลือกคุณสมบัติ") but left English in "feature space มิติสูงขึ้น" and "feature map"; "คุณสมบัติ" also reads as property/qualification rather than the ML sense (คุณลักษณะ). (3) "tutorial" is "บทช่วยสอน" throughout but becomes "บทเรียน" twice in the 80-minute QPU note. (4) Mixed-script inconsistency: "ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม" vs "ฮาร์ดแวร์ quantum จริง", "แบบคลาสสิก" vs "ชุดข้อมูล classical", "Circuit ควอนตัม" vs "quantum circuit". (5) Stiff calques: the heading "ประมวลผลหลัง" for "Post-process", the half-translated "งาน learning" in the appendix heading, and "เมื่อใดที่มีศักยภาพได้เปรียบเชิงควอนตัม" in the learning outcomes.

examples.source: This approach leverages the computational advantages of quantum systems to potentially achieve better performance on certain tasks compared to classical methods.
examples.suggested: วิธีนี้ใช้ประโยชน์…เพื่อให้มีศักยภาพที่จะได้ประสิทธิภาพดีขึ้นในงานบางอย่างเมื่อเทียบกับวิธีแบบคลาสสิก
examples.translation: วิธีนี้ใช้ประโยชน์จากข้อได้เปรียบเชิงการคำนวณของระบบควอนตัมเพื่อให้ได้ประสิทธิภาพที่ดีขึ้นในงานบางอย่างเมื่อเทียบกับวิธีแบบคลาสสิก
examples.why: "potentially" is dropped, turning a hedged possibility into a flat claim that quantum systems do deliver better performance. The same drop recurs in the appendix: "we can expect potential advantage from the PQK" → "เราก็สามารถคาดหวังได้ว่า PQK จะให้ข้อได้เปรียบ" (line ~927).

examples.source: encode classical data into a quantum feature space ... embeds our classical dataset into a higher-dimensional feature space
examples.suggested: Pick one convention: keep "feature space" in English throughout, or use "ปริภูมิคุณลักษณะ" consistently in both places
examples.translation: เข้ารหัสข้อมูลแบบคลาสสิกลงในพื้นที่คุณสมบัติเชิงควอนตัม ... ฝังชุดข้อมูล classical ของเราลงใน feature space มิติสูงขึ้น
examples.why: The same concept is rendered two ways in one file (translated "พื้นที่คุณสมบัติ" vs English "feature space"), and "คุณสมบัติ" reads as property/qualification rather than the ML sense of feature ("คุณลักษณะ").

examples.source: To make sure that the rest of the tutorial is easily executable ... you can continue the tutorial with your own results.
examples.suggested: เพื่อให้ส่วนที่เหลือของบทช่วยสอนนี้ทำงานได้ง่าย ... สามารถทำบทช่วยสอนต่อด้วยผลลัพธ์ของตัวเองได้
examples.translation: เพื่อให้ส่วนที่เหลือของบทเรียนนี้ทำงานได้ง่าย ... สามารถดำเนินบทเรียนต่อด้วยผลลัพธ์ของตัวเองได้
examples.why: "tutorial" is "บทช่วยสอน" everywhere else in the file (lines ~21, 27, 32, 40, 91, 96, 248, 1038) but switches to "บทเรียน" twice in this one paragraph.

examples.source: We also provide the results from an experiment that we ran on quantum hardware.
examples.suggested: เรายังแนบผลลัพธ์จากการทดลองที่รันบนฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัมจริงด้วย
examples.translation: เรายังแนบผลลัพธ์จากการทดลองที่รันบนฮาร์ดแวร์ quantum จริงด้วย
examples.why: Script mixing inside one compound: "ฮาร์ดแวร์ quantum" contradicts "ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม" at lines ~38 and ~329; same pattern with "ชุดข้อมูล classical" (line ~332) against "แบบคลาสสิก" elsewhere.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return result in desired classical format / Appendix: Verify the dataset's potential quantum advantage in learning tasks
examples.suggested: ขั้นตอนที่ 4: ประมวลผลภายหลังและคืนผลลัพธ์ในรูปแบบคลาสสิกที่ต้องการ / …0ในงานการเรียนรู้
examples.translation: ขั้นตอนที่ 4: ประมวลผลหลังและคืนค่าผลลัพธ์ในรูปแบบคลาสสิกที่ต้องการ / ภาคผนวก: ตรวจสอบศักยภาพของชุดข้อมูลในการได้เปรียบเชิงควอนตัมในงาน learning
examples.why: "ประมวลผลหลัง" is a bare calque of "post-process" and reads truncated in Thai ("ประมวลผลภายหลัง" is the natural form), and "งาน learning" leaves the noun half-translated. Same stiffness at line ~22: "เมื่อใดที่มีศักยภาพได้เปรียบเชิงควอนตัม".

editor_note: The Thai prose is generally fluent, informal (no ครับ/ค่ะ) and terminologically confident — it keeps eigenvalue/eigenvector/Hamiltonian/qubit/subspace in English and renders "ทแยงมุม" for diagonalize, "ขึง" for span, "การลู่เข้า" for convergence consistently — but two passages state something the English does not. (1) TH line 973 says "เราจะเลือกมิติ Krylov เล็กเพียง 5" (we will pick a Krylov dimension of only 5) where the EN says "a maximum Krylov dimension of 4" and the code cell immediately below sets `krylov_dim = 4`, so the prose contradicts its own setup. (2) TH line 1179 drops the anisotropic couplings from the Trotter paragraph: EN has "Pauli rotations R_xx, R_yy, R_zz with coupling strengths J_x, J_y, and J_z and a parametrized angle t ... e^{-i(J_x XX + J_y YY + J_z ZZ)t}", while TH writes only "ที่มีมุม parameter `t` ... $e^{-i (XX + YY + ZZ) t}$" — teaching an isotropic chain when the whole example (JX=1, JY=3, JZ=2, and the earlier "interaction between spins is different along different axes" paragraph) is anisotropic. Secondary, non-misleading issues: "If it is not already normalized, normalize it" is rendered three times (TH 115/138/175) as "ถ้ายัง normalize ไม่ได้ ให้ normalize" = "if it still cannot be normalized, normalize it"; "the sketch of a proof" becomes "การร่างหลักฐาน" (sketch of *evidence*) at TH 672 while the appendix correctly uses "การพิสูจน์"; "Claim 1" becomes "อ้างสิทธิ์ 1" (a legal claim) at TH 1701/1759; the frontmatter description abbreviates KQD as "(QKD)" (line 4) although the body says KQD; and TH 333 garbles "distinguish the residual from the dimension r" into "แยกความแตกต่างจาก residual กับมิติ...".

examples.source: We specify the number of Trotter steps to use in the time evolution. We also specify a maximum Krylov dimension of 4. This Krylov dimension is not large enough for realistic applications. But it is sufficient for this example.
examples.suggested: ... เราจะเลือกมิติ Krylov สูงสุดเพียง 4 ซึ่งไม่ใหญ่พอสำหรับการใช้งานจริง แต่เพียงพอสำหรับตัวอย่างนี้ และเราจะตรวจสอบการลู่เข้าที่มิติที่เล็กกว่านั้นด้วย
examples.translation: กำหนดมิติสูงสุดของ Krylov ที่ต้องการใช้ ... เพื่อบทเรียนนี้ เราจะเลือกมิติ Krylov เล็กเพียง 5 ซึ่งค่อนข้างจำกัดในบริบทของแอปพลิเคชันจริง แต่เพียงพอสำหรับตัวอย่างนี้
examples.why: Swapped quantity: the prose says the Krylov dimension is 5, but the EN says 4 and the code cell directly beneath sets `krylov_dim = 4`. The learner is told a setup that the example does not use.

examples.source: we insert Pauli rotations $R_{xx}$, $R_{yy}$, $R_{zz}$ with coupling strengths $J_x,$ $J_y,$ and $J_z$ and a parametrized angle $t$, which correspond to the approximate implementation of $e^{-i (J_x XX + J_y YY + J_z ZZ) t}$
examples.suggested: ... เราแทรก Pauli rotations $R_{xx}$, $R_{yy}$, $R_{zz}$ ที่มีค่าความแรงของ coupling $J_x,$ $J_y,$ และ $J_z$ และมุมแบบ parameter $t$ ซึ่งสอดคล้องกับการ implement โดยประมาณของ $e^{-i (J_x XX + J_y YY + J_z ZZ) t}$
examples.translation: ในทางปฏิบัติเราแทรก Pauli rotations $R_{xx}$, $R_{yy}$, $R_{zz}$ ที่มีมุม parameter `t` ซึ่งสอดคล้องกับการ implement ประมาณของ $e^{-i (XX + YY + ZZ) t}$
examples.why: The coupling strengths J_x, J_y, J_z are dropped from both the sentence and the operator, so the Thai describes an isotropic Heisenberg chain — contradicting the lesson's own anisotropic setup (JX=1, JY=3, JZ=2) and the `2*JX*t` rotations in the code.

examples.source: If it is not already normalized, normalize it.
examples.suggested: ถ้ายังไม่ได้ normalize ก็ให้ normalize เสียก่อน
examples.translation: ถ้ายัง normalize ไม่ได้ ให้ normalize
examples.why: "ยัง normalize ไม่ได้" is the potential reading ("still cannot be normalized"), making the instruction self-contradictory; the intended "not yet normalized" is "ยังไม่ได้ normalize". Repeated three times.

examples.source: We have already seen this from the sketch of a proof in the first section ... **Claim 1:** there exists a function $f$ ...
examples.suggested: เราได้เห็นสิ่งนี้จากการร่างบทพิสูจน์ในส่วนแรกของบทเรียนนี้ ... **ข้อกล่าวอ้าง 1:** มีฟังก์ชัน $f$ อยู่
examples.translation: เราได้เห็นสิ่งนี้จากการร่างหลักฐานในส่วนแรกของบทเรียนนี้ ... **อ้างสิทธิ์ 1:** มีฟังก์ชัน $f$ อยู่
examples.why: "หลักฐาน" is legal/forensic evidence, not a mathematical proof (the appendix correctly uses "การพิสูจน์", so the file is also inconsistent); "อ้างสิทธิ์" means asserting a legal entitlement, not stating a mathematical Claim.

examples.source: Krylov quantum diagonalization (KQD) is described, starting with classical Krylov methods.
examples.suggested: อธิบายวิธีการทแยงมุมแบบควอนตัม Krylov (KQD) โดยเริ่มจากวิธีการ Krylov แบบคลาสสิก
examples.translation: อธิบายวิธีการทแยงมุมแบบควอนตัม Krylov (QKD) โดยเริ่มจากวิธีการ Krylov แบบคลาสสิก
examples.why: The page description abbreviates the lesson's subject as QKD, which is the standard acronym for quantum key distribution; the body of the same file uses KQD throughout (lines 16, 537, 1671).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the CRN admonition keeps every condition intact ("Kapag ito ay ipinasa, ang mga backend at job mula sa instance na iyon lamang ang available" / "Kung hindi tinukoy ang isang instance, lahat ng backend at job sa lahat ng instance sa iyong account ay available"), the deprecated-package note keeps "parehong ... at ..." for "both ... and ...", and the qubit counts, retirement dates and processor-family facts all match. Terminology is consistent and correctly keeps the field's English (qubit, gate, backend, job, instance, packaging, fidelity, tunable couplers), register is casual with no po/opo. Two things a native technical editor would still fix: in the Falcon bullet "medium-scale na Circuit" carries a stray mid-sentence capital on "Circuit" (a glossary-substitution artifact — nowhere else in the file is a common noun capitalized), and in the Osprey bullet "kaysa sa Eagle sa 433 qubit" calques English "at 433 qubits" with a bare "sa", where Tagalog wants "na may 433 qubit"; the same sentence's "apat na beses na mas malaki" also reads a shade like 4x-bigger-than rather than "nearly quadruple the size", though it does not mislead about the scale.

examples.source: The Falcon family of devices offered a valuable platform for medium-scale circuits
examples.suggested: ... para sa mga medium-scale na circuit
examples.translation: Ang pamilyang Falcon ng mga device ay nag-alok ng mahalagang plataporma para sa mga medium-scale na Circuit
examples.why: "Circuit" is capitalized mid-sentence, inconsistent with every other English technical noun in the file (qubit, gate, backend, job all lowercase) — reads as an unedited term-substitution artifact rather than an authored choice.

examples.source: Osprey was nearly quadruple the size of Eagle at 433 qubits.
examples.suggested: Halos apat na beses ang laki ng Osprey kumpara sa Eagle, na may 433 qubit.
examples.translation: Halos apat na beses na mas malaki ang Osprey kaysa sa Eagle sa 433 qubit.
examples.why: "sa 433 qubit" is a direct calque of English "at 433 qubits"; Tagalog uses "na may" for a spec appositive. "apat na beses na mas malaki" also drifts toward "four times larger than" rather than "quadruple the size".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, and the core terminology is right and consistent (qubit/circuit/classical bit/ClassicalRegister kept in English, "measurement" consistently rendered as "sukat"/"sukatin", "idle" kept, register stays casual with no po/opo). The one thing a native technical editor would change is the genitive calque used for API-member headings: "Paraan ng `QuantumCircuit.measure`", "Klase ng `Measure`", "Paraan ng `measure_all`/`measure_active`/`random_circuit`" (7 occurrences, incl. the Next-steps list). In Tagalog "paraan ng X" reads as "X's way of doing things" rather than "the X method"; the idiomatic form is the linker "paraang `measure_all`" (or simply keeping "`measure_all` method"). Note the file itself is inconsistent about this: the heading says "Klase ng `Measure`" but the body sentence keeps "Ang Qiskit [Measure] class". Second, minor: "Sa default, ang paraang ito ay nagdadagdag..." is Taglish for "By default"; "Bilang default" (or "Sa karaniwan") is the standard rendering. Neither would mislead a learner.

examples.source: ### `QuantumCircuit.measure_all` method
examples.suggested: ### Paraang `QuantumCircuit.measure_all`
examples.translation: ### Paraan ng `QuantumCircuit.measure_all`
examples.why: "Paraan ng X" is a genitive calque of the English noun-adjunct "X method" and reads as "X's way of doing something". Tagalog marks the appositive with the linker -ng/na: "Paraang `measure_all`" or "`measure_all` na paraan". Repeated in all four API headings and in the four Next-steps bullets ("Klase ng [`Measure`]", "Paraan ng [`measure_all`]", etc.).

examples.source: ### `Measure` class / The Qiskit Measure class measures the specified qubits.
examples.suggested: ### `Measure` class (or "Klaseng `Measure`") — matching the body sentence, which keeps "class" in English
examples.translation: ### Klase ng `Measure` / Ang Qiskit [Measure] class ay sumusukat sa mga tinukoy na qubit.
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: the heading translates "class" to "klase" while the very next sentence keeps the English "class". Pick one convention; the body's keep-in-English choice is the more idiomatic one for a Qiskit API name.

examples.source: By default, this method adds new classical bits in a `ClassicalRegister` to store these measurements.
examples.suggested: Bilang default, nagdadagdag ang paraang ito ng mga bagong classical bit...
examples.translation: Sa default, ang paraang ito ay nagdadagdag ng mga bagong classical bit sa isang `ClassicalRegister` para maimbak ang mga sukat na ito.
examples.why: "Sa default" is a preposition-for-preposition calque of "by default"; "Bilang default" is the conventional Filipino technical rendering. Meaning is unaffected. (Note this sentence does use the idiomatic linker "paraang ito", which is exactly the form the headings should adopt.)

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ти" convention holds cleanly (звернись, Зауваж, Пам'ятай, дивись) — nothing here misleads a learner. But a native editor would change several things. "Circuit" is rendered two ways in the same file: as proper Ukrainian "схема" (тротеризованих квантових схем, квантову схему, тротеризованих схем) and as bare, undeclined English "Circuit" (Транспіляція Circuit для Backend; тротеризовані Circuit з 16 кубітами; транспілюємо Circuit до цільового Backend; з транспільованих Circuit) — the undeclined English nouns inside Ukrainian case slots read as glossary leakage, not as a writer's choice, and "Backend" behaves the same way (фіктивний Backend на 127 кубітів). "One-body" is likewise split: одночастинкові гамільтоніани / одно- та двочастинкових частин versus the calque однотілову еволюцію. There is a genuine grammatical error — "просто замін фіктивний Backend" (must be "заміни"; "замін" is not an imperative). Smaller slips: "рішеннях" where Ukrainian math takes "розв'язках", and "converges" flattened to "зменшується".

examples.source: Transpile the circuits for the backend / we will transpile the circuits to the target backend
examples.suggested: Транспіляція схем для бекенда / ми транспілюємо схеми до цільового бекенда
examples.translation: Транспіляція Circuit для Backend / ми транспілюємо Circuit до цільового Backend
examples.why: The same file already renders circuit as "схема" (тротеризованих квантових схем, квантову схему), so "Circuit" is an inconsistent second rendering. Worse, both English nouns are left undeclined inside Ukrainian case slots ("із Circuit", "до цільового Backend", "на цільовому Backend"), which no Ukrainian technical writer would produce — it reads as untranslated glossary leakage.

examples.source: allow for an efficient compilation of the one-body evolution
examples.suggested: дозволяють ефективно компілювати одночастинкову еволюцію
examples.translation: дозволяють ефективно компілювати однотілову еволюцію
examples.why: "One-body" is rendered "одночастинков-" twice earlier (одно- та двочастинкові гамільтоніани; одно- та двочастинкових частин гамільтоніана) but as the calque "однотілову" here. "Однотілова" is a literal body→тіло mapping; the physics term is одночастинковий. Recognizable, but inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: To run on a real QPU, just replace the fake backend with a real backend.
examples.suggested: Щоб запустити на реальному QPU, просто заміни фіктивний бекенд на реальний.
examples.translation: Щоб запустити на реальному QPU, просто замін фіктивний Backend на реальний.
examples.why: "замін" is not a valid imperative — the informal imperative of замінити is "заміни" ("замін" is only the genitive plural of the noun заміна). A hard grammatical error in an instruction sentence.

examples.source: The error from sampling Krylov basis states converges with increasing ``d``.
examples.suggested: Похибка від вибірки базисних станів Крилова збігається зі збільшенням ``d``.
examples.translation: Похибка від вибірки базисних станів Крилова зменшується зі збільшенням ``d``.
examples.why: "Converges" is a statement about convergence behaviour of the Krylov expansion; "зменшується" asserts monotonic decrease, which is a slightly different (stronger, simpler) claim than the English makes. Not misleading in context, but the technical nuance is flattened.

examples.source: the average occupancy of each spatial orbital across all batches' solutions
examples.suggested: середню заповненість кожної просторової орбіталі по всіх розв'язках пакетів
examples.translation: середню заповненість кожної просторової орбіталі по всіх рішеннях пакетів
examples.why: In Ukrainian mathematical/physical usage the solution of an equation or eigenproblem is "розв'язок"; "рішення" means a decision and is a well-known interference form. A native editor would change it on sight.

examples.source: as seen in the print statements above
examples.suggested: як видно з наведених вище результатів виведення
examples.translation: що видно з вище наведених виведень
examples.why: "вище наведених" inverts the natural Ukrainian order (наведених вище), and "виведень" as a plural noun for "print statements" is stiff and unidiomatic. Grammatical but reads as machine-assembled rather than written.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no dropped caveats, informal register (اختر / أنشئ / إضافتك الخاصة) holds — but the file is visibly a two-pass merge with a terminology seam at the first example. "Synthesis" is split between تركيب (intro: إضافة تركيب المصفوفة الأحادية، التركيب عالي المستوى، lines 39/46/47/53/54) and توليف (body: إضافة لتوليف الوحدانيات، التوليف عالي المستوى، lines 180/184/332/336), with "unitary" likewise split المصفوفة الأحادية vs الوحدانية/الوحدانيات, and "transpiler" split المُحوِّل (lines 37–160) vs bare Transpiler (lines 314/353/423); "gate" is بوابات الأساس at line 69 but Gate/Gates at 182/342. Separately, "pass manager" is rendered مدير المسارات ("path/route manager", lines 38/69/160) while "pass" is correctly تمريرة elsewhere (182, 353) — recognizable next to the English PassManager identifiers, but it invites conflation with the routing stage. Line 50 is grammatically broken: "الإضافات التي تحتل أسماءها محجوزة" is not parsable Arabic (and drops "also"); line 346 has the same problem with "ولم يتحدد بعد أي Qubits المادية".

examples.source: unitary synthesis plugin / high-level synthesis plugin
examples.suggested: Pick one convention for the whole file — e.g. توليف for synthesis and مصفوفة وحدانية for unitary — and use it in the bullet list, the reserved-names list, the headings and the body alike
examples.translation: إضافة تركيب المصفوفة الأحادية / إضافة التركيب عالي المستوى (intro) vs إضافة لتوليف الوحدانيات / إضافة للتوليف عالي المستوى (body)
examples.why: The intro bullets that tell the reader which plugin to choose use different words from the section headings that show how to build it, so the reader cannot match "إضافة تركيب المصفوفة الأحادية" to the section "إنشاء إضافة لتوليف الوحدانيات". Both renderings are defensible on their own; the split is the defect.

examples.source: The Qiskit SDK itself includes a number of plugins, whose names are also reserved.
examples.suggested: يتضمن Qiskit SDK نفسه عددًا من الإضافات، وأسماؤها محجوزة هي الأخرى.
examples.translation: يتضمن Qiskit SDK نفسه عددًا من الإضافات التي تحتل أسماءها محجوزة.
examples.why: "التي تحتل أسماءها محجوزة" is ungrammatical word-salad (a stray verb تحتل plus an accusative أسماءها with no working predicate); a native reader has to reconstruct the sentence. The qualifier "also" is also dropped.

examples.source: pass manager / the pass manager for a built-in transpiler stage
examples.suggested: مدير التمريرات (matching تمريرة already used for "pass" at lines 182 and 353), or keep PassManager in Latin script
examples.translation: مدير مسارات / مدير المسارات
examples.why: مسار means path/route, so "مدير المسارات" reads as a router/route manager — in a transpiler page that already has a routing stage this is an actively confusing choice, and it contradicts the file's own rendering of "pass" as تمريرة.

examples.source: ...the physical qubits in the target or coupling map that this operation is operating on has not yet been determined.
examples.suggested: ولم تُحدَّد بعدُ الكيوبتات المادية في الهدف أو في خريطة الاقتران التي تعمل عليها هذه العملية.
examples.translation: ولم يتحدد بعد أي Qubits المادية في الهدف أو خريطة الاقتران التي ستعمل عليها هذه العملية.
examples.why: "أي Qubits المادية" is a broken construction (أيّ cannot take a definite plural directly) and the verb does not agree; the future ستعمل also shifts the English present "is operating on". Grammatically jarring rather than misleading.

examples.source: follow the instructions at [Transpiler plugins]
examples.suggested: Use إضافات المُحوِّل in all three places (it is the same link target and the same page title)
examples.translation: في [إضافات Transpiler] (lines 314, 423) vs في [إضافات المُحوِّل] (line 146)
examples.why: The same cross-reference to the same page is labelled two different ways within one file, so the reader cannot tell they point at one destination.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing here would mislead a learner: the intro paragraph, the ecosystem sentence ("إضافةً إلى Qiskit وحزمه المرتبطة، ثمة نظام Qiskit البيئي") and all eight card descriptions track the English claim-for-claim, and the informal singular imperative register ("أهلاً بك", "ابنِ", "جرّب", "استكشف", "حسّن") holds with no formal-plural slips. Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) Grammar/agreement in the second paragraph: "سير عمل كمية" mismatches the masculine head noun سير with a feminine adjective — it should be "سير عمل كمي" or, more naturally for the plural sense of "workflows", "تدفقات عمل كمية". (2) "transpiler"/"transpilation" is rendered as "محوّل" / "التحويل" (frontmatter description, and twice in the Optimization card): consistent within the file and understandable, but "محوّل" reads as a generic "converter/adapter" and loses the compile-to-target-ISA sense the guide is pointing at; first use would benefit from the English term in parentheses, e.g. "محوّل Qiskit SDK (transpiler)". Neither defect changes what the page teaches.

examples.source: researchers can build, optimize, and execute quantum workflows
examples.suggested: يستطيع الباحثون بناء تدفقات عمل كمية وتحسينها وتنفيذها
examples.translation: يستطيع الباحثون بناء وتحسين وتنفيذ سير عمل كمية
examples.why: Gender-agreement slip: سير is masculine, so the feminine adjective كمية does not agree (it should be كمي, or the head noun changed to the plural تدفقات). Also, chaining three masdars onto one object (بناء وتحسين وتنفيذ سير عمل) is a calque of the English verb series; a native technical writer would attach the first verb and pronominalize the rest.

examples.source: transpilation … ready for execution with the Qiskit SDK transpiler … Explore transpiler details
examples.suggested: التصريف/الترانسبايل … باستخدام محوّل (transpiler) Qiskit SDK … استكشف تفاصيل المحوّل (transpiler)
examples.translation: التحويل … جاهزة للتنفيذ باستخدام محوّل Qiskit SDK … استكشف تفاصيل المحوّل
examples.why: Imperfect but recognizable, and used consistently across the file. "محوّل"/"التحويل" is the generic word for converter/conversion and does not convey compiling a circuit to a backend's native gate set and connectivity; glossing the English term on first use would keep the learner linked to the term they will meet in the Qiskit API and in the transpile guide.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — the long appendix (Tvrzení 1, the energy-error bound, the Chebyshev/p*(x) derivation) is genuinely native, well-inflected mathematical Czech, and no negation, quantity or caveat is inverted. What a native technical editor would fix is a cluster of untranslated capitalized glossary tokens dropped into Czech sentences where they break agreement and clash with the correct term used elsewhere in the same file: "vyžadují hluboké Circuit", "reprezentaci Circuit modifikovaného Hadamardova testu", "Circuit Hadamardova testu může být hluboký Circuit po rozkladu na nativní Gate", "výsledky spuštění Circuit", "Inicializuj Backend", "nový target pro Transpiler" — while the rest of the file correctly says obvod/obvody, hradlo/hradla. The same freezing hits "qubit", which stays uninflected in "Hamiltonián pro $N$ qubit", "všechny qubit systémového Hamiltoniánu", "připraví systémové qubit", "ve středním qubit", even though "qubity" is declined correctly in the transpilation section. Two term choices are imperfect: "measured either in the X or Y basis" → "v základně X nebo Y" (báze is the physics term; the file itself later writes "v energetické vlastní bázi"), and "overestimate" → "přehodnotit/přehodnocení" (= reassess; the antonym of podhodnotit is nadhodnotit), where the English "up to a point" qualifier is also dropped. Smaller: "vlastních hodnot a vlastních stavů $H$ pohledem na vlastní hodnoty $\tilde{H}$" drops eigenstates from the second half; "kde je zachováno množství elektronů" should be "počet elektronů"; "následujících střední hodnot" lacks case agreement; and the eigenvalue problem is called "problém vlastních hodnot" in Step 1 but "problém vlastních čísel" in Step 4.

examples.source: which require deep circuits ... / The Figure shows a circuit representation ... / The Hadamard test circuit can be a deep circuit once we decompose to native gates / Once we have the results of the circuit executions / Instantiate the backend / create a new target for transpilation
examples.suggested: vyžadují hluboké obvody / Obrázek ukazuje obvodovou reprezentaci modifikovaného Hadamardova testu / Obvod Hadamardova testu může být po rozkladu na nativní hradla velmi hluboký / Jakmile máme výsledky spuštění obvodů / Inicializuj backend / vytvoříme nový cíl (target) pro transpilaci
examples.translation: vyžadují hluboké Circuit ... / Obrázek ukazuje reprezentaci Circuit modifikovaného Hadamardova testu ... / Circuit Hadamardova testu může být hluboký Circuit po rozkladu na nativní Gate / Jakmile máme výsledky spuštění Circuit / Inicializuj Backend / vytvoříme nový target pro Transpiler
examples.why: Untranslated capitalized glossary tokens are spliced into Czech sentences with no declension ("hluboké Circuit" is ungrammatical), and they contradict the correct terms obvod/obvody and hradla used elsewhere in the very same file. Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native editor would replace all of them.

examples.source: the Heisenberg Hamiltonian for $N$ qubits / The bottom wire represents all the qubits of the system Hamiltonian ... prepares the system qubit in the state / a state with an excitation in the middle qubit
examples.suggested: Heisenbergův hamiltonián pro $N$ qubitů / Dolní linka představuje všechny qubity systémového hamiltoniánu ... připraví systémové qubity ve stavu / stav s excitací na prostředním qubitu
examples.translation: Heisenbergův Hamiltonián pro $N$ qubit / Dolní drát představuje všechny qubit systémového Hamiltoniánu ... připraví systémové qubit ve stavu / stav s excitací ve středním qubit
examples.why: "qubit" is frozen in the nominative singular where Czech requires genitive plural / accusative plural / locative, producing agreement errors a native writer would never make — especially jarring because the transpilation section inflects it correctly ("s dobře fungujícími qubity"). "drát" for circuit wire is also a calque; Czech circuit diagrams use linka/vodič.

examples.source: an ancilla qubit which is measured either in the X or Y basis
examples.suggested: ancilla qubit, který se měří buď v bázi X, nebo Y
examples.translation: ancilla qubit, který se měří buď v základně X nebo Y
examples.why: "základna" means base/foundation (or the base of a geometric figure), not a vector-space basis; the Czech physics term is "báze". The file itself uses the correct word later ("v energetické vlastní bázi"), so this is both an imperfect term and an internal inconsistency.

examples.source: it is preferable up to a point to underestimate this value rather than overestimate, since overestimating can allow contributions from high-energy states to corrupt even the optimal state
examples.suggested: do určité míry je výhodnější tuto hodnotu spíše podhodnotit než nadhodnotit, protože nadhodnocení může umožnit ...
examples.translation: je výhodnější tuto hodnotu spíše podhodnotit než přehodnotit, protože přehodnocení může umožnit příspěvkům z vysokoenergetických stavů zkreslit i optimální stav
examples.why: "přehodnotit/přehodnocení" means to reassess/re-evaluate, not to overestimate; the antonym of "podhodnotit" is "nadhodnotit". The contrast with podhodnotit still lets the reader infer the intent, so it is recognizable rather than misleading — but the English hedge "up to a point" is also silently dropped.

examples.source: One can then obtain estimates of the eigenvalues and eigenstates of $H$ by looking at the ones of $\tilde{H}$.
examples.suggested: Lze pak získat odhady vlastních hodnot a vlastních stavů $H$ pohledem na vlastní hodnoty a vlastní stavy $\tilde{H}$.
examples.translation: Lze pak získat odhady vlastních hodnot a vlastních stavů $H$ pohledem na vlastní hodnoty $\tilde{H}$.
examples.why: The English "the ones of H̃" refers back to both eigenvalues and eigenstates; the Czech narrows the second half to eigenvalues only, which slightly weakens the point the next sentence then relies on (the ground state is read off the eigenvector c⃗).

examples.source: chemistry Hamiltonians that describe stable molecule (where the number of electrons is conserved) / can be calculated by calculating the following expectation values
examples.suggested: ... (kde je zachován počet elektronů) / lze vypočítat výpočtem následujících středních hodnot
examples.translation: chemické Hamiltoniány popisující stabilní molekuly (kde je zachováno množství elektronů) / lze vypočítat výpočtem následujících střední hodnot
examples.why: "množství elektronů" (amount) instead of "počet elektronů" (number) blurs the U(1) particle-number-conservation argument the paragraph is making, and "následujících střední hodnot" is a case-agreement slip; neither misleads but both read as unedited output.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — meaning, quantities and the Bell-state pedagogy all track the English — but a Czech editor would rewrite several things. The file leaves core domain nouns untranslated AND German-style capitalized mid-sentence ("kvantový Circuit", "dva entanglované Qubity", "druhý CX Gate", "na konec Circuitu"), which reads as a glossary keep-English leak rather than a convention: the rest of the cs corpus uses "kvantový obvod" (45 files) and "hradlo" (100 files), and Czech never capitalizes common nouns this way. Line 45 mangles the product name — "virtuální prostředí s Qiskem" implies a base form "Qisk"; the corpus convention is "s Qiskitem" (20 files vs 2). Line 186 silently rewrites the link label: EN "Follow the steps in the [Run your first circuit on hardware] guide" became "[Hello world]", and the word "guide/průvodce" is dropped. Smaller calques remain ("byl vyvinut s použitím následujících požadavků", "pokud se tvoje prostředí Pythonu poruší", "Pro zobrazení histogramu"). Informal "ty" register holds throughout (Sestav, Stáhni si, Klikni, Zkus) with no Vy/Vám slips.

examples.source: Build your first quantum circuit … (two entangled qubits) … add a second CX gate … to the end of the circuit
examples.suggested: Sestav svůj první kvantový obvod … (dva provázané qubity) … přidej druhé hradlo CX … na konec obvodu
examples.translation: Sestav svůj první kvantový Circuit … (dva entanglované Qubity) … přidej druhý CX Gate … na konec Circuitu
examples.why: circuit/gate are left in English and capitalized like German nouns, which Czech never does for common nouns; the rest of the cs corpus renders them 'kvantový obvod' (45 files) and 'hradlo' (100 files), so this file is out of step with its own glossary. Recognizable, hence minor, but a native technical writer would change every occurrence.

examples.source: Download Python and use a virtual environment with Qiskit (recommended).
examples.suggested: Stáhni si Python a použij virtuální prostředí s Qiskitem (doporučeno).
examples.translation: Stáhni si Python a použij virtuální prostředí s Qiskem (doporučeno).
examples.why: 'Qiskem' is the instrumental of a non-existent 'Qisk' — the product name loses its final syllable. Correct Czech declension is 'Qiskitem', which 20 other cs files already use; only 2 files (this one included) carry the corrupted form.

examples.source: Follow the steps in the [Run your first circuit on hardware](/guides/hello-world) guide to run a circuit on real quantum hardware.
examples.suggested: Postupuj podle kroků v průvodci [Spusť svůj první obvod na hardwaru](/guides/hello-world) a spusť obvod na skutečném kvantovém hardwaru.
examples.translation: Postupuj podle kroků v [Hello world](/guides/hello-world) a spusť Circuit na skutečném kvantovém hardwaru.
examples.why: The link label was replaced with the page's older title 'Hello world' instead of the English label, and the noun 'guide/průvodce' was dropped. The destination is right, so it does not mislead, but the reader sees a label the English source no longer uses.

examples.source: The code on this page was developed using the following requirements. … if your Python environment becomes corrupted … To set up a virtual environment, navigate to your project directory
examples.suggested: Kód na této stránce vznikl s následujícími verzemi balíčků. … pokud se ti prostředí Pythonu poškodí … Virtuální prostředí nastavíš tak, že přejdeš do adresáře svého projektu
examples.translation: Kód na této stránce byl vyvinut s použitím následujících požadavků. … pokud se tvoje prostředí Pythonu poruší … Abys nastavil/a virtuální prostředí, přejdi do adresáře svého projektu
examples.why: Word-for-word English syntax: the nominal 'byl vyvinut s použitím' and the fronted purpose clause 'Abys …, přejdi' are calques a Czech technical writer would recast; 'poruší se' means broken/violated rather than corrupted ('poškodí se').

examples.source: ## 4. See what happens
examples.suggested: ## 4. Podívej se, co se stane
examples.translation: ## 4. Prozkoumej, co se děje
examples.why: The English heading invites the reader to observe the outcome of a change they are about to make (future/perfective); 'co se děje' is present-continuous 'what is going on', which flattens the cause-and-effect framing of the experiments listed underneath.

editor_note: The file is ~90% code; the handful of prose headings are semantically faithful (e.g. "Schnittpositionen finden, bei maximal 4 Qubits pro Teilschaltkreis. Dieser Circuit lässt sich durch einen einzigen Wire-Schnitt und das Schneiden eines `CRZGate` in zwei Teile aufteilen" matches the English exactly, and the sampling-overhead heading keeps the causal "durch das Schneiden dieser Gates und Wires entstehenden"). Two things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The closing sentence renders the product term "Qiskit pattern" as "eines Qiskit-Musters" — Qiskit Patterns is a brand/framework name the German-speaking Qiskit community keeps in English ("eines Qiskit Patterns"); "Muster" reads as a generic "pattern/template" and loses the link to the named workflow, even though the hyperlink still points at intro-to-patterns. (2) "circuit" is rendered inconsistently inside a single sentence-pair: "Circuit" (English) in "Einen Circuit und Observablen erstellen" / "Dieser Circuit lässt sich…" / "Den Circuit und die Observablen…", but the German compound in "Teilschaltkreis(e)" and in the image alt "Quantenschaltkreis-Diagramm". Not misleading — the concept stays identifiable — but the split should be resolved one way (either Circuit/Subcircuit or Schaltkreis/Teilschaltkreis). Register is fine: all headings are infinitive constructions, no Sie/Ihnen slips.

examples.source: Steps 3 and 4 of a [Qiskit pattern](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/guides/intro-to-patterns) can then be performed as in the preceding tutorials.
examples.suggested: Schritte 3 und 4 eines [Qiskit Patterns](…) können dann wie in den vorherigen Tutorials durchgeführt werden.
examples.translation: Schritte 3 und 4 eines [Qiskit-Musters](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/guides/intro-to-patterns) können dann wie in den vorherigen Tutorials durchgeführt werden.
examples.why: "Qiskit Patterns" is a named IBM workflow framework that the field keeps in English; "Qiskit-Muster" over-translates it into a generic word for "template" and severs the term from the linked guide. Recognizable, so MINOR, not misleading.

examples.source: Create a circuit and observables / … per subcircuit / Partition the circuit and observables into subcircuits
examples.suggested: Pick one convention: either "Circuit"/"Subcircuit" throughout, or "Schaltkreis"/"Teilschaltkreis" throughout (alt text "Quantenschaltkreis-Diagramm" should follow the same choice).
examples.translation: Einen Circuit und Observablen erstellen / … pro Teilschaltkreis / Den Circuit und die Observablen in Teilschaltkreise und Teilobservablen aufteilen
examples.why: The same root is English in "Circuit" and German in "Teilschaltkreis" within one sentence, which makes the whole/part relationship look like two different objects at a glance. Within-file inconsistency only — the concept remains identifiable, so MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats — and the domain terms are correct and consistent (Erwartungswert, Circuit-Observable-Paar, Primitives, Estimator, Batch-Ausführungsmodus, transpilieren, QPU), with du-form held everywhere. Two genitive slips read as unedited MT: "gängige Verwendungsweisen des Estimator" and "die Wiederverwendbarkeit des Circuit" both need the -s ("des Estimators", "des Circuits"), since both loanwords are otherwise declined as normal German masculines in this file. In the "Nächste Schritte" list, "Lerne, wie du lokal transpilierst, im Abschnitt [Transpile]" keeps the English adjunct order and strands the prepositional phrase at the end; and the bare imperative "Verstehe die Job-Limits …" is a literal calque of "Understand the …" that no German technical writer would use ("Mach dich mit den Job-Limits vertraut"). None of this misleads a learner; it is polish only.

examples.source: leveraging parameter values to increase circuit reusability
examples.suggested: … um die Wiederverwendbarkeit des Circuits zu erhöhen
examples.translation: und nutze dabei Parameterwerte, um die Wiederverwendbarkeit des Circuit zu erhöhen
examples.why: Missing genitive -s on the loanword 'Circuit', which the file otherwise treats as a normal German masculine noun (e.g. 'Circuit-Observable-Paare'). Reads as untouched machine output.

examples.source: The examples in this section illustrate some common ways to use Estimator.
examples.suggested: … einige gängige Verwendungsweisen des Estimators.
examples.translation: Die Beispiele in diesem Abschnitt zeigen einige gängige Verwendungsweisen des Estimator.
examples.why: Same uninflected-genitive slip; elsewhere the file writes 'Verwende den Estimator' with correct declension, so the form is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: Learn how to transpile locally in the Transpile section. / Understand the Job limits when sending a job to an IBM QPU.
examples.suggested: Lerne im Abschnitt [Transpile], wie du lokal transpilierst. / Mach dich mit den [Job-Limits] vertraut, wenn du einen Job an eine IBM QPU sendest.
examples.translation: Lerne, wie du lokal transpilierst, im Abschnitt [Transpile]. / Verstehe die [Job-Limits] beim Senden eines Jobs an einen IBM QPU.
examples.why: English adjunct order stranded at the end of the clause, plus 'Verstehe die …' as a bare calque of 'Understand the …' — grammatical but not idiomatic German instructional prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats (the "Open Plan users cannot submit session jobs" restriction, the pre/post-processing overhead sentence, and the PUB definition all survive intact), and the informal tú register is consistent ("necesitas", "Encuentra", "Define", "Consulta", "Ten en cuenta"). Two things a native technical editor would still change: (1) "primitive" is rendered as masculine "primitivo" ("el primitivo Estimator", "primitivos Qiskit Runtime V2", "bloques unificados de primitivos", "Practica con primitivos") whereas the es corpus convention and standard Spanish CS usage is the feminine noun "la primitiva / las primitivas" (225 corpus hits vs 105 for the masculine form) — internally consistent here, so recognizable but off-convention; (2) the heading "agregar gates parametrizadas" leaves "gates" in English, an anglicism the rest of the corpus avoids ("compuertas/puertas parametrizadas", 7 hits; this is the only "gates parametrizadas" in the es tree). Minor stylistic nit alongside these: "cualquier lenguaje o framework que soporte el trabajo con APIs REST" calques English "support" where "admita" reads more natively.

examples.source: You need at least one circuit as the input to the Estimator primitive.
examples.suggested: Necesitas al menos un circuito como entrada a la primitiva Estimator.
examples.translation: Necesitas al menos un circuito como entrada al primitivo Estimator.
examples.why: In Spanish CS, the noun for a fundamental building-block operation is the feminine "primitiva"; masculine "primitivo" is normally the adjective/noun meaning "primitive (early, unrefined)". Recognizable, but off the dominant convention of the es corpus ("la primitiva"/"las primitivas"), which this file departs from consistently (lines 45, 67, 137, 409).

examples.source: ### 3. Create a quantum circuit and add parameterized gates
examples.suggested: ### 3. Crear un circuito cuántico y agregar compuertas parametrizadas
examples.translation: ### 3. Crear un circuito cuántico y agregar gates parametrizadas
examples.why: "gate" is not a keep-in-English term in Spanish quantum writing — "puerta/compuerta cuántica" is well established and used everywhere else in the es tree (55 "puertas cuánticas", 34 "compuertas cuánticas"). The feminine agreement in "parametrizadas" even signals the writer had "compuertas" in mind.

examples.source: this workflow can be executed using any language or framework that supports working with REST APIs
examples.suggested: este flujo de trabajo puede ejecutarse con cualquier lenguaje o framework que admita el trabajo con APIs REST
examples.translation: este flujo de trabajo puede ejecutarse con cualquier lenguaje o framework que soporte el trabajo con APIs REST
examples.why: "soportar" for English "to support (a feature)" is a well-known calque; a native technical writer would use "admita" or "sea compatible con". Grammatical and understandable, purely a fluency polish.

editor_note: Faithful, natural technical Spanish with consistent conventions: English API/domain terms kept where the field keeps them (pass, pass manager, target, backend, ansatz, basis_gates) while prose terms are correctly localized (dynamical decoupling→desacoplamiento dinámico, basis gates→puertas base, scheduled circuits→circuitos planificados / planificación, timing information→información de temporización, mock backend→backend simulado, transpile→transpila/transpilador), and the tricky YGate paragraph ("sabemos *a priori* que `YGate` tiene la misma duración y error que `XGate`... aunque no sea una puerta base real de `ibm_fez`") preserves the emphasis, the *not*-a-basis-gate caveat and the reason `basis_gates` was saved separately; informal tú holds throughout (Obtén, Crea, transpila, consulta, Te recomendamos).

Nothing here misleads: the meaning is faithful throughout (feed-forward flow control → « contrôle de flux classique par anticipation (feed-forward) », the bidirectional QuantumCircuit conversion is preserved via « ... et inversement », the OpenQASM 3 block quote is rendered accurately), terminology is correct and consistent (portes, mesures, réinitialisations, transpilation, QPU, « lingua franca » kept in italics), and the informal "tu" register holds everywhere (consulte, Apprends, Lis, Visite) with no vous/veuillez slip. Two small things a native technical editor would still change. First, "Hardware engineers" is rendered « Les ingénieurs matériels », where the noun-apposition should stay invariable (« les ingénieurs matériel ») or be expanded (« les ingénieurs en matériel ») — as written the plural agreement reads as "material engineers". Second, « OpenQASM est le choix de nombreux publics » flattens the English "is the choice for a variety of audiences" into a slightly calqued genitive; « est le choix de publics variés » / « s'adresse à des publics variés » is what a French technical writer would produce. Both are cosmetic; no drift, no terminology error.

examples.source: Hardware engineers who design the classical controllers and waveform generators prefer languages that are practical to compile...
examples.suggested: Les ingénieurs matériel qui conçoivent les contrôleurs classiques...
examples.translation: Les ingénieurs matériels qui conçoivent les contrôleurs classiques et les générateurs de formes d'onde préfèrent des langages pratiques à compiler...
examples.why: In French the apposed noun 'matériel' stays invariable after 'ingénieurs'; the plural 'matériels' reads as an adjective ('material engineers') and is a visible calque of the English compound. The rest of the sentence is well rendered.

examples.source: OpenQASM is the choice for a variety of audiences because of its versatility.
examples.suggested: OpenQASM s'adresse à des publics variés grâce à sa polyvalence.
examples.translation: OpenQASM est le choix de nombreux publics en raison de sa polyvalence.
examples.why: 'le choix de nombreux publics' is a genitive calque of 'the choice for ... audiences' and also swaps 'a variety of' for 'many'; meaning survives but the phrasing is stiffer than a French technical writer would use.

editor_note: Translation is accurate, consistently informal ("tu"), and terminology is correct and stable throughout (qubit, portes de base, carte de couplage, modèle de bruit, simulations bruitées, vecteur d'état, matrice densité, réseau de tenseurs; "transpiler", "backend", "fake backends", "shots" and primitive names kept in English, which matches French Qiskit usage). Two small editorial points, neither misleading. (1) The Aer method list twice uses the calque "échantillonner les résultats de mesure depuis des circuits *idéaux* / *bruités*"; a native technical writer would write "à partir de circuits" — "depuis" marks time/place origin, not the source you sample from. (2) In the "extended_stabilizer" bullet, EN "decomposing the state into a ranked-stabilizer state" becomes "la décomposition de l'état en une somme d'états stabilisateurs de rang limité", adding "somme" and "de rang limité"; the added "rang limité" sits awkwardly beside the very next sentence "Le nombre de termes croît avec le nombre de portes non-Clifford (T)". Minor stiffness elsewhere ("Un simulateur d'état stabilisateur de Clifford efficace") is defensible and not counted.

examples.source: A dense statevector simulation that can sample measurement outcomes from *ideal* circuits with all measurements at the end of the circuit.
examples.suggested: ... qui peut échantillonner les résultats de mesure à partir de circuits *idéaux* dont toutes les mesures se trouvent à la fin du circuit.
examples.translation: Une simulation par vecteur d'état dense qui peut échantillonner les résultats de mesure depuis des circuits *idéaux* avec toutes les mesures à la fin du circuit.
examples.why: "échantillonner ... depuis des circuits" is an English-shaped calque ("sample from"); French uses "à partir de" for the source of a sampling. It occurs twice (statevector and density_matrix bullets), so it reads as MT rather than as written French.

examples.source: An approximate simulator for Clifford + T circuits based on decomposing the state into a ranked-stabilizer state. The number of terms grows with the number of non-Clifford (T) gates.
examples.suggested: ... basé sur la décomposition de l'état en une somme d'états stabilisateurs (décomposition de rang fini). Le nombre de termes croît ...
examples.translation: Un simulateur approché pour les circuits Clifford + T, basé sur la décomposition de l'état en une somme d'états stabilisateurs de rang limité. Le nombre de termes croît avec le nombre de portes non-Clifford (T).
examples.why: "de rang limité" is added material not in the English "ranked-stabilizer state", and it half-contradicts the following sentence saying the number of terms grows with the count of T gates. Not misleading in substance (the method is approximate), but a qualifier the English does not assert.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, and the physics claims (ideal ⟨Z_i⟩ = +1, subcircuits "פחות רגישים לרעש", observable acting trivially as I on the added qubit, upstream measured / downstream prepared in the eigenstate) all survive intact — but several terms are off. "parameterized" becomes "מפורמט" (= *formatted*, disk-formatting sense) instead of "מפורמטר"/"תלוי בפרמטרים"; "backend" appears once as the non-word "הלקצה" ("קבוצת שערי הבסיס של הלקצה") and elsewhere is dissolved into "חומרה", and "transpile" is rendered as "מעבירים/העברה" (= transfer) in both the heading and the body; upstream/downstream become the coined calques "המעגל הזרם-עלי"/"המעגל הזרם-תחתי"; "post-process" becomes the dangling "עיבוד לאחר" in the Step 4 heading and loses its "post-" entirely in the Background ("עיבוד קלאסי מסוים"); and "Periodic boundary conditions" is "תנאי שפה תקופתיים" (should be מחזוריים — תנאי שפה itself is correct). Naturalness slips in a few places into raw-MT syntax — the Prerequisites line "אנחנו מציעים שהמשתמשים יהיו מכירים את הנושא הבא לפני עבור מדריך זה" is ungrammatical, and passives are calqued ("הנצפה חייב להיות מורחב", "המעגל צריך להיות מסומן" instead of "יש להרחיב/לסמן"), plus "נצפה-המשנה" where Hebrew wants "תת-הנצפה" and a plural→singular register slip in Next steps ("אם מצאת... שתתעניין" against "שימו לב/ודאו" elsewhere). None of this would make a learner form a false belief, but a native technical editor would rewrite all of the above.

examples.source: The MBL circuit is a hardware-efficient circuit and is parameterized by two parameters $\theta$ and $\vec{\phi}$.
examples.suggested: מעגל MBL הוא מעגל יעיל לחומרה, והוא מפורמטר בשני פרמטרים $\theta$ ו-$\vec{\phi}$.
examples.translation: מעגל MBL הוא מעגל יעיל לחומרה והוא מפורמט על ידי שני פרמטרים $\theta$ ו-$\vec{\phi}$.
examples.why: "מפורמט" means *formatted* (as in formatting a disk), not *parameterized*; the intended word is "מפורמטר" (or "תלוי בשני פרמטרים"). Recoverable from the immediately following "שני פרמטרים", so imperfect rather than misleading.

examples.source: #### Transpile the circuits onto the backend … we transpile the circuit into the basis gate set of the backend:
examples.suggested: #### טרנספילציה של המעגלים אל הבקאנד … אנחנו מבצעים טרנספילציה של המעגל לקבוצת שערי הבסיס של הבקאנד (backend):
examples.translation: #### העברת המעגלים להתאמה לחומרה … אנחנו מעבירים את המעגל לקבוצת שערי הבסיס של הלקצה:
examples.why: "הלקצה" is not a Hebrew word — a garbled rendering of backend, which is elsewhere dissolved into "חומרה", so the term is both broken and inconsistent within the file. "מעבירים" (transfer) is also the wrong verb for transpile.

examples.source: We suggest that users are familiar with the following topic before going through this tutorial:
examples.suggested: מומלץ להכיר את הנושא הבא לפני שמתחילים במדריך זה:
examples.translation: אנחנו מציעים שהמשתמשים יהיו מכירים את הנושא הבא לפני עבור מדריך זה:
examples.why: Ungrammatical Hebrew: "יהיו מכירים" is not a valid verb form (should be "יכירו"), and "לפני עבור מדריך זה" is a word-for-word calque that misreads "going through" as the preposition "עבור". Reads as raw MT.

examples.source: for each cut the upstream circuit must be measured in a Pauli basis, and the downstream circuit must be prepared in the eigenstate of the basis
examples.suggested: בכל חיתוך יש למדוד את המעגל שלפני החיתוך (upstream) בבסיס Pauli, ולהכין את המעגל שאחרי החיתוך (downstream) במצב העצמי של הבסיס
examples.translation: עבור כל חיתוך המעגל הזרם-עלי חייב להימדד בבסיס Pauli, והמעגל הזרם-תחתי חייב להיות מוכן במצב העצמי של הבסיס
examples.why: "הזרם-עלי"/"הזרם-תחתי" are invented calques of upstream/downstream that no Hebrew quantum text uses; the relation is guessable but a native writer would say "לפני/אחרי החיתוך" or keep the English in parentheses. The passives "חייב להימדד / חייב להיות מוכן" are also English syntax.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return result in desired classical format … the final result is obtained by some classical post-processing over the outcome of each subcircuit
examples.suggested: שלב 4: עיבוד לאחר-מעשה והחזרת התוצאה בפורמט קלאסי רצוי … התוצאה הסופית מתקבלת מעיבוד קלאסי לאחר-מעשה (post-processing) של תוצאת כל מעגל משנה
examples.translation: שלב 4: עיבוד לאחר והחזרת תוצאה בפורמט קלאסי רצוי … התוצאה הסופית מתקבלת על ידי עיבוד קלאסי מסוים על תוצאת כל מעגל משנה
examples.why: "עיבוד לאחר" is a dangling fragment ("processing after" — after what?), and in the Background the "post-" is dropped entirely, weakening the point that the classical work happens *after* the subcircuits run. A dropped qualifier plus a broken heading term.

examples.source: [Periodic boundary conditions with circuit cutting]
examples.suggested: [תנאי שפה מחזוריים עם חיתוך מעגלים]
examples.translation: [תנאי שפה תקופתיים עם חיתוך מעגלים]
examples.why: "תנאי שפה" for boundary conditions is correct, but "תקופתיים" means *occasional / of an era*; the physics term for periodic is "מחזוריים". A recognizable-but-wrong literal choice in a cross-tutorial link title.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no dropped caveats that would mislead, and the conceptual core (שזירה, e-bit, מצבי Bell, אקראיות משותפת, אי-מקומיות, אי-שוויון CHSH) is correct and consistent. What a native technical editor would change is mechanical Hebrew: "אלו הם אבנות יסוד של מידע קוונטי" uses the non-word "אבנות" (correct construct plural is "אבני יסוד"); "settings" in the Alice/Bob paragraph is rendered twice as "הגדרות" (a false friend that reads as "definitions"/"config settings" instead of contexts — "הקשרים"/"תרחישים"); and "שני סיביות" (line 58) has the wrong gender numeral, contradicting the correct "שתי סיביות" three lines later. "qubit" is kept in Latin script (a defensible convention here) but is cased inconsistently within the file — "שני qubit" vs "ה-Qubit" vs "ל-Qubit". A few calques remain: "יש טבע זה" for "have this nature", "להשיג משימות" for "accomplish tasks" (Hebrew collocation is "לבצע/להשלים משימות"), "דוגמאות חשובות ביסודיות שלהן" for "fundamentally important", and the preliminary-comments sentence (line 26) is left as a fragment because "are in order" was dropped. Register is correctly informal.

examples.source: Rather, they are stones in the foundation of quantum information.
examples.suggested: אלא שהם אבני יסוד של המידע הקוונטי.
examples.translation: אלו הם אבנות יסוד של מידע קוונטי.
examples.why: "אבנות" is not a valid Hebrew plural/construct form of אבן; the idiom is "אבני יסוד". The contrastive "Rather" (אלא) is also dropped.

examples.source: which is typical of a wide range of settings — but in other settings they may be in competition
examples.suggested: מצב אופייני במגוון רחב של הקשרים — אך בהקשרים אחרים הם עשויים להיות ביחסי תחרות
examples.translation: מצב אופייני במגוון רחב של הגדרות — אך בהגדרות אחרות הם עשויים להיות ביחסי תחרות
examples.why: "settings" here means contexts/scenarios; "הגדרות" is a false friend that a Hebrew reader parses as "definitions" or software configuration settings. Same paragraph also flattens "consistent or harmonious" to just "עקביות או לא".

examples.source: this example of a probabilistic state of two bits
examples.suggested: נתקלנו קודם לכן גם בדוגמה זו של מצב הסתברותי של שתי סיביות
examples.translation: נזכרנו גם בדוגמה זו של מצב הסתברותי של שני סיביות
examples.why: סיבית is feminine, so the numeral must be "שתי" — and line 66 already writes "שתי סיביות" correctly, so the file contradicts itself. "נזכרנו" (we remembered) also misrenders "we previously encountered".

examples.source: two qubits / the other qubit / names for the qubits
examples.suggested: pick one form and hold it (e.g. lowercase "qubit" throughout, or קיוביטים throughout)
examples.translation: שני qubit … ה-Qubit השני … שני qubit … ל-Qubit
examples.why: Keeping the term in Latin script is a defensible convention, but the casing flips between "qubit" and "Qubit" within the same file, which reads as unedited output rather than a chosen house style.

examples.source: entanglement is viewed as a resource through which different tasks can be accomplished
examples.suggested: לראות בשזירה משאב שבאמצעותו ניתן לבצע משימות שונות
examples.translation: להסתכל על שזירה כמשאב דרכו ניתן להשיג משימות שונות
examples.why: "להשיג משימות" is a literal calque of "accomplish tasks" and is not a Hebrew collocation (it reads as "obtain tasks"); "לבצע/להשלים משימות" is the natural pairing.

examples.source: Before proceeding to the examples themselves, a few preliminary comments that connect to all three examples are in order.
examples.suggested: לפני שנמשיך לדוגמאות עצמן, ראוי להקדים כמה הערות הנוגעות לשלוש הדוגמאות כולן.
examples.translation: לפני שנמשיך לדוגמאות עצמן, מספר הערות מקדימות המתחברות לשלוש הדוגמאות כולן.
examples.why: "are in order" was dropped, leaving a verbless fragment; the sentence loses its function as a signpost to the reader.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, no dropped caveats — and the informal "kamu" register holds consistently ("kamu perlu bisa mengontrol alur program kuantum"). What a native editor would change is cosmetic-but-visible: kept-English glossary terms are capitalized mid-sentence as if they were proper nouns ("agar Gate kuantum bisa dikondisikan", "dynamic Circuit kuantum", "Bangun Circuit stabilizer bit-flip", "Buat ISA Circuit"), and the same sentence in Step 2 mixes both cases ("menerima Circuit dan observable … disebut sebagai ISA circuit"). "Encode" is rendered three ways in adjacent paragraphs — "qubit yang telah diencode", "mengenkode $k$ qubit logis", "qubit encoding" — recognizable but inconsistent. Two calques remain: "Kode stabilizer secara kritis berfokus" for "critically focus" (here English means "crucially/essentially", not "in a critical manner") and the literal "dan satu tanpa koreksi" for "and one without correction". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: quantum gates can be conditioned on measurement results / dynamic quantum circuit / Build a bit-flip stabilizer circuit / Generate ISA circuits
examples.suggested: agar gate kuantum bisa dikondisikan … / circuit kuantum dinamis / Bangun circuit stabilizer bit-flip / Buat ISA circuit
examples.translation: agar Gate kuantum bisa dikondisikan … / dynamic Circuit kuantum / Bangun Circuit stabilizer bit-flip / Buat ISA Circuit
examples.why: Kept-English domain terms are capitalized mid-sentence like proper nouns; Indonesian technical prose keeps them lowercase, and line 163 uses both cases in one sentence ("menerima Circuit dan observable … disebut sebagai ISA circuit").

examples.source: encoded qubit / encodes $k$ logical qubits / encoding qubits
examples.suggested: pick one stem, e.g. qubit yang telah dienkode / mengenkode $k$ qubit logis / qubit pengenkode
examples.translation: qubit yang telah diencode / mengenkode $k$ qubit logis / qubit encoding
examples.why: Three different renderings of the same verb within a few paragraphs; "diencode" is a non-standard hybrid form next to the properly affixed "mengenkode".

examples.source: Stabilizer codes critically focus on correcting a discrete error set
examples.suggested: Fokus utama kode stabilizer adalah mengoreksi sekumpulan kesalahan diskrit
examples.translation: Kode stabilizer secara kritis berfokus pada pengoreksian sekumpulan kesalahan diskrit
examples.why: "critically" here means "crucially/essentially", not "in a critical manner"; "secara kritis berfokus" is a calque a native technical writer would not produce, and the nominalization "pengoreksian" adds stiffness.

examples.source: Run the version with correction applied and one without correction.
examples.suggested: Jalankan versi dengan koreksi dan versi tanpa koreksi.
examples.translation: Jalankan versi dengan koreksi yang diterapkan dan satu tanpa koreksi.
examples.why: "dan satu tanpa koreksi" copies English's pronominal "one"; Indonesian repeats the noun ("versi") instead — the current phrasing reads as MT.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and core terminology is right and consistent (nilai ekspektasi, keadaan kuantum, observable/backend/hardware kept in English, "kamu" register held everywhere) — nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native editor would change: (1) "circuit" is kept in English but capitalized mid-sentence every time ("pengambilan sampel Circuit", "Circuit kuantum", "menjalankan Circuit pada QPU IBM"), which reads like a glossary artifact rather than Indonesian technical prose — lowercase "circuit" or "sirkuit" is the convention; (2) heavy calqued use of "mereka" for inanimate classes ("mereka dibangun", "mereka diakses", "mereka harus diinisialisasi", "karena mereka yang terbaru") where Indonesian would use "keduanya" or drop the pronoun entirely. Two smaller wobbles: "by toggling options such as `resilience_level`" became "dengan mengaktifkan opsi seperti ..." (mengaktifkan = switching on, but resilience_level is a level to be set, not a boolean), and "for selecting which quantum computer to run on" became "untuk memilih komputer kuantum mana yang akan dijalankan", which literally says the quantum computer is what gets run.

examples.source: circuit sampling (`Sampler`) ... Sampler samples the output register from quantum circuit execution ... running circuits on IBM QPUs
examples.suggested: pengambilan sampel sirkuit ... eksekusi sirkuit kuantum ... menjalankan sirkuit pada QPU IBM
examples.translation: pengambilan sampel Circuit (`Sampler`) ... Sampler mengambil sampel register output dari eksekusi Circuit kuantum ... menjalankan Circuit pada QPU IBM
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English AND capitalized mid-sentence in every occurrence, so it reads as a proper noun / glossary token instead of the common noun it is. Indonesian quantum material normally uses lowercase "sirkuit" (or at least lowercase "circuit").

examples.source: they are the latest and are more commonly used ... They are built with the Qiskit `quantum_info` module ... except they should be initialized with an additional `backend` argument
examples.suggested: karena keduanya paling baru dan lebih umum digunakan ... Keduanya dibangun dengan modul `quantum_info` Qiskit ... hanya saja keduanya perlu diinisialisasi dengan argumen `backend` tambahan
examples.translation: karena mereka yang terbaru dan lebih umum digunakan ... Mereka dibangun dengan modul Qiskit `quantum_info` ... kecuali mereka harus diinisialisasi dengan argumen `backend` tambahan
examples.why: Repeated "mereka" for inanimate classes is a direct calque of English "they"; native Indonesian technical writing uses "keduanya"/"kelas-kelas ini" or omits the pronoun. "karena mereka yang terbaru" is also ungrammatical as written.

examples.source: you can take advantage of the latest advancements in error mitigation and suppression by toggling options such as the primitive's `resilience_level`
examples.suggested: ... dengan menyetel opsi seperti `resilience_level` pada primitive
examples.translation: kamu bisa memanfaatkan kemajuan terbaru dalam error mitigation dan suppression dengan mengaktifkan opsi seperti `resilience_level` pada primitive
examples.why: "mengaktifkan" means switching on/enabling, implying a boolean flag; `resilience_level` is a numeric level the user sets. "menyetel"/"mengatur" preserves the English "toggling options" sense without implying an on/off switch.

examples.source: they should be initialized with an additional `backend` argument for selecting which quantum computer to run on
examples.suggested: ... untuk memilih komputer kuantum tempat kode akan dijalankan
examples.translation: harus diinisialisasi dengan argumen `backend` tambahan untuk memilih komputer kuantum mana yang akan dijalankan
examples.why: As written it says "which quantum computer will be run", making the QPU the object of execution rather than the place execution happens. Grammatical and understandable in context, but the English relation is inverted.

examples.source: Acknowledging that most developers would not and should not be familiar with distilling such raw data into 0s and 1s
examples.suggested: Menyadari bahwa kebanyakan developer tidak akan dan memang tidak seharusnya terbiasa mengolah data mentah tersebut menjadi angka 0 dan 1
examples.translation: Menyadari bahwa kebanyakan developer tidak perlu dan tidak harus memahami cara mengolah data mentah tersebut menjadi angka 0 dan 1
examples.why: The English is descriptive-plus-normative ("would not and should not be familiar"); the translation turns both halves normative ("do not need to and must not understand"). The pedagogical point survives, but the observational half of the claim is lost.

editor_note: No semantic drift: the physics is faithful throughout (kicked-Ising setup, $h=\pi/8$ Clifford-angle caveat, "misureremo solo i primi 30 termini", the max_err_terms/max_obs_terms non-monotonicity caveats all survive intact), core terms are right and consistent (valore atteso, osservabile, gate, qubit, shot, twirling, post-selezione), and the informal "tu" holds (Consulta, visita, Ricorda, dovrai). The defect is a glossary leak: the plain English nouns "Circuit" and "Backend" are left untranslated AND capitalized mid-sentence in ~9 places ("le misurazioni nel Circuit", "per l'intero Circuit", "dal Circuit inscatolato", "Il numero di Circuit casuali", "Se il tuo Circuit rumoroso", "Transpilarlo sul Backend", "fornirgli il Backend"), even though the same file otherwise writes "circuito"/"backend" correctly — the capitalisation makes a learner read them as API class names rather than ordinary words. Secondary: "layer" is rendered as "layer" in most bullets but as "strato" in the QuantumProgram section ("ogni strato di rumore", "gli strati di rumore"), and "boxed circuit" alternates between the calque "inscatolato" and the untranslated "box"/"le box" used everywhere else. One stiff calque: "gli utenti vorranno considerare" for "users will want to consider".

examples.source: we learn the noise model affecting the entangling gates and measurements in the circuit … so we can minimize the number of shots needed to learn the noise for the entire circuit. We use find_unique_box_instructions … to provide us the unique layers from the boxed circuit
examples.suggested: … le misurazioni nel circuito … per l'intero circuito … i layer unici dal circuito boxed (con box)
examples.translation: apprendiamo il modello di rumore che colpisce i gate entangling e le misurazioni nel Circuit … così da minimizzare il numero di shot necessari per apprendere il rumore per l'intero Circuit. Usiamo find_unique_box_instructions … per ottenere i layer unici dal Circuit inscatolato
examples.why: The ordinary English noun "circuit" is left untranslated and capitalised as "Circuit", so it reads as a Qiskit class name; the same paragraph writes "circuito" correctly elsewhere, making the term split within one sentence.

examples.source: `num_randomizations`: The number of random circuits to use per learning circuit configuration
examples.suggested: Il numero di circuiti casuali da usare per ogni configurazione del circuito di apprendimento
examples.translation: `num_randomizations`: Il numero di Circuit casuali da usare per ogni configurazione del circuito di apprendimento
examples.why: Worst instance of the leak: "Circuit casuali" and "circuito di apprendimento" sit in the same clause, so the reader is invited to infer a distinction that does not exist in the English.

examples.source: We set each noise layer's scale to `0.0` … This just maps noise layers to the associated noise model.
examples.suggested: Impostiamo la scala di ogni layer di rumore a `0.0` … Mappa semplicemente i layer di rumore al modello di rumore associato.
examples.translation: Impostiamo la scala di ogni strato di rumore a `0.0` … Mappa semplicemente gli strati di rumore al modello di rumore associato.
