examples.why: "layer" is kept in English everywhere else in the file ("Tutti i layer di rumore devono essere scalati", "i layer unici", "layer del circuito"); switching to "strato" only here is an unmotivated within-file split of the same concept.

examples.source: In addition to the primary inputs, users will want to consider:
examples.suggested: Oltre agli input principali, conviene considerare anche:
examples.translation: Oltre agli input primari, gli utenti vorranno considerare:
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of the English future "will want to"; Italian technical prose uses an impersonal "conviene/è opportuno considerare" — the current form reads as machine-rendered English.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout and mostly idiomatic: the tricky negations survive intact ("Problems do not have to be mapped to device topology" → "I problemi non devono necessariamente essere mappati alla topologia del dispositivo"; "not a hard limitation but represents rough thresholds" → "non è un limite assoluto, ma rappresenta soglie indicative"), and the informal "tu" holds everywhere (autenticati, decommentando, avrai bisogno). Three things a native technical editor would still change: (1) the Next-steps bullet has a broken elision, "Richiedi l'accesso all'[Q-CTRL Optimization Solver.]" — "all'" before the consonant Q is ungrammatical (al / all'Optimization Solver di Q-CTRL); (2) the graph-theory term "cover" is left in raw English and inflected as an Italian masculine noun ("è nel cover", "un estremo del cover", "al vertice del cover") where Italian technical prose says "copertura" / "copertura di vertici" — consistent, so not misleading, but it reads as an anglicism; (3) "(QUBO)" is inserted in the constrained-optimization intro ("problema di ottimizzazione binaria quadratica non vincolata (QUBO)") where the English has no acronym — accurate, but an unrequested addition. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Request access to [Q-CTRL Optimization Solver].
examples.suggested: Richiedi l'accesso all'[Optimization Solver di Q-CTRL].
examples.translation: Richiedi l'accesso all'[Q-CTRL Optimization Solver.]
examples.why: "all'" elides only before a vowel; before the consonant Q it is a plain grammatical error a native editor would catch immediately.

examples.source: let $n_i = 1$ if vertex $i$ is in the cover (i.e., in the subset) … every edge in the graph should include at least one end point from the cover
examples.suggested: … se il vertice $i$ è nella copertura (cioè nel sottoinsieme) … almeno un estremo della copertura
examples.translation: sia $n_i = 1$ se il vertice $i$ è nel cover (cioè nel sottoinsieme) … ogni arco nel grafo deve includere almeno un estremo del cover
examples.why: Italian graph-theory prose uses "copertura (di vertici)"; keeping the bare English noun and inflecting it as Italian masculine is an anglicism. It is used consistently, so the concept stays identifiable — MINOR, not misleading.

examples.source: The prior max-cut example is a common quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem.
examples.suggested: … un tipico problema di ottimizzazione binaria quadratica non vincolata.
examples.translation: Il precedente esempio Max-Cut è un tipico problema di ottimizzazione binaria quadratica non vincolata (QUBO).
examples.why: "(QUBO)" is not in the English. The addition is factually correct and even helpful, but it introduces an acronym the source never defines here — an unrequested editorial insertion rather than a translation.

editor_note: Physics content is faithful — every number and claim checks out (12 Qubit/プラケット, 隣接プラケットは3個のQubitを共有, 21点スイープ, 21×12=252, 臨界角度 約0.3π, ノイズ下では 0.5π 以下なら相転移は観測される, 133→125/18, 156→144/21) and there are no inversions or dropped caveats. The damage is cosmetic glossary leakage: a misspelled English verb is spliced into Japanese prose at line 125 ("2QubitゲートをどのようにParalelizeするか" — should be 並列化), and two spurious glossary tokens are injected into line 211 that the English does not contain ("2QubitゲートのルーティングTranspile" for plain "routing the two-qubit gates", and "ネイティブCircuit接続" for "native connections"). Core terms are also split within the file: 回路 vs Circuit (line 141 "GEMプロトコルのCircuit" against 回路 everywhere else), ゲート vs Gate ("アダマールGate"/"2Qubitゲート"/"単一QubitGate"/"Gate・スケジュール"), and 結合マップ/プラケット格子 vs "Coupling・Map"/"プラケットLattice" at line 352. Line 211's opening sentence is also ungrammatical ("〜するには、通常…が含まれます"), and "Exact and noisy simulation" is rendered 完全・ノイズあり where 厳密 is the standard term. Register is correct throughout: plain desu/masu, no keigo.

examples.source: This partitioning determines how two-qubit gates can be parallelized
examples.suggested: この分割は、2Qubitゲートをどのように並列化できるか…を決定します
examples.translation: この分割は、2QubitゲートをどのようにParalelizeするか…を決定します
examples.why: A misspelled English verb ("Paralelize", not even correct English) is spliced into Japanese prose. 並列化 is the standard domain term; no Japanese technical writer would leave this token.

examples.source: routing the two-qubit gates to conform to the qubit connectivity of the hardware … the two-qubit gates are already mapped onto native connections
examples.suggested: ハードウェアのQubit接続性に合わせた2Qubitゲートのルーティング … 2Qubitゲートはすでにネイティブな接続にマッピングされています
examples.translation: ハードウェアのQubit接続性に合わせた2QubitゲートのルーティングTranspile … 2QubitゲートはすでにネイティブCircuit接続にマッピングされています
examples.why: Two glossary tokens ("Transpile", "Circuit") are injected where the English has no such word, inventing terms like "ルーティングTranspile" and "ネイティブCircuit接続" that do not exist in the field.

examples.source: Transpiling quantum circuits for execution on hardware generally involves a number of stages.
examples.suggested: 量子回路をハードウェアで実行するためにTranspileする処理には、通常複数のステージが含まれます。
examples.translation: 量子CircuitをハードウェアでTranspileするには、通常[複数のステージ](/guides/transpiler-stages)が含まれます。
examples.why: 「〜するには…が含まれます」 is ungrammatical (the 〜には/〜が含まれる pairing does not agree); the English's "for execution on hardware" is also flattened into ハードウェアで.

examples.source: A GEM protocol circuit is built using the following steps / it builds the plaquette lattice from the backend's coupling map
examples.suggested: GEMプロトコルの回路は、以下の手順で構築されます / Backendの結合マップからプラケット格子を構築し
examples.translation: GEMプロトコルのCircuitは、以下の手順で構築されます / BackendのCoupling・MapからプラケットLatticeを構築し
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: 回路/Circuit, ゲート/Gate, 結合マップ/Coupling・Map, プラケット格子/プラケットLattice all appear in both forms. The Japanese renderings dominate elsewhere, so the English leaks read as unedited residue.

examples.source: so the transition is at the edge of what this sweep can resolve
examples.suggested: このスイープで分解できる限界にあることを意味します
examples.translation: このスイープで解決できる限界にあることを意味します
examples.why: "Resolve" in the measurement sense is 分解する, not 解決する (to settle a problem) — a false friend that makes the sentence read as if the sweep were solving something.

examples.source: Exact and noisy simulation with Qiskit Aer primitives
examples.suggested: Qiskit Aerプリミティブを使用した厳密・ノイズありシミュレーション
examples.translation: Qiskit Aerプリミティブを使用した完全・ノイズありシミュレーション
examples.why: "Exact" simulation is conventionally 厳密シミュレーション; 完全 reads as "complete/full", which is a different property and weakens the contrast with ノイズあり.

editor_note: No misleading content: every claim, comparison, caveat and negation matches the English (the mirror-circuit caveats, the "no single method dominates" partial negation 「支配しているわけではない」, and the AI-vs-SABRE metric split are all faithful). The dominant defect is glossary leakage producing within-file term splits: "circuit" appears as bare English 「量子Circuit の」「Circuit を」「小規模Circuit」 (with a stray space before the particle) alongside the correct 回路 in the very same sentence; "qubit" is split between 量子ビット (2量子ビット深さ) and Qubit (20Qubit未満、Qubit数); "gate" between Gate (Gate数、基底Gate) and ゲート (SWAPゲート); "backend" left as 「Backend は」. Secondary: calqued word choices a native technical writer would replace — 「タイも可能です」「すべてのタイした手法がクレジットを受ける」 for ties/credit, 「評決として読むべきではありません」 for "verdict", 「同じ分断を反映」 for "the same split", 「トライアルを増やす」 for layout/routing trials; and one broken construction, 「さらなるチューニングには、ユーザーが…トライアルを増やすことができます」. Register is correct throughout (desu/masu, no keigo).

examples.source: Quantum circuit compilation transforms a high-level quantum algorithm into a physical circuit that respects the constraints of the target hardware.
examples.suggested: 量子回路のコンパイルは、高レベルの量子アルゴリズムを、ターゲットハードウェアの制約を満たす物理回路に変換します。
examples.translation: 量子Circuit のコンパイルは、高レベルの量子アルゴリズムをターゲットハードウェアの制約に準拠した物理回路に変換します。
examples.why: Untranslated 'Circuit' (with a stray space before の) sits next to the correct 物理回路 in the same sentence — a glossary leak that splits 'circuit' across the file (Circuit vs 回路). Same pattern for Qubit/量子ビット, Gate/ゲート, Backend.

examples.source: Ties are possible ... When a tie occurs, all tied methods receive credit, so the percentages for a given metric may sum to more than 100%.
examples.suggested: 同点になることもあります。…同点の場合は同点となったすべての手法をカウントするため、あるメトリクスの割合の合計が100%を超えることがあります。
examples.translation: タイも可能です：…タイが発生した場合、すべてのタイした手法がクレジットを受けるため、あるメトリクスのパーセンテージの合計が100%を超える場合があります。
examples.why: 「タイ」「タイした手法がクレジットを受ける」 is a direct calque of tie/receive credit; a Japanese technical writer would write 同点 and カウントする. Meaning survives, but it reads as MT.

examples.source: ...so it should not be read as a verdict on overall method quality.
examples.suggested: …1つの回路を2倍に伸ばしたものを試しているにすぎないため、手法全体の品質を判断する材料と受け取るべきではありません。
examples.translation: 単一のミラー結果は1つの回路の2倍バージョンをテストするものであり、全体的な手法の品質に対する評決として読むべきではありません。
examples.why: 「評決」 (legal verdict) and 「2倍バージョン」 are literal renderings that no native technical writer would use here; 判断材料 / 2倍に伸ばした回路 is the idiomatic choice.

examples.source: Rustiq ... produces the single best result on only a small fraction of the large-scale circuits.
examples.suggested: …Rustiqが単独で最良の結果を出す大規模回路はごく一部にとどまります。
examples.translation: …Rustiqは、大規模回路の一部でのみ単独での最良結果を生成します。
examples.why: The qualifier 'small' is dropped: 「一部でのみ」 reads as an unquantified 'in some cases', softening the English's 'only a small fraction'. Not misleading, but a lost qualifier.

examples.source: For further tuning, users can increase layout and routing trials.
examples.suggested: さらにチューニングしたい場合は、レイアウトとルーティングの試行回数を増やすとよいでしょう
examples.translation: さらなるチューニングには、ユーザーがレイアウトとルーティングのトライアルを増やすことができます
examples.why: 「〜には、ユーザーが〜できます」 is ungrammatical/stiff Japanese (topic marker mismatched with the potential form), and 'trials' as 「トライアル」 loses the sense of 試行回数; the actionable advice lands less clearly than in the English.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the CHSH derivation, the ±2 classical / ±2√2 Tsirelson bound framing, the "scales by parallel Bell pairs, not by a bigger circuit" argument, and the "국소 숨은 변수 이론" terminology are all correct, and nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native editor would change: (1) "Bell" is rendered two ways in the same file — "Bell 상태 / Bell 쌍" (lines 21, 24, 28, 260, 385, 392) but "벨 상태" at line 70 and "벨의 정리 / 벨 부등식" at lines 34, 36; pick one. (2) The course title "Entanglement in action" is calqued as "행동 속의 얽힘" (lines 28, 392), where 행동 means "behavior/deed" and misses the "in action = 실전/실제 적용" sense. (3) Honorific 시-forms slip out of the informal convention: "살펴보시길 권장합니다" (line 27), "생각하신다면 … 관심을 가지실 수 있습니다" (line 391). (4) Two stiff MT-flavored spots: the broken "이를 통해 … 유사합니다" connective at line 121, and the noun-stacked "단일 수동 선택 쌍" for "a single hand-picked pair" (lines 262, 387). Note also the glossary-driven mid-sentence English "Circuit / Qubit / Backend" with Korean particles ("Qubit를", "서브-Circuit") — consistent, so treated as a project convention, not a defect.

examples.source: We create the entangled pair by preparing the Bell state |Φ+⟩ …
examples.suggested: Bell 상태 $|\Phi^+\rangle$를 준비하여 얽힌 쌍을 생성합니다.
examples.translation: 벨 상태 $|\Phi^+\rangle = \frac{|00\rangle + |11\rangle}{\sqrt{2}}$를 준비하여 얽힌 쌍을 생성합니다.
examples.why: Within-file split: 'Bell 상태/Bell 쌍' is used everywhere else (learning outcomes, large-scale section, next steps), but this key sentence — the one that actually defines the state being prepared — switches to '벨 상태'. Not misleading, but the concept should carry one spelling.

examples.source: [Entanglement in action], a course lesson on Bell states and the CHSH game.
examples.suggested: [실전 얽힘] 또는 [얽힘의 실제 적용]
examples.translation: [행동 속의 얽힘]: Bell 상태와 CHSH 게임에 관한 강좌 레슨.
examples.why: '행동' renders 'action' in the sense of behavior/deed, not the idiomatic 'in action' = seen at work / applied. Reads as a word-for-word calque of a lesson title a Korean reader cannot match back to the source page.

examples.source: It is recommended that you familiarize yourself with these topics: … If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.suggested: 다음 주제를 먼저 살펴보는 것을 권해요: … 이 내용이 흥미로웠다면 다음 자료도 살펴보세요:
examples.translation: 다음 주제를 먼저 살펴보시길 권장합니다: … 이 작업이 흥미롭다고 생각하신다면, 다음 자료에도 관심을 가지실 수 있습니다:
examples.why: Honorific 시-forms (살펴보시길, 생각하신다면, 가지실) push the tutorial into deferential register instead of the file's intended informal instructional voice; the rest of the document stays plain, so these two spots stand out.

examples.source: … so the simulator response is qualitatively similar to what we expect from hardware.
examples.suggested: 그 덕분에 시뮬레이터의 응답은 하드웨어에서 기대하는 것과 질적으로 비슷해집니다.
examples.translation: 이를 통해 시뮬레이터의 응답이 하드웨어에서 예상하는 것과 질적으로 유사합니다.
examples.why: '이를 통해 … 유사합니다' leaves the connective dangling — 이를 통해 sets up a resulting action but the clause ends in a static adjective. Grammatically parseable, but no Korean technical writer would build the sentence this way.

examples.source: rather than a single hand-picked pair … not just on a single hand-picked pair.
examples.suggested: 직접 골라낸 한 쌍이 아니라 … 엄선한 한 쌍에서만이 아니라
examples.translation: 단일 수동 선택 쌍이 아니라 … 단일 수동 선택 쌍뿐만 아니라
examples.why: '수동 선택 쌍' is a four-noun stack that translates 'hand-picked' as 'manual selection' (an HMI term); it reads as machine output rather than the English's rhetorical contrast between one cherry-picked pair and the whole chip.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversion, no swapped quantity, no dropped caveat; the check/postselection logic ("검사 큐비트가 '0'으로 측정되면 유지, '1'이면 버립니다"), the anticommute/phase-kickback sentence, the 236배 fidelity figure and the 28% 사후 선택 효율 all match the English, and the polite 합니다체 matches the ko house register. What a native editor would change: (1) "error correction" is rendered "오류 수정" throughout ("완전한 오류 수정", "내결함성 오류 수정") — the field's standard term is 오류 정정 (and the sibling file tutorials/repetition-codes.mdx already uses 양자 오류 정정); 수정 reads as "editing/revision", recognizable but off-domain. (2) Core nouns are split three ways inside single sentences: "이 앙실라 qubit, 즉 검사 큐비트" and "GHZ Qubit과 검사 큐비트" (Qubit / qubit / 큐비트), plus Circuit vs 회로 ("Clifford Circuit"…"GHZ 회로"), Gate vs 게이트 ("Hadamard Gate" vs "아다마르(Hadamard) 게이트"), Pauli vs 파울리. (3) "shots" is 측정 횟수 in the Background but 샷 later ("이 샷들은 버려집니다"). (4) Two mild qualifier losses: "A very naive approach" → "가장 단순한 방법" (drops the pejorative), and "respects the hardware topology" → "고려합니다" (weaker than "respects"). None of these mislead a learner; they are polish items.

examples.source: …to catch faults with far less overhead than full error correction… than full fault-tolerant error correction
examples.suggested: 완전한 오류 정정보다 훨씬 낮은 오버헤드… 완전한 내결함성 오류 정정보다
examples.translation: 완전한 오류 수정보다 훨씬 낮은 오버헤드… 완전한 내결함성 오류 수정보다
examples.why: Korean quantum-computing convention is 오류 정정 (error correction); 수정 means editing/revision. Recognizable but off-domain, and inconsistent with the sibling tutorial repetition-codes.mdx which uses 양자 오류 정정.

examples.source: This ancilla qubit, or the check qubit, starts in the |+> state… the layout of the GHZ qubits and the check qubits
examples.suggested: 큐비트 (or a single chosen form) used consistently: "이 앙실라 큐비트, 즉 검사 큐비트", "GHZ 큐비트와 검사 큐비트"
examples.translation: 이 앙실라 qubit, 즉 검사 큐비트는 $\ket{+}$ 상태에서 시작하고… GHZ Qubit과 검사 큐비트의 레이아웃
examples.why: Qubit / qubit / 큐비트 appear in the same sentence; the same split affects Circuit vs 회로, Gate vs 게이트, Pauli vs 파울리. Not misleading, but no Korean technical writer would mix three spellings of the same noun within one clause.

examples.source: fewer shots than standard error mitigation … These shots are discarded.
examples.suggested: Use 샷 (or 샷 수) in both places
examples.translation: 표준 오류 완화보다 적은 측정 횟수 … 이 샷들은 버려집니다.
examples.why: 'shots' is rendered 측정 횟수 in the Background but 샷 in the results discussion, so the reader does not connect the paper's overhead claim to the shots being discarded later.

examples.source: A very naive approach to prepare the GHZ state would be to choose a root qubit with an initial Hadamard gate…
examples.suggested: GHZ 상태를 준비하는 매우 단순무식한(naive) 방법은…
examples.translation: GHZ 상태를 준비하는 가장 단순한 방법은 루트 Qubit에 Hadamard Gate를 적용하여…
examples.why: 'very naive' carries a pedagogical warning that '가장 단순한' (the simplest) loses — it even reads mildly positive. The next sentence still says it is a bad approach, so no learner is misled, but the setup-then-critique rhythm of the English is flattened.

examples.source: The error detection algorithm for GHZ state preparation respects the hardware topology.
examples.suggested: …하드웨어 토폴로지를 그대로 따릅니다 / 준수합니다.
examples.translation: GHZ 상태 준비를 위한 오류 검출 알고리즘은 하드웨어 토폴로지를 고려합니다.
examples.why: 'respects' is a hard constraint (the circuit is built only on existing couplings); '고려합니다' (takes into account) softens it into a heuristic preference.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — dates (1 Nov 2022 → 1 Apr 2023), quantities (4 langkah masa, 2 bit, 56 qubit), the QUBO objective list, and the `multiple_passmanager`-is-disabled caveat all survive intact, and "anda" is used correctly in the Setup section, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The recurring defect is a glossary leak: "circuit" is left as the capitalized English word mid-sentence in four places ("Circuit kuantum menganggarkan fungsi kos", "Jumlah bilangan Circuit", "ansatz Circuit kuantum", "pengoptimuman Circuit") where every other technical noun in the file is translated and standard Malay has "litar kuantum"; "Backend" is likewise capitalized mid-sentence ("pada Backend `ibm_torino`"), which is defensible as a kept-English term but not with a stray capital. Second, "hardware-efficient" is rendered two different ways: mis-parsed at the ansatz introduction as "satu adaptasi perkakasan yang disesuaikan dan cekap" (reads as "a customized and efficient hardware adaptation", losing the hardware-efficient compound), but correctly as "ansatz cekap perkakasan" later in Step 2. Third, the narrator pronoun flips from "kami" (Background, Step 2) to "kita" (Step 3, plotting paragraph) with no change in the English "we". Minor extras: "risk aversion" as "penolakan risiko" (lit. "risk rejection"; "keengganan/penghindaran risiko" is the finance convention) and "runtime" flattened to "masa sebenar" instead of "masa larian".

examples.source: the quantum circuit estimates the cost function / The total number of circuits / configures the quantum circuit ansatz
examples.suggested: litar kuantum menganggarkan fungsi kos / Jumlah bilangan litar / mengkonfigurasi ansatz litar kuantum
examples.translation: Circuit kuantum menganggarkan fungsi kos / Jumlah bilangan Circuit / mengkonfigurasi ansatz Circuit kuantum
examples.why: "Circuit" is left in English and capitalized mid-sentence in four places while every other domain noun in the file is translated; Malay has the well-established "litar (kuantum)". Reads as an untranslated glossary leak rather than a deliberate keep-English convention.

examples.source: a customized and hardware-efficient adaptation of the standard Real Amplitudes ansatz
examples.suggested: satu adaptasi ansatz Real Amplitudes standard yang disesuaikan dan cekap perkakasan (hardware-efficient)
examples.translation: satu adaptasi perkakasan yang disesuaikan dan cekap daripada ansatz Real Amplitudes standard
examples.why: The compound "hardware-efficient" is split so "perkakasan" attaches to "adaptasi", yielding "an efficient hardware adaptation" instead of "a hardware-efficient adaptation". The same term is rendered correctly as "ansatz cekap perkakasan" in Step 2, so the file is also internally inconsistent.

examples.source: we illustrate how to use / we extract and display / We plot both distributions
examples.suggested: pick one — "kita" throughout is the natural inclusive choice for tutorial prose
examples.translation: kami menjelaskan cara / kita ekstrak dan paparkan / Kita plot kedua-dua taburan
examples.why: The narrator pronoun switches from exclusive "kami" (Background, Step 2) to inclusive "kita" (Step 3 and the plotting paragraph) with no corresponding change in the English. A native technical editor would unify it.

examples.source: risk aversion / the risk aversion coefficient
examples.suggested: keengganan risiko / pekali keengganan risiko (or penghindaran risiko)
examples.translation: penolakan risiko / pekali penolakan risiko
examples.why: "Penolakan" means rejection/refusal; the Malay finance convention for risk aversion is "keengganan" or "penghindaran". Consistent and recognizable, so not misleading, but not the conventional term.

examples.source: NOTE: This is an estimate only. Actual runtime might vary.
examples.suggested: NOTA: Ini hanyalah anggaran. Masa larian sebenar mungkin berbeza.
examples.translation: NOTA: Ini hanyalah anggaran sahaja. Masa sebenar mungkin berbeza.
examples.why: "Masa sebenar" drops the "runtime" sense (and collides with the reading "real time"); "hanyalah … sahaja" is a doubled restrictive that a native writer would trim to one.

editor_note: The prose is otherwise fluent and the core convention is right and consistent ("boleh cerap" for observable, "formalisme penstabil", "penguraian spektrum", "anggaran fasa", weight = "berat" in the defining paragraph). The blocking defect is one sentence: EN "lower weight Pauli observables require smaller circuits" is rendered "boleh cerap Pauli **berpangkat rendah** memerlukan litar yang lebih kecil" — i.e. low-*rank*, not low-*weight*. This file itself uses "pangkat" for rank two sentences earlier ("pangkat lebih tinggi daripada satu", "pangkat $2^{n-1}$"), and every non-identity n-qubit Pauli observable has rank exactly $2^{n-1}$, so as translated the claim is false and severs the link to the "berat" definition that motivates low-weight stabilizers. Secondary, non-blocking: the hedge "apparent" is dropped from "apparent lack of interest in $Y$ errors" → flat "kekurangan minat"; "Preskripsi yang sama" is a calque of "The same prescription"; and inanimate matrices are referred to as "mereka" ("darab tensor antara mereka") where "antaranya" is native.

examples.source: This means that lower weight Pauli observables require smaller circuits to be implemented through this approach.
examples.suggested: Ini bermakna boleh cerap Pauli berberat rendah (berat yang lebih rendah) memerlukan litar yang lebih kecil untuk dilaksanakan melalui pendekatan ini.
examples.translation: Ini bermakna boleh cerap Pauli berpangkat rendah memerlukan litar yang lebih kecil untuk dilaksanakan melalui pendekatan ini.
examples.why: "weight" (defined earlier in this file as "berat") is rendered "pangkat" = rank, the term this same file uses for the rank of the projections ($2^{n-1}$). As translated the sentence states something false — rank is fixed at $2^{n-1}$ for every non-identity n-qubit Pauli — and the learner loses the weight→circuit-size link that motivates low-weight stabilizer checks.

examples.source: which explains our focus on $X$ and $Z$ errors and apparent lack of interest in $Y$ errors
examples.suggested: ...serta kekurangan minat yang nyata (seolah-olah) terhadap ralat $Y$
examples.translation: yang menjelaskan tumpuan kita pada ralat $X$ dan $Z$ serta kekurangan minat terhadap ralat $Y$
examples.why: The hedge "apparent" is dropped, so the text asserts a real lack of interest in Y errors instead of a merely seeming one — the whole point being that Y is already covered up to phase by XZ.

examples.source: The same prescription can be followed for Pauli operations on $n\geq 2$ qubits
examples.suggested: Kaedah yang sama boleh diikuti untuk operasi Pauli pada $n\geq 2$ qubit
examples.translation: Preskripsi yang sama boleh diikuti untuk operasi Pauli pada $n\geq 2$ qubit
examples.why: "Preskripsi" in Malay reads as a medical prescription; a native technical writer would use "kaedah" or "resipi" here. Recognizable but a clear calque.

examples.source: and by tensoring them together we obtain operations on multiple qubits
examples.suggested: dan dengan mendarab tensorkannya (hasil darab tensor antaranya), kita memperoleh operasi pada berbilang qubit
examples.translation: dan dengan menghasilkan darab tensor antara mereka, kita memperoleh operasi pada berbilang qubit
examples.why: "mereka" is the animate/human pronoun; used for matrices it is a typical translationese slip — Malay takes the clitic "-nya"/"antaranya" for inanimate referents.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or hallucinated claims — and the informal "ty" register holds ("zawsze musisz podać", "twój zaszumiony obwód", "znajdziesz"), but a native technical editor would rewrite a lot. "Observable" is rendered three ways in one file: "obserwowalny/obserwowalnego" (intro, PNA overview, Hamiltonian section), "obserwabli/obserwablą" (the PNA propagation section) and "obserwablu/obserwabla" (measurement-bases section); "term" likewise alternates between "składnik" (max_err_terms/max_obs_terms bullets) and the English borrowing "term/termy Pauliego". Glossary leakage leaves core nouns untranslated and capitalized mid-sentence and undeclined — "Transpilacja do Backend", "łańcuch Qubitów", "Twirl wszystkich aktywnych Qubitów", "Próbkuj Circuit", "Circuit zawierający wszystkie bramki" — while the same concepts appear correctly as "obwód"/"jednokubitowe" elsewhere. Two outright non-words survive ("przekazujemy do nauciciela szumu", "do pełnego zdefiniowania samplskiego"), the intro has the redundant garble "z selekcji post-selekcji", and the closing section switches from the file's own "mitygacja błędów" to "wartość oczekiwaną z korekcją błędów" three times — naming quantum error correction, a distinct technique from the error mitigation this tutorial teaches.

examples.source: Post-process the samples to calculate an error-mitigated expectation value … combining all of the data into an error-mitigated expectation value.
examples.suggested: … wartość oczekiwaną z mitygacją błędów (spójnie z resztą pliku)
examples.translation: Przetwórz próbki, aby obliczyć wartość oczekiwaną z korekcją błędów … aby połączyć wszystkie dane w wartość oczekiwaną z korekcją błędów.
examples.why: The rest of the file consistently uses "mitygacja błędów" for error mitigation (intro, PNA definition, outline). "Korekcja błędów" is the established Polish term for quantum error *correction* — a different technique class that IBM's own material explicitly contrasts with mitigation. Recognizable in context (TREX, post-selection mask), so MINOR, but a reader could take PNA/TREX for QEC.

examples.source: observable (throughout)
examples.suggested: pick one — "obserwabla" (f., the standard Polish physics noun) — and decline it consistently: "obserwabla mitygująca szum", "w mierzonej obserwabli"
examples.translation: "obserwowalnego" (zarys, definicja PNA), "obserwabli / obserwablą ograniczającą szum" (sekcja propagacji), "w mierzonym obserwablu / naszego obserwabla" (sekcja baz pomiarowych)
examples.why: Three renderings of the same core term inside one tutorial; "obserwowalny" used as a noun is an English calque, whereas "obserwabla" is the conventional Polish physics term. The heading "obserwabli ograniczającą szum" also breaks agreement.

examples.source: These are the layers we pass to the noise learner. / Bindings necessary to fully define the samplex
examples.suggested: … przekazujemy do noise learnera (obiektu uczącego szumu). / … niezbędne do pełnego zdefiniowania obiektu samplex
examples.translation: To te warstwy przekazujemy do nauciciela szumu. / Powiązania niezbędne do pełnego zdefiniowania samplskiego
examples.why: "nauciciela" and "samplskiego" are not Polish words — the first is a mangled "nauczyciela", the second an invented adjective from "samplex". Both read as raw MT artifacts in otherwise clean prose.

examples.source: …and post-selection to mitigate errors not captured… / Transpile it to the backend… / choose a chain of qubits… / Sample the circuit using the Executor primitive
examples.suggested: …oraz z post-selekcji, aby… / Transpilacja obwodu do backendu… / łańcuch kubitów… / Próbkuj obwód za pomocą…
examples.translation: …oraz z selekcji post-selekcji, aby mitygować błędy nieuwzględnione… / Transpilacja do Backend… / wybierzemy łańcuch Qubitów… / Próbkuj Circuit za pomocą prototypu prymitywu ``Executor``
examples.why: "selekcji post-selekcji" is a doubled term; "Backend", "Qubitów", "Circuit" are left in English, capitalized mid-sentence and undeclined, even though the same file elsewhere writes "obwód" and "bramki jednokubitowe". Classic glossary leak — no Polish technical writer would mix the two.

examples.source: A shape tuple to extend the implicit shape defined by ``samplex_arguments``. Non-trivial axes introduced by this extension enumerate randomizations.
examples.suggested: Nietrywialne osie wprowadzone przez to rozszerzenie numerują randomizacje.
examples.translation: Krotka kształtu rozszerzająca niejawny kształt zdefiniowany przez ``samplex_arguments``. Osi wprowadzone przez to rozszerzenie wyliczają losowe instancje.
examples.why: The qualifier "non-trivial" is dropped, so the sentence claims all new axes enumerate randomizations rather than only the non-trivial ones; "Osi" is also the wrong case (should be "Osie"). Dropped qualifier — MINOR, but it slightly over-generalizes the API's behavior.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities — and the informal "ty" convention holds ("uwierzytelnij się", "upewnij się, że masz zainstalowane"). What a native editor would fix is a cluster of untranslated/mis-cased English leaks embedded in Polish syntax: "Circuit" is left English in every occurrence of "Circuit QPE" (should be "obwód QPE"), producing the ungrammatical "uruchamianie głębokich Circuit QPE na sprzęcie"; "Gate" survives in "jednoQubitowa Gate fazy" (should be "bramka fazy") even though the same paragraph correctly writes "błędy bramek"; and "Backend wzbogaconym przez Fire Opal" is capitalized mid-sentence. The same artifact produced the camelCase non-word "jednoQubitowego / jednoQubitowa" (should be "jednokubitowego / jednokubitowa"). Terminology also splits within the file: "eigenphase" is left English six times in the body but rendered "eigenfazy" in the closing paragraph, and "bitstrings" is "łańcuchy bitów" everywhere except the closing paragraph's "bitciągów"; separately, "counts" is rendered as plain "liczby" ("konwertujemy liczby na znormalizowane prawdopodobieństwa", "surowe liczby") where the Polish domain term is "zliczenia".

examples.source: However, running deep QPE circuits on hardware presents challenges
examples.suggested: Jednak uruchamianie głębokich obwodów QPE na sprzęcie wiąże się z wyzwaniami
examples.translation: Jednak uruchamianie głębokich Circuit QPE na sprzęcie wiąże się z wyzwaniami
examples.why: "circuit" is left untranslated and capitalized as "Circuit", and the Polish adjective "głębokich" cannot agree with it — the phrase is ungrammatical. Same leak recurs at lines 86, 126 and 174 ("Circuit QPE implementuje...", "Budujemy Circuit QPE", "budujemy Circuit QPE"). Polish uses "obwód" (or "układ") kwantowy.

examples.source: we illustrate QPE to recover the eigenphase of a known single-qubit unitary. The unitary whose phase we want to estimate is the single-qubit phase gate applied to the target qubit
examples.suggested: ilustrujemy QPE, odtwarzając fazę własną znanego operatora unitarnego jednokubitowego. Operator unitarny, którego fazę chcemy estymować, to jednokubitowa bramka fazy zastosowana do qubitu docelowego
examples.translation: ilustrujemy QPE do odtworzenia eigenphase znanego jednoQubitowego unitarnego. Unitarny, którego fazę chcemy estymować, to jednoQubitowa Gate fazy zastosowana do docelowego qubitu
examples.why: Three leaks in one sentence: "Gate" instead of "bramka" (the file itself writes "błędy bramek" correctly at line 24, so it is inconsistent), and the camelCase non-word "jednoQubitowego/jednoQubitowa" which is not Polish orthography ("jednokubitowy").

examples.source: masking the true eigenphase / The simulation sets the baseline for the correct eigenphase
examples.suggested: maskując prawdziwą fazę własną / Symulacja wyznacza punkt odniesienia dla prawidłowej fazy własnej
examples.translation: maskując prawdziwą eigenphase / Symulacja wyznacza punkt odniesienia dla prawidłowej eigenfazy
examples.why: "eigenphase" stays raw English in six body occurrences but is Polonized to "eigenfazy" only in the closing paragraph; the same paragraph also switches "bitstrings" from the body's "łańcuchy bitów" to "bitciągów". Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but a reader meets two names for each term.

examples.source: convert the counts into normalized probabilities for later comparison with hardware results
examples.suggested: konwertujemy zliczenia na znormalizowane prawdopodobieństwa do późniejszego porównania z wynikami sprzętowymi
examples.translation: konwertujemy liczby na znormalizowane prawdopodobieństwa do późniejszego porównania z wynikami sprzętowymi
examples.why: "counts" (measurement counts) is the domain term "zliczenia"; bare "liczby" just means "numbers" and loses the link to the shot statistics the code is normalizing. Recurs at line 88 ("surowe liczby" for "raw counts").

examples.source: including dynamical decoupling, qubit layout improvements, and error suppression techniques
examples.suggested: w tym dynamiczne odsprzęganie (dynamical decoupling), poprawę rozmieszczenia qubitów oraz techniki tłumienia błędów
examples.translation: w tym dynamiczne rozsprzęganie, ulepszenia rozmieszczenia qubitów oraz techniki tłumienia błędów
examples.why: "rozsprzęganie" is not the established Polish rendering of "dynamical decoupling" ("odsprzęganie"/"rozprzęganie dynamiczne" is used); recognizable but off. "tłumienie błędów" for error suppression is correct and consistent — no change needed there.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, informal "você" holds, and the authentication caveat ("O Servidor MCP do Qiskit e o Servidor MCP do Qiskit Docs não requerem autenticação") is rendered exactly. The defect is glossary leakage: "circuit" is left as capitalized English "Circuits" in four places ("transpilar Circuits quânticos", "Otimizar Circuits", "Executar Circuits quânticos", "otimizem Circuits quânticos") while the very same concept is correctly translated as "circuito" elsewhere in the file ("otimização de circuito", "síntese de circuito quântico") — an inconsistency a Portuguese reader will notice immediately, since "circuitos quânticos" is the uncontested PT term and there is no reason to keep it in English. Same artifact hits "backend": mid-sentence capitalized "Backends quânticos" twice, where lowercase "backends" is the normal PT convention. Separately, "AI-powered transpiler passes" becomes "passagens do Transpiler com IA"; "passagem" means a passage/crossing, not a compiler pass — "passes do transpilador" (or "passos de transpilação") is the conventional rendering. None of these would teach a false concept, but a native technical editor would change all three.

examples.source: Creating, manipulating, and transpiling quantum circuits / Optimizing circuits using AI-powered transpilation
examples.suggested: Criar, manipular e transpilar circuitos quânticos / Otimizar circuitos usando transpilação com inteligência artificial
examples.translation: Criar, manipular e transpilar Circuits quânticos / Otimizar Circuits usando transpilação com inteligência artificial
examples.why: "Circuits" is untranslated English with anomalous mid-sentence capitalization — a glossary-preservation leak. "circuito(s)" is the standard PT term and the file itself already uses it in "otimização de circuito" (l.48) and "síntese de circuito quântico" (l.56), so the same concept is split two ways within one page.

examples.source: Analyzing and selecting optimal quantum backends / interact with quantum backends
examples.suggested: Analisar e selecionar backends quânticos ideais / interajam com backends quânticos
examples.translation: Analisar e selecionar Backends quânticos ideais / interajam com Backends quânticos
examples.why: Keeping "backend" in English is a defensible convention in PT quantum docs, but the forced capitalization mid-sentence is not — it reads as a machine-substituted token rather than prose a Portuguese engineer wrote.

examples.source: AI-powered transpiler passes
examples.suggested: passes do transpilador com IA (ou: passos de transpilação com IA)
examples.translation: passagens do Transpiler com IA
examples.why: "Passagem" in PT means a passage/crossing/fare, not a compiler pass; the compiler sense is conventionally "passe" (or "passo"). Recognizable in context via the link, but it is not the term the field uses, and it is inconsistent with the file's own translated "transpilar"/"transpilação".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities; the billing caveat ("este NÃO é o tempo usado para cobrança (tempo de QPU)"), the v0.43.0 version gate and the "1 dt = 1 ciclo de agendamento" definition all survive intact, and the informal "você" register holds. The dominant defect is within-file term splitting: "circuit" appears untranslated and capitalized as "Circuit/Circuits" in the title, description and body (line 2 "Visualizar o timing do Circuit", line 35 "Circuits estáticos"/"Circuits dinâmicos", line 153 "Circuits ISA", line 237 "Visualizar Circuits") while the normal Portuguese "circuito(s)" is used 11 times elsewhere — twice inside the same sentence (line 35 "...para Circuits estáticos, ele pode não refletir com precisão o timing de Circuits dinâmicos... o timing do circuito"; line 153 "defina os circuitos e converta-os para Circuits ISA"). Secondary: the literal metadata key `compilation` is translated to "metadados de \"compilação\"" (line 40) even though the code just below reads `metadata["compilation"]`; "feedforward" is rendered "Retroalimentação" (line 236), which is Portuguese for *feedback*, the opposite direction; and "Adicionalmente" (line 148) is a calque of "Additionally" where a native technical writer would write "Além disso".

examples.source: While the timeline drawer built in to Qiskit is useful for static circuits, it might not accurately reflect the timing of dynamic circuits
examples.suggested: ...útil para circuitos estáticos ... o timing de circuitos dinâmicos ...
examples.translation: Embora o [visualizador de linha do tempo] integrado ao Qiskit seja útil para Circuits estáticos, ele pode não refletir com precisão o timing de Circuits dinâmicos ... o Qiskit Runtime retorna as informações precisas de timing do circuito
examples.why: "circuit" is left in English and capitalized as "Circuit/Circuits" in 9 prose spots (title, sidebar_label, description, line 35 x3, line 153 "Circuits ISA", the two Next-steps links) while the correct "circuito(s)" is used 11 times elsewhere — the split even occurs inside a single sentence. The page title "Visualizar o timing do Circuit" reads as broken Portuguese to a native reader. Recognizable, so not misleading, but an editor would unify on "circuito".

examples.source: Although the total circuit time is returned in the "compilation" metadata, this is NOT the time used for billing (QPU time).
examples.suggested: ... seja retornado nos metadados de `compilation` ...
examples.translation: Embora o tempo total do circuito seja retornado nos metadados de "compilação", este NÃO é o tempo usado para cobrança (tempo de QPU).
examples.why: "compilation" in the English is the literal dictionary key the reader will type — the code two cells later is metadata["compilation"]. Translating it to "compilação" turns an API identifier into a common noun; a learner scanning for a key named "compilação" will not find one. The caveat itself (NOT billing time) is preserved correctly.

examples.source: Classical feedforward and control flow (dynamic circuits)
examples.suggested: Feedforward clássico e fluxo de controle (circuitos dinâmicos)
examples.translation: Retroalimentação clássica e fluxo de controle (Circuits dinâmicos)
examples.why: "Retroalimentação" is the standard Portuguese word for *feedback*, i.e. the reverse-direction concept; "feedforward" describes classical information flowing forward from a mid-circuit measurement to later gates. The link target is still identifiable from "fluxo de controle / circuitos dinâmicos", so this is imperfect-but-recognizable rather than a false concept — but the field keeps "feedforward" in English in Portuguese-language Qiskit material.

examples.source: Instruction - The gate and the qubit to operate on. ... Additionally, each instruction has the format of X_Y
examples.suggested: `Instruction` - O gate e o qubit sobre o qual ele atua. ... Além disso, cada instrução tem o formato *X_Y*
examples.translation: `Instruction` - O gate e o qubit a operar. ... Adicionalmente, cada instrução tem o formato *X_Y*
examples.why: "o qubit a operar" is a compressed calque of "the qubit to operate on" and reads as if the qubit does the operating; "Adicionalmente" is a word-for-word carry-over of "Additionally" that a Portuguese technical writer would render "Além disso". Grammatical and non-misleading, but audibly translated.

editor_note: Register is correct throughout (informal "tu": "s-ar putea să vrei", "poți apela", "folosește"), and the body prose is accurate — the caveat "această metodă nu returnează rezultate corecte pentru circuitele dinamice" is preserved intact. Four editorial defects, none misleading. (1) The "Pași următori" list diverges from the English: the first bullet was replaced with "[Feedforward clasic și fluxul de control](/guides/classical-feedforward-and-control-flow) (circuite dinamice)" instead of "[Visualize circuit timing](/guides/qiskit-runtime-circuit-timing) when using Qiskit Runtime" — a different page and different label, and the "when using Qiskit Runtime" qualifier is gone (the body still links that guide, so nothing is lost pedagogically). (2) "circuit" is written as a capitalized, hyphen-inflected proper noun in some places ("sincronizarea Circuit-ului", "Vizualizează Circuit-urile", "programarea unui Circuit") but correctly lowercase in others ("pe un circuit", "circuitele dinamice") — bad Romanian orthography plus within-file inconsistency. (3) "circuit timing" → "sincronizarea Circuit-ului": "sincronizare" means synchronization, not timing; "temporizarea/cronometrarea circuitului" is the domain-correct rendering. (4) "To visualize a scheduled circuit program" → "un program Circuit programat" is a stiff, near-tautological calque ("program … programat") that no Romanian technical writer would produce.

examples.source: - [Visualize circuit timing](/guides/qiskit-runtime-circuit-timing) when using Qiskit Runtime
examples.suggested: - [Vizualizează temporizarea circuitului](/guides/qiskit-runtime-circuit-timing) când folosești Qiskit Runtime
examples.translation: - [Feedforward clasic și fluxul de control](/guides/classical-feedforward-and-control-flow) (circuite dinamice)
examples.why: The recommendation was substituted with a different guide and label; the English pointer to the Qiskit Runtime timing guide and its "when using Qiskit Runtime" qualifier disappear from Next steps.

examples.source: Visualize circuit timing
examples.suggested: Vizualizează temporizarea circuitului
examples.translation: Vizualizează sincronizarea Circuit-ului
examples.why: "Sincronizare" = synchronization, a different concept from timing; also the capitalized, hyphen-inflected "Circuit-ului" is not Romanian orthography for a common noun.

examples.source: circuit / circuits
examples.suggested: circuit / circuitului / circuitele throughout
examples.translation: "pe un circuit", "circuitele dinamice" vs. "programarea unui Circuit", "Vizualizează Circuit-urile"
examples.why: The same common noun is rendered lowercase in some sentences and as a capitalized hyphenated form in others within one short file.

examples.source: To visualize a scheduled circuit program, you can call this function with a set of control arguments.
examples.suggested: Pentru a vizualiza un program de circuit planificat, poți apela această funcție cu un set de argumente de control.
examples.translation: Pentru a vizualiza un program Circuit programat, poți apela această funcție cu un set de argumente de control.
examples.why: "program Circuit programat" stacks "program" and "programat" in a way that reads as raw word-for-word transfer; "planificat" also disambiguates scheduling from programming.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; the Grover/oracle setup, the `optimization_level=0` vs `3` contrast, the dynamical-decoupling paragraph and the "mai mare este mai bine, iar 1 reprezintă fidelitate perfectă" gloss all match the English. The recurring defect is terminology form: "gate" is written as the non-word "poartă-uri" (lines 82, 88, 141, 189) — the Romanian plural of "poartă" is "porți", and the "-uri" suffix belongs only to English loanwords — while the very same sentence at line 82 also uses "Gate-uri swap" and "Gate-urile multi-Qubit", so the term is split two ways within one paragraph. Compounding this, common nouns are capitalized mid-sentence in German fashion ("Transpiler-ului", "Circuit-ul", "Qubiții", "Backend-uri"), and even that is inconsistent ("Circuit-ul" line 139 vs "circuit-ul" line 141). Register also slips: the file is otherwise informal "tu" ("te-ai aștepta", "Vei compara", "poți"), but line 35 switches to formal "Rețineți că…" / "Asigurați-vă că…". None of this misleads a learner, but a native technical editor would rewrite all four.

examples.source: The highest optimization level is much smarter and uses lots of tricks to reduce the overall gate count. Since multi-qubit gates have high error rates…
examples.suggested: …pentru a reduce numărul total de porți. Deoarece porțile multi-qubit au rate de eroare ridicate…
examples.translation: Nivelul de optimizare cel mai ridicat este mult mai inteligent și folosește numeroase trucuri pentru a reduce numărul total de poartă-uri. Deoarece Gate-urile multi-Qubit au rate de eroare ridicate…
examples.why: "poartă-uri" is not a Romanian word — it glues the English plural "-uri" onto the native noun "poartă", whose plural is "porți". The same sentence then renders the identical concept as "Gate-urile", so "gate" appears two different ways within one paragraph. Recognizable, so not misleading, but no Romanian technical writer would produce either form.

examples.source: Note that the same setting could improve the results of one circuit while hindering another. Be sure to inspect the resulting transpiled circuits before running on actual hardware.
examples.suggested: Reține că aceeași setare ar putea îmbunătăți rezultatele unui circuit, în timp ce îl poate înrăutăți pe altul. Asigură-te că inspectezi circuitele transpilate rezultate înainte de a le rula pe hardware real.
examples.translation: Rețineți că aceeași setare ar putea îmbunătăți rezultatele unui circuit, în timp ce îl poate înrăutăți pe altul. Asigurați-vă că inspectați circuitele transpilate rezultate înainte de a le rula pe hardware real.
examples.why: Formal-plural imperatives in a file that is otherwise consistently informal "tu" ("te-ai aștepta", "ai rula", "Vei compara", "poți observa", "Explorează"). A localized register slip, not a comprehension problem.

examples.source: it maps the circuit qubits to the device qubits… the circuit transpiled with optimization_level=3… adds dynamic decoupling to the circuit transpiled with optimization_level=3
examples.suggested: mapează qubiții circuitului la qubiții dispozitivului… circuitul transpilat cu `optimization_level=3`… la circuitul transpilat cu `optimization_level=3`
examples.translation: mapează Qubiții circuitului la Qubiții dispozitivului… Circuit-ul transpilat cu `optimization_level=3`… adaugă dynamic decoupling la circuit-ul transpilat cu `optimization_level=3`
examples.why: Mid-sentence capitalization of ordinary common nouns (Qubiții, Circuit-ul, Transpiler-ului, Backend-uri) is a German-style convention foreign to Romanian orthography, and the hyphenated "Circuit-ul" treats a fully naturalized Romanian noun ("circuitul") as a foreign loan. It is also applied inconsistently — "Circuit-ul" at line 139 vs "circuit-ul" at line 141.

examples.source: Since multi-qubit gates have high error rates and qubits decohere over time…
examples.suggested: …și qubiții își pierd coerența în timp…
examples.translation: Deoarece Gate-urile multi-Qubit au rate de eroare ridicate și Qubiții decoerează în timp…
examples.why: "a decoera" is a calqued verb coined from English "decohere"; Romanian physics prose says "își pierd coerența" or "suferă decoerență". Understandable but reads as machine-formed vocabulary rather than native technical writing.

editor_note: Overall faithful, casual (no ครับ/ค่ะ), and the load-bearing content is intact: the qubit-count caveat ("จำนวน Qubit จะกำหนดแค่ขนาดของ ensemble ที่สามารถฝึกได้เท่านั้น"), the benchmark table, and the closing "ฟีเจอร์นี้ยังไม่ได้ถูกนำมาใช้ในเวอร์ชันปัจจุบัน" caveat all survive. But "two interleaving half circles" is rendered "ครึ่งวงกลมสองอันเชื่อมต่อกัน" ("connected together") in the Overview while the same dataset is correctly called "ครึ่งวงกลมสองอันที่พันกัน" (intertwined) in the Examples section — an inconsistent and, in the first instance, wrong description of the make_moons shape. "quantum hardware" is likewise split between the English term (Overview) and the calqued "hardware ของ quantum" (post-benchmark paragraph). Two further spots are stiff or slightly re-scoped: "มันสามารถทำความแม่นยำสูงอย่างสม่ำเสมอ" is unidiomatic, and "classically train an ensemble of classifiers" becomes "ฝึก ensemble ของ classifier แบบคลาสสิก", moving the adverb onto the classifiers. None of these would lead a learner to a false concept about the function or about quantum computing.

examples.source: a synthetic problem comprising two interleaving half circles, a notoriously challenging problem due to its nonlinear decision boundary
examples.suggested: ปัญหาสังเคราะห์ที่ประกอบด้วยครึ่งวงกลมสองอันที่สอดประสานกัน ซึ่งเป็นปัญหาที่ท้าทายอย่างมากเนื่องจาก decision boundary ที่ไม่เชิงเส้น
examples.translation: ปัญหาสังเคราะห์ที่ประกอบด้วยครึ่งวงกลมสองอันเชื่อมต่อกัน ซึ่งเป็นปัญหาที่ท้าทายอย่างมากเนื่องจาก decision boundary ที่ไม่เป็นเส้นตรง
examples.why: "เชื่อมต่อกัน" means "connected/joined", not "interleaving" — it describes a different shape than the make_moons data actually has, and it contradicts line 89, which correctly says "ครึ่งวงกลมสองอันที่พันกัน". Also "ไม่เชิงเส้น" is the standard Thai rendering of "nonlinear".

examples.source: As quantum hardware evolves and scales
examples.suggested: เมื่อ quantum hardware พัฒนาและขยายขนาดขึ้น
examples.translation: เมื่อ hardware ของ quantum พัฒนาและขยายขนาดขึ้น
examples.why: Line 42 keeps the term intact as "quantum hardware"; here it is split into a calqued "hardware ของ quantum", which no Thai engineer would write. Same term, two renderings in one file.

examples.source: It consistently achieves high accuracies on classically challenging problems
examples.suggested: ฟังก์ชันนี้ให้ความแม่นยำสูงได้อย่างสม่ำเสมอกับปัญหาที่ท้าทายสำหรับคอมพิวเตอร์แบบคลาสสิก
examples.translation: มันสามารถทำความแม่นยำสูงอย่างสม่ำเสมอบนปัญหาที่ท้าทายสำหรับคอมพิวเตอร์แบบคลาสสิก
examples.why: "ทำความแม่นยำสูง" is not an idiomatic collocation in Thai technical prose ("ให้ความแม่นยำสูง" / "ทำความแม่นยำได้สูง" is), and the bare pronoun "มัน" at the head of a paragraph reads as MT rather than authored prose.

examples.source: it uses a hybrid approach to classically train an ensemble of classifiers on the labeled dataset
examples.suggested: ฟังก์ชันนี้ใช้แนวทาง hybrid โดยฝึก ensemble ของ classifier ด้วยวิธีแบบคลาสสิกบนชุดข้อมูลที่มี label
examples.translation: มันใช้แนวทาง hybrid ในการฝึก ensemble ของ classifier แบบคลาสสิกบนชุดข้อมูลที่มี label
examples.why: The English adverb "classically" modifies the training method; the Thai attaches "แบบคลาสสิก" to "classifier", so it reads as "an ensemble of classical classifiers". The emphasis of the hybrid pipeline (classical training, then quantum optimization) is blurred.

examples.source: Unlike other quantum machine learning solutions, this function is capable of handling large-scale datasets
examples.suggested: ต่างจากโซลูชัน quantum machine learning อื่น ๆ ฟังก์ชันนี้สามารถจัดการชุดข้อมูลขนาดใหญ่
examples.translation: ต่างจาก quantum machine learning อื่น ๆ ฟังก์ชันนี้สามารถจัดการชุดข้อมูลขนาดใหญ่
examples.why: "solutions" is dropped, leaving "other quantum machine learning" — the comparison has no head noun and reads as an unfinished phrase in Thai.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner — the qubit counts (120/156/133), revision dates, heavy-hexagonal lattice, TLS mitigation and coherence claims are all faithful, and the informal register holds with no ครับ/ค่ะ. But a native editor would still change four things. (1) The tip Admonition silently swaps the EN concept: title "Supported instruction set" → "Native gates และ operations" and the body "supported instruction set / all supported instructions" → "native gates และ operations / native gates และ operations ทั้งหมด" — narrower than the source, even though the link anchors happen to point at the native-gates sections. (2) "enhanced application workloads" becomes "workload ของแอปพลิเคชันที่หลากหลายมากขึ้น" (more *varied* workloads), which is a different claim from "enhanced". (3) "readout performance" is rendered "ประสิทธิภาพการวัดผล", where การวัดผล reads as assessment/evaluation rather than qubit readout (การอ่านค่า/readout). (4) "an Eagle-sized upgrade to Egret" is left as the untranslated calque "การอัปเกรด Eagle-sized จาก Egret", which no Thai technical writer would phrase that way; likewise "family เก่าจะถูกยกเลิก" for "retired" (ปลดระวาง is the idiomatic term).

examples.source: To find the supported instruction set for a backend, use [this code]. You can see all supported instructions in [this table].
examples.suggested: title: "ชุดคำสั่งที่รองรับ" / "หากต้องการดูชุดคำสั่ง (instruction set) ที่ backend รองรับ ให้ใช้[โค้ดนี้] และดูคำสั่งที่รองรับทั้งหมดได้ใน[ตารางนี้]"
examples.translation: เพื่อดู native gates และ operations ของ backend ให้ใช้[โค้ดนี้] สามารถดู native gates และ operations ทั้งหมดได้ใน[ตารางนี้]  (title: "Native gates และ operations" vs EN "Supported instruction set")
examples.why: The EN talks about the full supported instruction set; the Thai narrows it to native gates and operations, a strict subset, in both the title and the body.

examples.source: ...with increased connectivity for enhanced application workloads.
examples.suggested: พร้อมการเชื่อมต่อที่เพิ่มขึ้นเพื่อยกระดับ workload ของแอปพลิเคชัน
examples.translation: พร้อมเพิ่มการเชื่อมต่อเพื่อรองรับ workload ของแอปพลิเคชันที่หลากหลายมากขึ้น
examples.why: "enhanced" (better/more capable workloads) is turned into "หลากหลายมากขึ้น" (more varied workloads) — a different claim about what the added connectivity buys you.

examples.source: ...that directly impact coherence, gate fidelity, and readout performance.
examples.suggested: ...และประสิทธิภาพการอ่านค่า (readout)
examples.translation: ซึ่งส่งผลโดยตรงต่อ coherence ความแม่นยำของ Gate และประสิทธิภาพการวัดผล
examples.why: การวัดผล in Thai reads as assessment/evaluation of results; qubit readout is การอ่านค่า (or simply keep readout in English, as this file does for coherence and coupler).

examples.source: At 156 qubits, Heron is an Eagle-sized upgrade to Egret...
examples.suggested: Heron มี 156 qubit เป็นการอัปเกรดจาก Egret ให้มีขนาดเทียบเท่า Eagle
examples.translation: Heron มี 156 Qubit เป็นการอัปเกรด Eagle-sized จาก Egret
examples.why: The compound modifier "Eagle-sized" is carried over untranslated in front of a Thai noun phrase, a calqued English construction a Thai technical writer would unpack; the same stiffness appears in "family เก่าจะถูกยกเลิก" for retired families (ปลดระวาง).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, and the physics terms (syndrome, Pauli matrices, density matrix, Kraus representation, product state, encoding) are kept in English consistently, which is the right convention; register is correctly informal (no po/opo). What a native technical editor would still change is a layer of translationese in the discourse verbs and connectives: "Mahahanap natin na" for "What we'll find is that" (that verb means "locate", the idiom is "Makikita/Matutuklasan natin"), "Sa wakas" for the list-final "Finally" (that reads as "at last!", should be "Panghuli"), "Sa katumpakan" for "To be precise" (a calque; "Para maging tiyak"), and "Bago pa man ang aktwal na standard basis measurements" for "Just prior to" (reads as "well before" rather than "immediately before"). One phrase is genuinely misworded rather than merely stiff: "kung aling qubit ang pinatatakbo ng isang partikular na qubit unitary operation" reverses the roles — "pinatatakbo" means "is made to run by", where the English is "which qubit the operation acts upon" ("kung aling qubit ang kinikilusan ng operasyon"). There are also small orthographic inconsistencies: the same verb appears as "nagko-collapse" (line 30) and "nagco-collapse" (lines 83, 115), "pag-sukat" is hyphenated where standard Tagalog writes "pagsukat" (lines 83, 111, 170), and "maari" is a typo for "maaari" (line 22). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: What we'll find is that, to handle such errors, we don't need to do anything different from what we've already discussed;
examples.suggested: Makikita natin na, para harapin ang ganitong mga error, hindi na natin kailangang gumawa ng ibang paraan kaysa sa mga natalakay na natin;
examples.translation: Mahahanap natin na, para harapin ang ganitong mga error, hindi na kailangan pang gumawa ng iba kaysa sa mga nabanggit na natin;
examples.why: "Mahahanap" is the verb for physically locating something; the expository "we'll find/see that" is "Makikita/Matutuklasan natin". Flags the sentence as machine-rendered from the first line.

examples.source: it will be convenient to use subscripts to indicate which qubit a given qubit unitary operation acts upon.
examples.suggested: ...para ipakita kung aling qubit ang kinikilusan (o pinag-aaplayan) ng isang partikular na qubit unitary operation.
examples.translation: magiging maginhawa ang paggamit ng mga subscript para ipakita kung aling qubit ang pinatatakbo ng isang partikular na qubit unitary operation.
examples.why: "Pinatatakbo ng" means "is made to run by", inverting agent and patient; the operation acts on the qubit, it does not "run" it. Recognizable in context but wrong voice.

examples.source: Finally, let's consider arbitrary errors that are not necessarily unitary.
examples.suggested: Panghuli, isaalang-alang natin ang mga arbitrary na error na hindi kailangang unitary.
examples.translation: Sa wakas, isaalang-alang natin ang mga arbitrary na error na hindi kailangang unitary.
examples.why: "Sa wakas" carries the sense of relief ("at last!"), not the sequencing "finally" that closes a list of cases; a native writer uses "Panghuli".

examples.source: collapse (as a verb, throughout)
examples.suggested: Pick one spelling of the borrowed-verb prefix — e.g. nagko-collapse — and use it throughout.
examples.translation: nagko-collapse (line 30) vs nagco-collapse (lines 83, 115)
examples.why: Same borrowed verb spelled two ways within one short file; purely orthographic, but a copy editor would unify it. Same class as "pag-sukat" for standard "pagsukat" and the "maari"/"maaari" typo on line 22.

examples.source: To be precise, we'll consider an error described by an arbitrary qubit channel.
examples.suggested: Para maging tiyak, isasaalang-alang natin ang isang error na inilarawan ng isang arbitrary na qubit channel.
examples.translation: Sa katumpakan, isasaalang-alang natin ang isang error na inilarawan ng isang arbitrary na qubit channel.
examples.why: "Sa katumpakan" is a word-for-word calque of "in precision" and is not an idiomatic Tagalog discourse marker; "Para maging tiyak/eksakto" is what a technical writer uses.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; the tricky region sentence ("Maaari mong ma-access ang alinmang rehiyon gamit ang parehong API key, ngunit makikita at ma-access mo lamang ang mga instance na nilikha sa rehiyong kung saan ka naka-log in") preserves both the "either region / same key" permission and the "only instances in your logged-in region" restriction exactly. Register is correctly casual (ka/mo/iyong, no po/opo), and the English-kept terms (instance, account switcher, API token/key, QPU, circuit, firewall, REST API) are consistent. What a native technical editor would still change is morphology and one calqued modifier stack: the frontmatter has "pagsumite" where standard Tagalog is "pagsusumite"; "naka-ugnay" in the intro paragraph should be "nauugnay"/"nakaugnay" (the hyphen is reserved for foreign roots, as correctly used in "naka-log in" two lines later); and "pinagkakatiwalaang Python na kapaligiran" stacks the English noun as a pre-modifier in English order — a native writer would write "pinagkakatiwalaang kapaligiran ng Python" (or simply keep "Python environment").

examples.source: Setup instructions for IBM Quantum on IBM Cloud to submit Qiskit SDK and Qiskit Runtime jobs
examples.suggested: ... para sa pagsusumite ng mga trabaho sa Qiskit SDK at Qiskit Runtime
examples.translation: Mga tagubilin sa pag-setup ng IBM Quantum sa IBM Cloud para sa pagsumite ng mga Qiskit SDK at Qiskit Runtime na trabaho
examples.why: "pagsumite" is a non-standard gerund; the verb magsumite/isumite gives "pagsusumite". The stacked "Qiskit SDK at Qiskit Runtime na trabaho" also copies English modifier order; Tagalog prefers the head noun first with "sa".

examples.source: Your user account is associated with one or more instances identified by Cloud Resource Names (CRNs)
examples.suggested: Ang iyong user account ay nauugnay sa isa o higit pang mga instance na tinutukoy ng _Cloud Resource Names_ (CRNs)
examples.translation: Ang iyong user account ay naka-ugnay sa isa o higit pang mga instance na tinutukoy ng _Cloud Resource Names_ (CRNs)
examples.why: "naka-ugnay" hyphenates a native root; the standard forms are "nauugnay" or "nakaugnay". The same file correctly reserves the hyphen for borrowed roots ("naka-log in", "i-configure"), so this reads as an inconsistency in the file's own convention.

examples.source: If you are using a trusted Python environment, such as a personal laptop
examples.suggested: Kung gumagamit ka ng pinagkakatiwalaang kapaligiran ng Python (o: pinagkakatiwalaang Python environment), tulad ng personal na laptop
examples.translation: Kung gumagamit ka ng pinagkakatiwalaang Python na kapaligiran, tulad ng personal na laptop
examples.why: "Python na kapaligiran" transplants the English adjective-noun order onto a Tagalog head noun; a native technical writer would use the "ng" possessive or keep "Python environment" in English. Same phrasing repeats in the step-3 bullets, so the stiffness is consistent but still non-native.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats — and the informal "ти" register holds consistently ("переконайся, що у тебе встановлено", "Зауваж, що спостережувана..."), so nothing here would mislead a learner. Two real editorial defects: (a) "gate" is rendered two different ways in the same file — "ворота/воріт" in the Background and transpile sections ("з меншою кількістю воріт або кубітів", "набір базисних воріт бекенду") but "вентиль" everywhere the `Move` gate is discussed ("віртуального вентиля `Move`"); "вентиль" is the better and dominant choice and should be used throughout. (b) The umbrella term "Circuit-knitting" is collapsed into "Розрізання схем" (= circuit cutting), which erases the distinction the English draws between the umbrella family and the cutting methods inside it — the resulting sentence stays true but the learner never meets the term "квантове зшивання схем / circuit knitting". Smaller items: the gender slip "додає віртуальне вентиль" (should be "віртуальний вентиль"), the ungrammatical ellipsis "отримане зі і без розрізання схеми" (needs "з розрізанням схеми і без нього"), and upstream/downstream rendered as вхідна/вихідна схема rather than "схема до розрізу / після розрізу". Terminology elsewhere is correct and stable: кубіт, транспілюємо, бекенд, примітив Sampler, очікуване значення, спостережувана/підспостережувані, базис Паулі, власний стан.

examples.source: ...involving fewer gates or qubits. / appends a virtual `Move` gate ...
examples.suggested: Use «вентиль» consistently: «із меншою кількістю вентилів або кубітів», «набір базисних вентилів бекенду»
examples.translation: «із меншою кількістю воріт або кубітів», «набір базисних воріт бекенду» vs. «віртуального вентиля `Move`», «вздовж вентиля `Move`»
examples.why: The same core term (gate) is split between «ворота» and «вентиль» inside one file; «вентиль» is the conventional Ukrainian rendering and is already dominant here, so the «ворота» occurrences read as a different concept to a scanning reader.

examples.source: Circuit-knitting is an umbrella term that encapsulates various methods of partitioning a circuit in multiple smaller subcircuits
examples.suggested: Зшивання схем (circuit knitting) — це узагальнений термін, що охоплює різні методи розбиття схеми на кілька менших підсхем
examples.translation: Розрізання схем — це узагальнений термін, що охоплює різні методи розбиття схеми на кілька менших підсхем
examples.why: «Circuit-knitting» is replaced by «розрізання схем» (= circuit cutting), which is one of the methods the umbrella covers, not the umbrella itself; the field's actual term disappears from the tutorial.

examples.source: `qiskit-addon-cutting` appends a virtual `Move` gate
examples.suggested: `qiskit-addon-cutting` додає віртуальний вентиль `Move`
examples.translation: `qiskit-addon-cutting` додає віртуальне вентиль `Move`
examples.why: Gender agreement error — «вентиль» is masculine, so «віртуальне» is wrong; a native technical writer would never leave this.

examples.source: the expectation value obtained with and without circuit cutting will be same
examples.suggested: очікуване значення, отримане з розрізанням схеми і без нього, буде однаковим
examples.translation: очікуване значення, отримане зі і без розрізання схеми, буде однаковим
examples.why: «зі і без X» is an English coordination pattern that does not work in Ukrainian, where the two prepositions govern different cases; the phrase reads as broken grammar.

examples.source: for each cut the upstream circuit must be measured in a Pauli basis, and the downstream circuit must be prepared in the eigenstate of the basis
examples.suggested: для кожного розрізання схема до розрізу повинна вимірюватися в базисі Паулі, а схема після розрізу — підготовлена у власному стані базису
examples.translation: для кожного розрізання вхідна схема повинна вимірюватися в базисі Паулі, а вихідна схема повинна бути підготовлена у власному стані базису
examples.why: «вхідна/вихідна» reads as input/output circuit rather than the part of the circuit before/after the cut, which is the spatial relation the wire-cutting explanation depends on.

editor_note: No semantic inversions or dropped caveats: negations (the "Skip to the next step if you are NOT using a trusted environment" parenthetical), the "one function job at a time" limit, `job.results()` vs `job.result()`, and the "respectively" pairing in the HI-VQE row all survive intact, and the informal singular address (كنت/استخدم/انقر/تجنَّب) holds throughout. What a native technical editor would still change: "observable" is rendered as the ACTIVE participle مُراقِب ("observer/monitor") rather than the passive مُراقَب / مرصود ("observable"), and it is diacritized that way consistently (مُراقِبات خفيفة الوزن، أي وزن من المُراقِبات، انتشار المُراقِب العكسي) — recognizable from context, but it names the wrong side of the observer/observable pair; the "low-weight / high-weight" observable pair is calqued as خفيفة الوزن / ثقيلة الوزن, which in Arabic idiom reads "lightweight/heavyweight" rather than Pauli weight. There is also a nonstandard form هجيني for "hybrid" (line 64) against correct الهجين later (line 69), a مشاكل/مسائل split for mathematical "problems", and a misparseable VSO clause "تُقدِّم الدوال IBM® وشركاء من أطراف ثالثة" that first reads as "the functions provide IBM and third-party partners". Plus two gender-agreement slips on سير العمل ("الكلاسيكية الكبيرة القائمة"، "سير عمل ... التي").

examples.source: Workloads that have low-weight observables and loop-free circuits. / compatible with any weight of observables / observable backpropagation
examples.suggested: مرصودات (أو: مؤثرات قابلة للرصد) منخفضة الوزن ... / مع أي وزن للمرصودات / الانتشار العكسي للمرصودات
examples.translation: أعباء العمل التي تحتوي على مُراقِبات خفيفة الوزن ودوائر خالية من الحلقات / متوافقة مع أي وزن من المُراقِبات / انتشار المُراقِب العكسي
examples.why: مُراقِب with kasra is the active participle 'observer/monitor' — the opposite pole of the observer/observable pair in quantum mechanics. The passive مُراقَب, or better مرصود / كمية قابلة للرصد, is the conventional Arabic term. It is at least used consistently, so the concept stays recoverable from context, but it names the wrong participant.

examples.source: low-weight observables ... high-weight observables
examples.suggested: مرصودات منخفضة الوزن ... مرصودات عالية الوزن
examples.translation: مُراقِبات خفيفة الوزن ... مُراقِبات ثقيلة الوزن
examples.why: خفيف/ثقيل الوزن is the everyday 'lightweight/heavyweight' idiom (as in lightweight software), not the technical Pauli-weight sense. The same file already uses وزن numerically ('أي وزن من المُراقِبات'), so منخفض/عالي الوزن would keep one consistent reading of weight.

examples.source: Functions are provided by IBM® and third-party partners.
examples.suggested: تُقدِّم شركة IBM® وشركاء من أطراف ثالثة هذه الدوال. (أو: الدوال مُقدَّمة من IBM® وشركاء من أطراف ثالثة.)
examples.translation: تُقدِّم الدوال IBM® وشركاء من أطراف ثالثة.
examples.why: Undiacritized Arabic defaults to verb-subject-object, so the first parse is 'the functions provide IBM and third-party partners'. The reader has to back up and re-parse. A native writer would either front the real subject or use the passive مُقدَّمة من.

examples.source: a robust hybrid VQA framework ... hybrid quantum-classical optimization
examples.suggested: إطار عمل هجين قوي لـ VQA ... التحسين الهجين الكمومي الكلاسيكي
examples.translation: إطار عمل هجيني قوي لـ VQA ... التحسين الهجين الكمومي الكلاسيكي
examples.why: هجيني is not a standard Arabic adjective form; the correct هجين is already used five rows later in the same table. One term, two renderings, one of them a nonword.

examples.source: problems modeled with 40 to 60 qubits / QUBO/HUBO problems / Binary optimization problems
examples.suggested: للمسائل المنمذَجة بـ 40 إلى 60 كيوبت / مسائل QUBO/HUBO / مسائل التحسين الثنائية
examples.translation: للمسائل المُصمَّمة بـ 40 إلى 60 كيوبت / مشاكل QUBO/HUBO / مشاكل التحسين الثنائية
examples.why: Mathematical 'problem' is مسألة in technical Arabic; مشكلة means 'trouble/difficulty'. The file uses مسائل once (line 66) and مشاكل everywhere else. Separately, المُصمَّمة means 'designed', not 'modeled' (المنمذَجة).

examples.source: integrating quantum into existing large-scale classical workflows / Classical machine learning classification workflows that could benefit
examples.suggested: في سير العمل الكلاسيكي القائم واسع النطاق / سير عمل ... الذي يمكنه الاستفادة
examples.translation: الذين يدمجون الكم في سير العمل الكلاسيكية الكبيرة القائمة / سير عمل تصنيف التعلم الآلي الكلاسيكي التي يمكنها الاستفادة
examples.why: سير العمل is masculine singular; both places attach feminine-plural agreement (الكلاسيكية الكبيرة القائمة، التي يمكنها). Grammatical slip a native technical editor would fix on sight.

examples.source: maximizing the performance of IBM devices to deliver accurate results
examples.suggested: مما يُعظِّم أداء أجهزة IBM لتحقيق نتائج دقيقة
examples.translation: مما يزيد من أداء أجهزة IBM لتحقيق نتائج دقيقة
examples.why: 'Maximizing' is softened to 'increases'. Not misleading on its own, but it flattens the vendor claim the English makes.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the usage rules (session = elapsed wall-clock, batch = cumulative QPU lock, zero usage on system-error failures), the "56 times longer than an `x` gate" comparison, the 250-microsecond `rep_delay` default and the 28-day rolling/full-day distinction are all correct, and the informal singular register (لاحظ، راجع، شغّل، إذا كنت تستخدم) holds with no formal antum slips. The defects are terminological and grammatical, not misleading. "observables" is rendered "المراقبات" ("monitorings/surveillance"), which is not the domain term (المؤثرات القابلة للرصد / الكميات المرصودة), and "commuting" as "المتبادلة" ("mutual") rather than "التبديلية"; only the retained English gloss "(qubit-wise commuting)" keeps the concept identifiable. "circuit" is split within the file between Arabic دائرة (lines 55, 67) and untranslated "Circuits" (lines 59–60), and "overhead" between الحمل الزائد (line 27) and عبء (lines 53, 60). Two straight grammar slips: "في دائرة الخاصة بك" (missing article — should be دائرتك / الدائرة الخاصة بك) and "الوقت الذي يستغرقه بوابة `x`" (بوابة is feminine → تستغرقه).

examples.source: Estimator groups qubit-wise commuting observables, which reduces the number of executions.
examples.suggested: يُجمِّع Estimator المؤثرات المرصودة (observables) التبديلية على مستوى الكيوبت، مما يُقلل من عدد عمليات التنفيذ.
examples.translation: يُجمِّع Estimator المراقبات المتبادلة بحسب الكيوبت (qubit-wise commuting)، مما يُقلل من عدد عمليات التنفيذ.
examples.why: "المراقبات" means monitoring/surveillance, not "observables" (المؤثرات القابلة للرصد / الكميات المرصودة), and "المتبادلة" means mutual/reciprocal rather than commuting (التبديلية). The retained English gloss keeps the concept recoverable, so this is an imperfect-but-recognizable term rather than a false concept.

examples.source: `<num executions>` is the total number of circuits times the number of shots ... extra circuits might be run as part of the mitigation process
examples.suggested: هو إجمالي عدد الدوائر مضروبًا في عدد اللقطات (shots) ... فقد تُشغَّل دوائر إضافية كجزء من عملية التخفيف
examples.translation: هو إجمالي عدد الـ Circuits مضروبًا في عدد اللقطات (shots) ... فقد تُشغَّل Circuits إضافية كجزء من عملية التخفيف
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: "circuit" is Arabic (دائرة / الدائرة / وقت الدائرة) in lines 55 and 67 but left as English "Circuits" in lines 59–60, with no reason for the switch. Same split for "overhead" (الحمل الزائد at line 27 vs عبء at lines 53 and 60).

examples.source: extra instructions might be inserted into your circuit, which would increase the total circuit length
examples.suggested: فقد تُدرج تعليمات إضافية في دائرتك، مما يزيد من إجمالي طول الدائرة
examples.translation: فقد تُدرج تعليمات إضافية في دائرة الخاصة بك، مما يزيد من إجمالي طول الدائرة
examples.why: "في دائرة الخاصة بك" is ungrammatical — an indefinite noun cannot take الخاصة بك; it needs either دائرتك or الدائرة الخاصة بك. A native technical writer would use the suffixed دائرتك here.

examples.source: A measurement, for example, can take 56 times longer than an `x` gate.
examples.suggested: يمكن أن تستغرق عملية القياس (measurement) 56 ضعف الوقت الذي تستغرقه بوابة `x`.
examples.translation: يمكن أن تستغرق عملية القياس (measurement) 56 ضعف الوقت الذي يستغرقه بوابة `x`.
examples.why: Gender-agreement slip: the subject of the relative clause is بوابة (feminine), so the verb must be تستغرقه, not يستغرقه. The 56x quantity itself is rendered correctly.

examples.source: This includes operations such as loading the payload into control electronics. ... which is 250 microseconds on most IBM Quantum backends.
examples.suggested: يشمل ذلك عمليات مثل تحميل الحمولة في إلكترونيات التحكم. ... وهي 250 ميكروثانية على معظم أجهزة backends التابعة لـ IBM Quantum.
examples.translation: يشمل ذلك عمليات مثل تحميل الحمولة في الإلكترونيات الضابطة. ... وهي 250 ميكروثانية على معظم backends الكم من IBM.
examples.why: "الإلكترونيات الضابطة" is a calque; the established Arabic is إلكترونيات التحكم. "backends الكم من IBM" half-translates the product name IBM Quantum into a construct that reads as machine output rather than something an Arabic-speaking engineer would write.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner — the meaning of every paragraph tracks the English, the Target/CouplingMap explanation is accurate, and the informal "ty" register holds throughout ("musíš provést", "budeš muset", "tvém případu použití", "Posuň se doprava"). The dominant defect is glossary-leak stiffness: English domain nouns are dropped into Czech prose uninflected and with inconsistent capitalization — "informace o Backend", "vlastností Backend", "verzi samotného Backend" (Czech needs "o backendu", "backendu"), "na více než dvou qubit", "podmnožině qubit", "na daném qubit" (needs "qubitech / qubitů / qubitu"), plus capitalized "optimalizaci Circuit", "stejný Gate" and "dvou-Qubit spojení u dvou-Qubit instrukcí" against lowercase "qubit" two lines earlier; "coupling mapě" is also a half-translated hybrid sitting beside the untranslated `CouplingMap`. Two smaller items: the qualifier "where possible" is dropped from "existing providers will deprecate the old access where possible" and replaced by an unsourced "postupně", and "enabled reasoning about quantum computers" flattens to the weaker "umožňující práci s kvantovými počítači". A couple of nominal calques ("pro vrácení informací", "Posuň se doprava pro zobrazení důležitých poznámek") read as translated rather than written.

examples.source: instructions that operate on more than two qubits … or it might have instructions that only operate on a subset of qubits (or two qubit links, for a two qubit instruction)
examples.suggested: instrukce operující na více než dvou qubitech … nebo instrukce, které operují pouze na podmnožině qubitů (nebo na dvouqubitových spojeních u dvouqubitových instrukcí)
examples.translation: instrukce operující na více než dvou qubit … nebo může mít instrukce, které operují pouze na podmnožině qubit (nebo dvou-Qubit spojení u dvou-Qubit instrukcí)
